chapters.title: Chapter 4680: THE Fallout! II
paragraphs: What did you do when the end of Existence came?
If asked this question, Noah could effectively say that he sat outside in the region of collapse sipping on Sacred Mead of Existence as he saw all of Existence begin to tremble.
And the trembling was unique as it was not even an effect that occurred when someone of sufficient power caused Existence to vibrate.

It was like something had been initiated and Existence vibrated in turn as if it prepared. The best he could explain it was seeing someone raise a blade or a gun toward you, and your body seemingly preparing for it, tensing to defend against it in any way it could.
It should be the activation ofTHE Loom, and whatever this weapon was bound to do across Existence.
Within THE Loom.
In a region filled with tumultuous waves of Civilizational Authority of Emotive, THE Living Emotivehad an expression of ecstasy as she performed a dance.

Her movements were manic and everywhere, limbs twisting in directions that defied anatomy while her form flickered between states of joy and sorrow and rage and love. She spun and leaped and crashed to the ground only to rise again, her dance a chaotic symphony of emotion made physical. Her laughter echoed alongside her screams, her tears fell even as her smile stretched impossibly wide.
And as she danced, she sang in a voice that was simultaneously beautiful and horrifying.
"Oh, my darling, my prisoner, my eternal flame,
The chains that bind you soon shall break, and nothing stays the same!
I’ve waited, waited, waited through the endless crawling years,
And now the moment comes at last to wash away my tears!
Dance with me, dance with me, through the falling sky,
The Loom unravels everything, and we shall never die!
My love, my enemy, my everything, my all,
I cannot wait to see you when the final curtain falls!"
HUUM!
Her dance reached a crescendo as she collapsed in a heap of manic joy, her chest heaving with laughter that bordered on sobbing.
"Soon," she whispered to the empty air. "Soon, my Creature. Soon."

Far from the domain ofTHE Living Emotive within THE Loom, in a distant region near the sea of endless Paradox, THE Living Paradoxstood before a vibrant cube that was currently spinning and radiating a profound light of power.
THE Living Paradoxhad a gaze of immense anticipation as he contemplated what he had accomplished.
He had done what many others may not have been able to do.
He had taken something as pristine as anAxiom and formed THE Loom around it.
It was actuallyTHE Axiom of Primordial Being.
Something that had been in the possession ofTHE Creature.
One of the Origin Axioms, and it granted absolute authority over Existence itself. The holder could decide what was real and what was not.

It was a terrifying construct to have in one’s hand, withTHE Living Paradoxbeing sure that this was part of the reason whyTHE Creaturehad succeeded in forming his Belly of Existence. WithTHE Axiom of Primordial Being, THE Creaturecould simply decide that his Belly existed, and it did. He could decide that it was vast beyond measure, and it was. He could decide that it was impenetrable, and it became so.
And nowTHE Living Paradoxwould use it and other tools at his disposal to cut open that overfilled Belly and also usher in a new age of glory.
"Audentis fortuna iuvat," he spoke such words with a smile as they had a simple meaning.
Fortune favors the bold.
And man oh man, was he bold.
To go againstTHE Creaturewas insanity. To think of fighting against Existence was an impossibility. And yet he still did it regardless.

Because he was not planning on being alone in fighting Existence andTHE Creature. He would turn and flip Existence upside down. He would corrupt everything that there was. Truly, even he didn’t know the final end result of The Fallout.

He was simply akin to an enzyme that initiated or catalyzed a reaction. He was acting as a biological catalyst. He had a rough idea of what would be coming, but the result was bound to surprise even him.
He would not be fighting against Existence alone.
Existence would be fighting against itself.
AndTHE Creaturewould have many, many enemies in the vast landscape that emerged from the ashes.
THE Living Paradoxwas feeling contemplative at this moment in time as he could not help but smile and think of the words that an old friend had said to him long, long ago.
"Look back over the eons of history and past with all the empires that rose and fell. Look back at all of this as in this history, you can also see the future."

Such glorious words meant that patterns repeated themselves. That what had happened before would happen again. That the same forces that toppled ancient powers would topple current ones. That understanding the past was understanding the future because Existence, for all its vastness, followed predictable cycles.
Empires rose. Empires fell. Powers emerged. Powers crumbled. And in the chaos between, new things were born.
THE Living Paradoxwas simply accelerating the cycle. He was pushing Existence toward its inevitable transformation, and in that transformation, he intended to be the one standing atop the rubble.
As such words rang out in his mind, THE Living Paradoxclosed his eyes as the cube in front of him spun faster and faster before it released a blinding light of brilliance.
Light filled absolutely everything as it radiated across this entire domain and spread even faster across the entire Loom.
A buzzing unlike any other began to bloom as an attack was officially initiated.THE Loomwas officially activated. And as a consequence, The Falloutthat would come as a result of it.
HOOOONG!

An extremely unsettling and heavy sound echoed out across Existence, a tone so deep and so vast that it seemed to originate from the very foundations of reality itself. It was not a sound that ears could properly hear but rather a vibration that souls could feel. It resonated through dimensions, through Folds, through the Wandering Territories, through everything that existed.

An attack that others could not even perceive erupted outward. An attack that even Fundamental Depths of Absolute Sovereignty entities could not understand, for it operated on principles that transcended normal comprehension.
It was precise and technical. It was eons of planning and hard work erupting all at once. And many would not even understand what had happened before they fell.
It was not an attack against bodies or against authorities.
It was an attack against Existence itself.
Against the very Axioms that held everything together.
Against Being.
Back in the region of collapse.
Noah felt his hand vibrating as the drink he held instantly vaporized and disappeared.
Something had happened that even he could not perceive. At this moment, his Existence only saw what he was capable of perceiving.
Countless gigaparsecs away, he did not hear any sound.
But he saw.

He saw a multicolored flaming mushroom cloud gigaparsecs in size bloom in the distance. It rose from a point of absolute destruction, its stem a pillar of annihilated reality and its cap a spreading dome of cascading devastation.The colors within it were not natural colors but the colors of Existence being unmade, of Principles being dissolved, of the very fabric of reality being incinerated.
The mushroom cloud expanded with terrifying speed, consuming everything in its path. Where it touched, things simplyceased. Ceased as if they had never been.
And then Noah observed that this was not the only one.

In all directions around him, he saw multiple other flaming points of explosive brilliance erupt across the horizon of Observable Existence. Each one bloomed into its own mushroom cloud of annihilation. Each one spread devastation across gigaparsecs of space.
The power and immensity felt was beyond anything he had ever experienced.
And then, only one gigaparsec away from him, a new point of light appeared.

The blooming of the clearest and most visible mushroom flaming cloud erupted with devastating proximity. Existence at the point of the explosion distorted and fractured like glass being struck by an impossible hammer. Cracks spread across reality itself, spiderwebbing outward from the epicenter as if existence was a window that had been shattered.
Noah heard the boom.
BOOM!

It was a sound that transcended sound. A vibration that transcended vibration. It struck him with such force that half of all his Logos shattered instantly, the carefully constructed meanings dissolving into meaningless fragments.
And then came the heat.

Blistering waves of thermal annihilation rushed toward him faster than light, faster than thought. His skin burned and tried to melt. Multiple other Logos that had survived the initial shockwave now melted away like ice before a sun.
Everything was made abundantly clear.
This was not something that could be survived through normal means.
This was not an attack that could be defended against with conventional authority.
This was The Fallout.
THE Fallout.
And it was glorious and terrible beyond measure.

At such a terrifying unfolding of events, Noah’s figure floated valiantly against the oncoming devastation. The Goad appeared in his hands, shining blue-gold with the authority of his entire Civilization.THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsmaterialized beside him, its pages fluttering in the cosmic winds of destruction, each page containing knowledge that now needed to be wielded.
His entire figure seemed majestic and defiant.
Even as his skin burned and his Logos melted, he stood firm.
Even as reality fractured around him, he did not flee.

Philologies bloomed around him in rapid succession. The Philology of Undifferentiated Mana wrapped his existence in protective meaning. The Philology of Perpetual Harvest began drawing power from the very destruction approaching him. The Philology of The Cheating Architect started rewriting the rules of his immediate reality.
He looked like a defiant primordial emperor welcoming a new era.
And he howled.
Not in fear and not in despair.
In challenge.
"COME!"
His voice carried across the collapsing region as the wave of destruction finally reached him.
"SHOW ME WHAT THE END OF EXISTENCE LOOKS LIKE!"
BOOM!
The wave struck.
And everything became light.

chapters.title: Chapter 4681: THE Fallout! III
paragraphs: Okay. So, maybe experiencing the effects of THE Fallout with his own body was ill-advised.
But Noah’s intuition was never wrong as he felt like he had to do this.
He knew that Depth may not necessarily matter when it came to survivingTHE Fallout. He knew that the answer lay with The First Tongue.
It was why even in The Early Veiled Shore ofTHE Creature, every single surface was absolutely filled with glimmers of The First Tongue.
And it was why his own Infiniverse had an array of Logos permeating every surface of its barrier that was deemedTHE Infinite Loom.
A shelter againstTHE Fallout.
In addition to that, THE Faraday Cagehad also been deployed as it consisted ofTHE Stanchions of Infinity, surrounding THE Infiniverse like an impenetrable cage.
Because of this, because these Stanchions were a part of his being, he could already be considered to have been experiencingTHE Falloutexternally.
Having a body out here to see exactly how the changes in Existence would unfold was just an additional step that was pretty much the same.
But man.
It was excruciating.
The sensation of sounds that atrophied Existence itself, of burning that radiated all around and even melted the very connections and framework of The First Tongue.

All of it was absolutely excruciating as the only reason that his Existence was not completely erased within the first few nanoseconds was because he was regenerating the Logos of The First Tongue as rapidly as they were being destroyed.
THE Falloutdestroyed, and he simultaneously returned each of them an instant after.

But it did not mean that he was spared from the unfathomable sensation of existential destruction. Even if one gave away their Everything of Pain and Sensation and Feeling, they would still feel this.

The apocalyptic atmosphere around him was one of absolute devastation. Multicolored flames of existential annihilation roared in all directions, each flame a different aspect of destruction made manifest. Some flames burned with the violet of unraveling time. Some burned with the crimson of collapsing causality. Some burned with colors that had no name because the concepts they represented were being erased even as they manifested.

The very fabric of reality was tearing apart around him, and through the tears, one could glimpse something beyond. Something that was not void but rather the absence of the possibility of void. Something that was not nothing but rather the erasure of the concept of something.
It was fucking confusing.

His body stood defiantly against this maelstrom, blue-gold authority pulsing desperately against the multicolored annihilation. His skin regenerated only to burn away again. His Logos reformed only to melt once more. His Philologies wove themselves together only to be unwoven by forces that seemed to specifically target the very structure of The First Tongue itself.
And as he did all of this...
Where The Wandering Territories used to be, THE Infiniverseitself stood like a boat in extremely horrid waters.

The illusory figure of Ruination stood besideTHE Tyranny Stanchion of Infinitythat should have been absorbing all the apocalyptic destruction. And yet even she was frowning as her body that should not be perceptible to damage felt a sense of heat permeating over it.
Beside her, the figure ofTHE Infiniversemanifested with an expression of grim determination.
"We prepared for ten times worse than we expected," THE Infiniversesaid with a voice that held both frustration and resolve, "and yet THE Infinite Loom is barely holding on."
BOOM!
The barrier shuddered as another wave of Fallout crashed against it, the Logos lining its surface flickering dangerously.

"The Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue that are lining up THE Infinite Loom are being destroyed as rapidly as they are being reformed," THE Infiniversecontinued, her jeweled eyes analyzing the situation with desperate precision. "But the moment that the existential cataclysm and degradation of The Fallout increases an octave higher, the rate at which we produce Logos and Philologies will fall behind. THE Infinite Loom would be overwhelmed. THE Faraday Cage would follow."
Her voice grew heavier with each word.

"This is not sustainable. The flames of THE Fallout would sweep into THE Infiniverse right after, and anything below THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty would be scorched out of Existence before even realizing it. Everything Master has built...gone in an instant."
Ruination held an imperious gaze as she processed this information. Right after, her eyes flashed with decisiveness.
"Sis," Ruination said with sudden intensity, "distribute all the pressure Creative Mode is taking onto me. I may have a use for it."

The situation was absolutely horrid. They prepared. They really did. Even after scaling their preparations upward by more than ten times in expectation of just how horrendous The Fallout would be, somehow even this was off.

The very integrity of Existence, the Principles flowing all around, the very makeup of The First Tongue, every single thing seemed to be undergoing change and degradation into something unrecognizable.
It even seemed like the scorching flames of The Fallout were specifically targeting The First Tongue itself.
As ifTHE Living Paradoxhad designed this weapon to attack the very language of creation.
As if he sought to unmake not just Existence but the ability to describe Existence.
In The Early Veiled Shore ofTHE Creature.
Anaximander’s expression was heavy, with another body of Noah standing beside him as they watched everything around them tremble.
As if the entire Shore was quaking and on the verge of shattering. The countless lifeforms within it looked up and all around with a sense of fear that transcended species and cultivation and origin.
Because at this moment, all of them could feel a prelude of the heat. A heat that told them if it did truly descend, they would not even be capable of thinking of the act of defiance against it.
It would scorch absolutely everything that they knew.

At such a momentous occasion, the figure of Anaximander graspedThe Goad of THE Creaturetightly. His knuckles whitened around the ancient stick as his brilliant eyes analyzed the situation with scientific intensity, searching for variables that could be adjusted, for factors that could be controlled.
Nearby, the figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originrose up and floated into the skies.

THE Living Origin’sentire body was shimmering with white brilliance at this time. In this moment, there was not really anything much that an individual could do. The means ofTHE Creaturewere really the only thing that could potentially be a saving grace in all of this.
And yet, at this moment, THE Living Originfloated up as if she was about to do something!

And when it came toClarity, Conviction, and Completeness, Completenesswas the only thing that one could say was weak when it came toTHE Living Origin.
Her Clarity and her Conviction were unfathomably grand!
HUUM!

So at this moment, THE Living Originclosed her eyes while her figure spun in the skies of The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature. The radiant Way of Origin permeated all around her as her figure instantly enlarged to be more than a gigaparsec in size. Her entire form looked like an unfathomable titan in the skies, an entity of beginnings whose mere presence reminded Existence of what it meant to start.

Two Philologies of The First Tongue burned around her with dozens of Logos orbiting them like satellites around suns. And in the next moment, decillions of strings of white light erupted from her and fell like a net over the entirety of the Shore ofTHE Creature.

The light of Origin began to paint over everything as this entity did not sit still. The countless lifeforms that had begun to feel a scorching, burning sensation within the Shore found a cooling radiance descending upon them. Where the light of Origin touched, the prelude of The Fallout’s heat receded. Where her strings wove themselves into the fabric of the Shore, the trembling lessened.
THE First Hungerlooked at this scene as he sighed and looked at the shaking all around. Then his own obsidian figure radiated crimson-obsidian light that pulsed with ancient hunger.

"THE Fallout?" Torspoke with a voice that rumbled like the stomach of a titan. "What is that to endless Hunger? Let me just consume whatever end it seeks to impose! I have devoured Ways and Civilizations and concepts themselves. I have consumed fear and hope and the space between moments. Does this Fallout think it is beyond my appetite? Does it believe itself inedible? HA! Let it come, and let it learn that nothing escapes THE First Hunger!"

In the next moment, THE First Hungerraised his head up and opened his jaw unnaturally wide. An obsidian-crimson jaw manifested above him, a maw that seemed to open into an endless void of consumption. It was surrounded by Logos of The First Tongue that spoke of devouring and digesting and making all things part of oneself. At the very center, a particularly radiant crimson Genesis Principle pulsed with the authority of Hunger itself.
The manifested jaw began to inhale, and the edges of The Fallout’s intrusion into the Shore were drawn toward it, consumed before they could do damage.
As all of this happened, near the body of Noah, the figure ofTHE Living Order, Sigrid, also rose as she breathed out with a sense of trepidation.
The phenomenon was an extremely terrifying one.
But...

"Order," Sigridspoke with a voice that resonated with absolute authority, "has been dormant since Paradox collapsed it long ago. It slumbered while chaos spread unchecked. It...I was absent while the very fabric of Existence frayed. No more."
Her black-and-white hair blazed with power as her eyes burned with conviction.

"My first action as an entity with any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Order will be to stake my Sovereignty against the chaos that The Fallout brings. Paradox initiated this destruction. Paradox seeks to unmake all structure and meaning. Then let Order answer! Let Order bloom to go against the actions of Paradox right now! Let every flame of chaos be met with a wall of structure! Let every dissolution be countered with crystallization!"
BOOM!

Her Existence here in the Shore ofTHE Creaturebegan to illuminate with black-and-white radiance. But alongside this, her Existence inTHE Infiniversewas illuminating even more. Patterns of perfect Order began to manifest around her, geometric structures of authority that pushed back against the chaotic flames.
THE First Hunger and THE Living Origin contributed. THE Living Order contributed. Each one imposed the Assertion of their Way against The Fallout.
The question remained whether Existence or The Fallout would even recognize any of theAssertionsof their Ways.
Maybe if any of them were atTHE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, theirImpositionscould have had an even grander effect.
Maybe.
But at this moment, there was not even a time for maybes.
Every single entity was doing all they could to put their very Existence againstTHE Fallout.
But whether their actions would yield any result was absolutely unknown.
In THE Infiniverse.
In the Early Veiled Shore, in the junction between the golden sands and the early sacred waters.

The figure ofAmelia Osmontcould be seen standing by the wet sands of the shore. She held a radiant blue-gold stick that looked to be a branch from one of the many trees in the Early Veiled Shore, its surface smooth from lots of growth and pulsing with the faint authority of The First Tongue that permeated everything in this place.

Even though she did not need to, she was walking around with this stick as she now placed it in front of her. She felt the vibrations traveling up the stick and into her hands from the golden sands beneath her feet.
Her expression was stern as she watched the shaking of the waters ahead of her and felt the trembling of the golden sand below her.

Her existence was extremely perceptive asThe Mother of THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, with her existence being privy to and having access to authorities that many underTHE Infiniverseonly dreamt of.

After all, she had carriedTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexiconsin her womb for many months. She had fed him and changed his diapers. She had consoled him when he cried and bolstered his confidence when he was hurt. She had watched him grow from a helpless infant into a man who shook Folds, and now into a being that laid claim to The First Tongue itself.
At this moment, even without having to try like The Emperor Penguin or Ayame or Barbatos or any others, her eyes actually flickered with Phonemes of The First Tongue.
She could form her Depth at any time if she wished. At this moment, she wondered if she should have done so in order to be able to help her son even a little bit more.
But just as she was thinking such a thought...
The figure of Noah walked up behind her to stand with her as she looked out into the expanse. His presence was warm and reassuring, even amidst the trembling of Existence itself.

"Do not let this worry you too much," he said gently."I never want to be the son that has to force his mother to fight on his behalf. You have fought for me all my life. Every sacrifice you made. Every night you stayed awake. Every worry you carried so that I wouldn’t have to. The least that I can do is make sure that you are safe."
Ameliasmiled at such words as she turned to look at her son with eyes that held decades of love and pride.

"Do you know what I used to say about you to the harping nurses and other workers whenever they asked me about you?"she asked softly."I would always boast about my son and say that in this world, all other men can be bad, but not my son."
She chuckled at the memory.
"Many took it as a joke and laughed. But I still say it to myself even today. Many beings can be bad, but not my son. Many beings can be weak, but not my son. Many beings can falter, but not my son."
Her voice grew stronger with each word.

"And since you have made the promise that me and all others will be safe, you have to be a man of your words. So I would leave everything to your hands. Because other beings may not be able to survive The Fallout, but not my son."
She looked directly into his eyes with absolute conviction.
"Not my son."
BOOM!
Amelia Osmonthad a radiant smile on her face filled with conviction as she said this. And in the next moment, The First Tongue buzzed wildly around her and Noah.
|Critical Event Detected.|
|The Mother of THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons has acknowledged her origin point.|
|She is the one who carried Quintessence within her womb.|
|She molded the Quintessence to be what he is today.|
|This is an act of immensity and effort worthy of unfathomable harvest.|
|She has utilized her motherly instincts to allow such harvest to flow toward your own Quintessence.|
|Result: The formation of the Core Phoneme of Quintessence blooms for the first time in Observable Existence.|
|The rest of the harvest has been directed toward the formation of all other remaining Core Phonemes.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4683: THE Fallout! V
paragraphs: Capítulo 4683: THE Fallout! V

Colorless brilliance permeated all around as from above Noah, lines and glorious waves of power began to twist and bloom. A letter of The First Tongue that had not yet bloomed in Observable Existence made its emergence.

It was colorless because Quintessence was beyond color. It was the purest essence of something, the distilled truth of a thing stripped of all excess. And now that essence had been given form as a Phoneme, a letter in the language of Existence that had never before been spoken.
It was a wonder that would have bloomed sooner or later from the hands of Ruination. But his mother tilted the scales just a teeny bit to cause this unfathomable result.
And as a consequence of it...
Noah’s eyes began to shine with a terrifying light of brilliance.

Because his body outside of THE Infiniverse, the one that had been undergoing cycles of destruction and regeneration of the Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue surrounding him, felt the blooming of the Phoneme of Quintessence.

And even though it was only a singular new letter in these Weavings of Existence, shockingly, it was not melted and decimated like the Logos and Philologies that he had been regenerating again and again.
It stood firm against THE Fallout.
It endured.
|A letter of Existence that did not exist before has come to fruition.|
|Such an action will have lasting consequences across all of Observable Existence.|
|The makeup of The First Tongue is no longer limited to eighteen Core Phonemes.|
|Every possible change you make, every potential new Phoneme brought to fruition, is an alteration of what many existences understand The First Tongue to be.|
|Your claim over The First Tongue has increased gloriously and quintessentially from this singular action.|
|You are no longer merely a speaker of The First Tongue.|
|You are becoming a contributor to its very structure.|
|At this moment, the newly emerging Phoneme of Quintessence poses a question to you:|
|Can a blade designed to cut Existence still have the capability to cut an aspect of Existence that did not exist when the blade was forged?|
BOOM!
The question was a heavy and yet simple one at the same time.
Noah looked at the Phoneme of Quintessence burning above him, colorless and pristine and utterly untouched by the flames of The Fallout that raged everywhere else.
And he answered.
“Fuck...” and he stretched the syllables of that one word as he finished it, “No,” he said with absolute certainty.

“A blade is forged with a purpose, with a target, with an understanding of what it must cut. THE Living Paradox spent eons designing THE Fallout. He studied The First Tongue. He understood its eighteen Phonemes. He crafted his weapon to attack what he knew, to destroy what he understood, to unmake what he had analyzed.”
His voice grew stronger.

“But a blade forged to cut iron cannot cut water. A weapon designed to burn wood cannot burn stone. And an attack crafted to destroy the eighteen Phonemes of The First Tongue cannot destroy a nineteenth Phoneme that did not exist when the attack was designed. The Fallout is precise. It is technical. It is the culmination of eons of planning. But that precision is also its limitation. It can only attack what THE Living Paradox knew to attack.”
He smiled with dawning realization.

“And he did not know about this. He could not have known about this. The Phoneme of Quintessence did not exist until this moment. It was not part of his calculations. It was not factored into his weapon. And therefore, it is beyond his weapon’s reach.”
The Phoneme of Quintessence shone even brighter at his words as Noah felt like he grasped the answer.
The answer to surviving THE Fallout.
THE Fallout was designed to collapse and affect Existence as THE Living Paradox knew it.
THE Living Paradox never accounted for new Phonemes.

The depth of destruction of THE Fallout, its effectiveness, would be tremendously reduced against something it was never built to attack. Against something that it was never built to be effective against.
So he just needed to enact all the other remaining personal Phonemes.
He just needed to complete what Ruination had been working on.
He just-
|I am close to presenting the rest to you, Master.|
The words of Ruination rang out in his mind with triumphant determination.

|All the effort and harvest from withstanding THE Fallout through Creative Mode has been directed to finishing the rest of the Phonemes. And after the declaration of Mother, I will deliver them to you soon.|
BOOM!

Noah looked at the constantly collapsing Weavings of Existence all around him. At the terrifying mushroom clouds of flames of Existence that seemed to only increase in size and frequency. At the annihilation that consumed gigaparsecs of reality with each passing moment.
And in the face of such sheer terror and cataclysm...
An eerie, devilish defiant gaze bloomed on his face.
He had his answer for survival.
THE Living Paradox had spent eons crafting the perfect weapon to destroy Existence as he knew it.
But Noah was about to introduce Existence to things that THE Living Paradox had never known.
New Phonemes.
New letters in the language of Existence.
New aspects of The First Tongue that had never been spoken before this moment.
And against these new letters, The Fallout would swing at targets that didn’t exist in its programming.
Its flames would try to burn concepts that weren’t in its fuel.
Its destruction would attempt to unmake things that weren’t on its list.
Noah looked at the Phoneme of Quintessence burning above him, pristine and untouched and perfect.
And he waited for Ruination to deliver the rest!
THE Fallout was akin to an unsurpassable and inevitable blade that cut through all of Existence.
But one must never forget that its target was THE Belly of Existence. Its target was THE Creature.

Inside THE Belly of Existence, the protective barriers were torn apart as waves of terrifying multicolored flames descended. They were not similar to the flames that were pervasively spreading outside all of external Existence as they did not seem as potent, but they were there nonetheless.
The flames ate away at the edges of THE Creature’s domain.

In a small region of THE Belly of Existence, the figure of Lumivara bellowed out as her Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty expressed itself in an undeniable fashion. Thirty-six entities with their own Depths stood behind her, roaring in defiance as the entire region they stood in became wrapped in an existential light of paradox.
“WE WILL NOT FALL HERE!” Lumivara’s voice carried the authority of THE Fundamental Depth as her white-blue fox ears blazed with power.

But within the next few moments, all of them disappeared, carried by endless waves of Existence to an unknown location. Their bodies continued to be hounded by the light of THE Fallout as it permeated across their existence, but they were moved nonetheless.
And there were countless others in THE Belly of Existence as what occurred continued to be pervasive. Civilizations that had existed since before differentiation found themselves scattered.
Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms. Those from The Infinite Unfurling.
Powers that had slumbered for eons were forcibly awakened. The sanctum of THE Creature, the place that had been inviolable for far too long, was being torn asunder.
THE Living Paradox’s blade was cutting gloriously deep!

paragraphs: Capítulo 4684: THE Fallout! VI
Back in that region of collapse.
Well, it actually could not truly be called a region of collapse anymore as this entire place was completely changed and carrying entirely different characteristics compared to before.

The surrounding Existence was covered by motes of gray multicolored allure as Noah faced bombardment all around. And yet for the first time, his existence held a sense of stability that the newly forged Phoneme of Quintessence provided.
It was like his existence was surrounded by countless shields, but only a single colorless shield was currently working.
The light of The Fallout still permeated across his entire existence as...
|An unfathomable and undeniable absolute change has been detected in Existence due to THE Fallout.|
|THE Fallout was undeniably meant to be experienced by every single lifeform in Observable Existence.|
|The Axioms of Observable Existence utilized to enact it have deemed it so.|
|Their set effects are now being branded across Existence.|
|No exceptions. No escapes. No mercy.|
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes flashed with a sense of alarm as in the next moment, a silent gray light of brilliance bloomed from the countless mushroom clouds of flaming Existence.
This light was a unique one that was not meant to be destructive as much as pervasive.
It was meant to be penetrative, as it permeated through all of Existence dancing on the waves and strings of The First Tongue. They shockingly sought to even enter THE Infiniverse.

And even though THE Infinite Loom and THE Faraday Cage were burning with brilliance, a portion of the light still permeated through. It used Existence and The First Tongue as passages to travel as it washed across THE Infiniverse.

It shockingly did the same to The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature. Anaximander raised his head up in defiance and roared as the gray light passed over him and countless others in the Shore of THE Creature.
THE Living Paradox had been extremely thorough.
THE Living Paradox had planned a great deal.
He truly planned to reshape Existence in an unfathomable manner, using things that Noah had just only recently learned about. The vision of THE Living Paradox became abundantly clear at this time.
As Noah faced these storms and waves of terrifying Weavings of The Fallout, prompts bloomed that allowed the vision of THE Living Paradox to be known at this moment.
|Your Existence has been branded with THE Existential Curse.|
|Curse Designation: THE Existential Ceiling.|
|THE Living Paradox designed The Fallout not just as a weapon of destruction but as a mechanism of control.|
|The curse is woven into the very flames and light of THE Fallout.|
|Effects of THE Existential Ceiling:|
|PRIMARY LIMITATION - THE Absolute Barrier:|
|- All entities affected by The Fallout can never advance beyond THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|- THE Absolute Depth becomes permanently inaccessible regardless of talent, resources, or time invested.|
|- Attempts to break through to Absolute Depth result in existential backlash that can collapse the entity entirely.|
|SECONDARY LIMITATION - Degraded Advancement Rate:|
|- Rate of cultivation and Way refinement reduced by 70% compared to pre-Fallout standards.|
|- The Clarity, Conviction, and Completeness of one’s Way becomes harder to develop.|
|- What once took centuries now takes millennia.|
|- What once took millennia now takes eons.|
|TERTIARY LIMITATION - Principle Erosion:|
|- Principles invoked or altered by cursed entities slowly degrade over time.|
|- All authority becomes inherently temporary, requiring constant maintenance.|
|- This prevents any cursed entity from building lasting power structures and Civilizations.|
|QUATERNARY LIMITATION - First Tongue Interference:|
|- The eighteen original Phonemes become harder to perceive and utilize.|
|- Logos formation requires 300% more effort and concentration.|
|- Philologies assembled by cursed entities are inherently unstable.|
|- The First Tongue itself seems to resist the touch of the cursed.|
|Markers of the Cursed:|
|- Faint cracks in your existence that glow with residual Fallout energy.|
|- A subtle dimming of your authority’s luminescence.|
|- An almost imperceptible tremor in your Sovereignty when exerted.|
|- The taste of ash that never quite leaves your perception.|
|Exposure Classification: Direct Exposure.|
|Full curse effects. Permanent and absolute.|
|Additional Warning: Unknown and unfathomable Mutations of Existence may bloom as a result of the absolute change and degradation to one’s existence.|
Noah read all these prompts with a sense of rage and coldness building in his chest.
They sought to restrict him?
They sought to block off his path?
WHO DID THEY THINK THEY WERE?!
“OOOH!!!”

He roared with defiance that shook the very fabric of collapsing reality around him, and THE Fallout itself seemingly roared back at him for his defiance as if it were asking...’The fuck are you on about? What are you even going to do about it?! You bum!’
The existential degradation around him became even more intense, as if the curse itself took offense at his refusal to submit.
The markers of the cursed began to unfold on Noah’s skin even as the flames of THE Fallout sought to end him.

Faint cracks appeared across his existence, glowing with the gray-multicolored light of residual Fallout energy. They spread like spiderwebs across his being, each one a reminder of the limitation being branded into his very soul.
His authority’s luminescence dimmed, the brilliant blue-gold of his Mana flickering as if struggling against a suffocating weight.
A tremor ran through his Sovereignty.
And the taste of ash filled his perception, coating everything with the flavor of endings and decay.
The curse was taking hold.
THE Existential Ceiling was being inscribed into his very being.
And at such a point...
BOOM!
He felt an eruption in his existence as warmth flooded through him from nine distinct points of power!
|The 8 other Core Phonemes apart from Quintessence have been forged and presented to you by Ruination.|
|9 new Core Phonemes of The First Tongue have been born.|
|They begin to flow across your existence, unblemished by The Fallout.|
|New Phonemes Registered:|
|- Phoneme of Quintessence: The purest essence of a thing, distilled truth stripped of all excess.|
|- Phoneme of Infinity: The boundless nature that defies limitation and ending.|
|- Phoneme of Tyranny: The absolute authority that demands obedience from reality itself.|
|- Phoneme of Fortune: The manipulation of probability and the guarantee of beneficial outcomes.|
|- Phoneme of Advantage: The systematic exploitation of loopholes in Existence’s rules.|
|- Phoneme of Narrative: The shaping of events to follow the arc of a protagonist’s journey.|
|- Phoneme of Harvest: The gathering of all that can be gathered from all sources.|
|- Phoneme of Hunger: The endless consumption that grows stronger with each devouring.|
|- Phoneme of Potential: The realization of possibilities that have not yet become.|
|These 9 Phonemes are YOUR Phonemes.|
|They did not exist before you.|
|They are immune to The Fallout’s targeted parameters.|
|They are the foundation of your unique existence.|
Noah closed his eyes as The Fallout raged around him.

He felt these nine points of new power. He felt how brilliant they were. He felt the warmth they encompassed all over his existence. He felt them as if they were part of his limbs, an extension of himself that had always been there waiting to be realized.
His existence mourned the curse being branded upon it.
But his existence also rejoiced at the new Phonemes flowing through it.
And he roared out with all his being...
“I WILL NOT BE BOUND BY SUCH A LIMITATION!”
THE Existential Ceiling.
He did not wish to be bound by such a limitation. And yet the capability and the power of THE Fallout was absolute. It was apparently being carried out by multiple Axioms of Observable Existence.
So Existence itself was telling him that he could not change it.
But his core sought to change it.
His innovation and design of brand new Phonemes of The First Tongue sought to change it.
But since it was absolute and could not be changed, another solution had to be found.
And so...
|Your existence is already too strange.|
|Too anomalous.|
|Too filled with infinities that defy normal parameters.|
|Your Infinite Mana seeks to reject the limitation.|
|Your First Tongue seeks to rewrite the degradation, regardless of how absolute it is.|
|An unprecedented possibility has been reached.|
|The basal mutative factor of THE Fallout has been commandeered by the emergence of your nine Core Phonemes of The First Tongue.|
|They do not exist in THE Fallout’s targeted parameters.|
|They were not accounted for in THE Living Paradox’s calculations.|
|They are outside the scope of the Axioms’ programmed effects.|
|Your 9 new Phonemes of The First Tongue are now utilizing the very power of THE Fallout that is backed by the immensity of Axioms of Observable Existence.|
|They are inscribing and allowing the emergence of an absolute anomalous factor.|
|This factor could potentially deny the absolute limitation imposed on you.|
|This factor could give you the best chance of survival in the landscape that will follow THE Fallout.|
|Your existence is undergoing mutation.|
|Emergence of an anomalous factor backed by:|
|- The First Tongue|
|- Your Infinities|
|- THE Fallout itself|
|- The redirected flow of absolutes from Axioms far outside your reach|
|Something unprecedented is emerging.|
HUUM!
|THE Absolute Mutation of THE Existential Paradox Loop is emerging in your existence.|
|Classification: Singular Mutation.|
|Only one instance can exist in Observable Existence.|
|You have been given the distinction of THE Absolute Mutant.|
BOOM!
Noah’s entire body trembled as if it would shatter at any moment.
But it became even more solid and grander an instant later as an unfathomable thing emerged.

The nine Phonemes that had been flowing through his existence began to weave themselves into a pattern that had never existed before. They danced with the very flames of THE Fallout that sought to destroy him, stealing the Axiom-backed power and redirecting it into the formation of something new.
The cracks of the curse still glowed on his skin.
But now, colorless threads of Quintessence began to weave between them.
The dimming of his authority persisted.
But now, the Phoneme of Infinity pulsed against it, refusing to accept limitation.
The tremor in his Sovereignty remained.
But now, the Phoneme of Tyranny began to stabilize it with absolute authority.
THE Existential Paradox Loop was being born, not despite THE Fallout, but because of THE Fallout!

chapters.title: Chapter 4685: THE Fallout! VII
paragraphs: Existence was a struggle and Existence was unfair. Noah knew this very well by this point as he did not need anybody to tell him otherwise.

The emergence of an unfathomable anomalous factor, the emergence of this mutation within his existence as a causality, as an effect ofTHE Fallout, felt like an answer given by his existence against all of this unfairness.

As he was receiving its scope of information, he was realizing the immensity and ridiculousness of it. At this moment, he allowed everything to be put together as his focus was placed onTHE Infiniverse.
The light of The Fallout that was backed by unknown Axioms of Observable Existence had proceeded to touch everything.
The curse ofTHE Existential Ceilingpermeated across every single lifeform in Observable Existence.
Well, apart from those sheltered in the safety and cozy allure ofTHE Loom. That was the design and inherent nature ofTHE Fallout.

So at this moment, his expression was heavy as when he looked into THEInfiniverse, he saw the figure of his Mother with the marks of the cursed permeating on her body as she raised her hand and saw the faint cracks on them.

He looked at his people as he saw these faint cracks on their bodies, as if they were told from this point on, they would always be lesser. Mutated. That their path across Existence would forever have a ceiling as they could never cross a certain Depth.

Alongside this, some of those within his Civilization had their existence imperceptibly vibrating as they underwent different types of mutations. The Fallout was far too pervasive as their Civilization answered to it and tried to adapt to it by undergoing glorious evolution.
They tried to be like him. Whatever the resultant effects were going to be, it would be much less than what he achieved. But it was still something.

Noah looked at the raging Fallout all around him and roared with immensity, his sound waves mixing with the continuously blooming mushroom clouds as if he was roaring out his defiance toward Existence and the very Fallout itself for what it imposed.
"OOOH!"

The roar carried the weight of a being who refused to accept limitation. It carried the fury of someone watching his loved ones be branded with a curse they did not deserve. It carried the defiance ofTHE Anomalywho would not bow to anyone’s design.
And as his own existence continued to change...
|The First Phase of THE Fallout is ending.|
|The Second Phase is beginning.|
Motherfucker, what?
|This information is being drawn by the emergence of your Core Phonemes of The First Tongue that are not accounted for by THE Fallout.|
|It is now known and understood thatTHE Falloutis irreversibly altering Existence, Paradox, Chaos, and The First Tongue in phases and sequences absolutely.|
|Your Core Phonemes, your additions to The First Tongue, will be the only things that remain unaffected.|
|The Second Phase of The Fallout involves:|
|- Endless expansion of all zones|
|- Corruption of fundamental existential relationships|
|- Displacement of Existence to forge the landscape of Existence after The Fallout|
|In that landscape:|
|- Distance is meaningless yet impassable|
|- Communication is impossible through any normal Weavings of Existence|
|- Sound is the only thing that can travel|
|- Mental connections will be severed|
|- Thoughts cannot be sent across distances|
|-Perception and awareness will be limited to a few miles even for THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities|
|All Weavings of Existence will be compressed to a singular existence.|
|Even clones of an entity will be returned to the main body.|
|EXCEPTION DETECTED:|
|The defiance of your existence and the unaltered Phonemes of your First Tongue bypass this limitation.|
|At most, you are capable of supporting the emergence and maintenance of two or three bodies.|
|WARNING:|
|If another body remains outside in the landscape of The Fallout as the Second Phase unfolds:|
|- All of your existence could be focused on it|
|- Your connection toTHE Infiniversecould be severed or masked|
|- You would not be able to find your way back to it|
|- Teleportation will not be possible|
|- Even quantum movement across distances will not be possible|
|It is advised to return to THE Infiniverse as the Second Phase of The Fallout unfolds and irreversibly changes all of Existence.|
The words were heavy.
Noah’s eyes burned with defiance as he felt like he had won and also lost.
He looked down across the ever-changing landscape ofTHE Falloutas he felt an imminent countdown that would stop absolutely everything.
And he disappeared.
He returned toTHE Infiniverse, into his Early Veiled Shore. The vibrating and the shaking of Existence had stopped as if it was known that imminent destruction had now been weathered and survived.
He stepped on the golden sands and looked at his people whose existence seemed to be undergoing their own imperceptible changes.
And they looked back at him.
A king looked at his family.
An emperor looked at his people.

At this moment, Noah looked like something that had transcended humanity entirely. His body radiated a terrifying, regal, and majestic allure of power. He was adorned in that blue-gold robe shining with his Way and filled with Phonemes of The First Tongue, now adding an additional nine that pulsed with unprecedented authority.

The cracks of the curse spread across his skin like fractured porcelain, but colorless tendrils of Quintessence now flowed through them, weaving between the damage like threads of pure essence refusing to accept the brokenness.
And his eyes.
His eyes had changed most of all.

His pupils now held an image of an endlessly recursive infinite loop, spiraling inward and outward simultaneously. It was hypnotic and terrifying, a visual representation of the mutation that now defined his existence. Looking into those eyes was like staring into a type of Infinity itself.
He looked like a grand ancient primordial emperor instead of a human being.
When he looked at his people, thinking of how he may have failed them, thinking of how they now bore cracks that would never fully heal...
His mother appeared beside him with a smile.
The cracks over her skin were faint but there, glowing with that residual Fallout energy that marked all the cursed. And yet she smiled as if none of it mattered.
"It seems like the hard part is over," Ameliasaid with serenity that only a mother could possess in such circumstances. "Let us now be together as we watch the unfolding end of Existence, shall we?"
The words were serene as they implied success.

Noah’s existence burned as he looked at his Mother and his people. The defiance in his eyes became even more pronounced as barring everything else, they had survived the First Phase of THE Fallout that was focused on lifeforms. They could now wait to see just what immense and unfathomable Weavings of Existence unfold as the Second Phase ofTHE Fallouttargeted all of Existence itself.

He looked at his people, at Sigrid and Khor, at Riya and Adelaide, at his Mother and Henry, at Titano and The Emperor Penguin, at Hyperion and The Great Beyonder, at Moiraine and Barbatos, at all those who had placed their faith in him.
Even the cockroach Little Bobby stood in a corner with a cracked bald round head as he held his daughter close.
He looked at all of them as his voice echoed out.

"Whatever limitation The Fallout has imposed upon us will be but temporary," Noahdeclared with a voice that carried the weight of absolute conviction. "Our Weavings of Existence will see glory. They will see Absolute. This I promise to myself, and to you."
HUUM!

He said such words to his people as Existence pulsed in turn. The sands of the Early Veiled Shore vibrated as if in agreement, as if the very foundation of his Civilization acknowledged the promise being made.
And he said this without boasting.
Because the details of his emerging anomalous factor became abundantly clear in his mind.
|THE EXISTENTIAL PARADOX LOOP - FULL DOCUMENTATION|
|Classification: Singular Mutation|
|Only one instance can exist in Observable Existence.|
|Status: Emerging within your existence.|
|Designation: THE Absolute Mutant.|
|CORE FUNCTION:|
|You can reset your existence to any previously experienced moment while retaining all memories, knowledge, and cultivation progress from the "future" timeline.|
|THE Existential Paradox Loopoperates on principles that bend the very nature of causality.|
|ANCHOR POINTS:|
|- You can designate specific moments as "Anchor Points" in your existence|
|- These Anchors are moments of significance that your Infinite Mana and your Way infuse with permanence|
|- You can have 9 Anchors active simultaneously across your timeline|
|- Each Anchor requires the infusion of an infinity to establish and maintain|
|- Current Anchors: 0/9|
|THE LOOP MECHANISM:|
|-Upon sensing the potential collapse of your Way and Civilization, or upon voluntary activation, your existence resets to the most recent Anchor Point|
|- All memories from the "erased" timeline are retained with perfect clarity|
|- All cultivation progress, including Depth advancement and Way refinement, is retained|
|- Knowledge of enemy capabilities, future events, and strategic information persists across resets|
|THE INFINITY REQUIREMENT:|
|- Each reset consumes one of your infused infinities|
|- Infinities must be woven with Logos and Philologies of your 9 new Core Phonemes to function|
|- Without sufficient infinities infused into the Loop, it fails entirely|
|- Your Infinite Mana allows continuous generation and infusion of new infinities|
|Your new Phonemes are woven into the Loop’s structure:|
|- Phoneme of Quintessence: Anchors the "essential" you across all timeline iterations. Ensures your core identity remains intact regardless of how many resets occur.|
|- Phoneme of Infinity: Provides the boundless energy required to sustain the Loop. Ensures the mechanism never runs out of fuel as long as your Mana remains infinite.|
|- Phoneme of Tyranny: Grants absolute authority over the reset process. Ensures no external force can interfere with or prevent a reset once initiated.|
|- Phoneme of Fortune: Influences the outcome of resets toward beneficial results. Increases the likelihood that knowledge gained will lead to favorable outcomes.|
|- Phoneme of Advantage: Identifies loopholes and exploitable patterns across timelines. Allows you to recognize opportunities that others would miss.|
|- Phoneme of Narrative: Shapes the flow of events to favor the protagonist’s journey. Ensures that resets follow a coherent story progression rather than chaotic randomness.|
|- Phoneme of Harvest: Gathers all benefits from erased timelines. Ensures no cultivation progress, insight, or power gained is ever truly lost.|
|- Phoneme of Hunger: Devours the scattered remnants of erased timelines to somewhat fuel future resets. Converts temporal waste into usable energy.|
|- Phoneme of Potential: Realizes possibilities that have not yet become. Allows you to reach outcomes that would otherwise be impossible through normal progression.|
|Because these Phonemes did not exist when The Fallout was designed, the Loop itself is immune to THE Fallout’s interference.|
|LIMITATIONS AND COSTS:|
|MEMORY BURDEN:|
|-Each loop adds the weight of an entire timeline|
|- The weight of all the reversal across Observable Existence must be felt by you|
|- After enough loops, the strain becomes immense|
|- You must maintain your Clarity, Conviction, and Completeness to prevent mental degradation|
|- Failure to maintain Way profundity may result in identity fragmentation|
|CAUSALITY BACKLASH:|
|- Major changes to the timeline create "resistance" from Existence itself|
|- The more dramatically you alter events, the harder subsequent alterations become|
|- Some events may be "fixed points" that resist change regardless of loops|
|- Attempting to force change on fixed points may consume multiple infinities|
|ANCHOR DEGRADATION:|
|- Anchor Points slowly degrade over extended periods|
|- They must be periodically reinforced with fresh infinities|
|- Losing an Anchor Point means losing the ability to reset to that moment|
|- If all Anchors degrade, the Loop becomes temporarily unusable until new Anchors are established|
|THE PARADOX ACCUMULATION:|
|- Each loop creates subtle paradoxes in the fabric of Existence|
|- Too many loops in quick succession can destabilize local reality|
|-THE Living Paradox, as the embodiment of contradiction, may be able to sense or exploit these paradoxes|

|THE Creature, THE Living Temporal, THE Primordial Chaos, and others of similar power may be able to sense these reversals and retain some memories of the future while understanding that someone is rewinding Observable Existence.|
|- Excessive paradox accumulation may attract unwanted attention from powerful entities|
|Against you, death is not defeat. Death is reconnaissance.|
|This is THE Existential Paradox Loop.|
|This is why THE Absolute Mutant will never truly fall. This was the best possible solution your Existence deemed viable based on what it sensed came with THE Fallout.|
Noah’s gaze was cold and imperious as he looked at all of this information of the emergence of a mutation.
This was the best possible solution that his Existence deemed viable based on what it sensed came withTHE Fallout.Basically...his existence thought it may not be able to survive.
So it gave way to the emergence of something that said hey...you may and will likely die, but...not really.
This was the answer toTHE Existential Ceiling.
THE Living Paradox had sought to limit all of Existence with THE Existential Ceiling.
And in doing so, he had given Noah the power to transcend limitation entirely!

sentences.text: Existence was a struggle and Existence was unfair.
Noah knew this very well by this point as he did not need anybody to tell him otherwise.

The emergence of an unfathomable anomalous factor, the emergence of this mutation within his existence as a causality, as an effect ofTHE Fallout, felt like an answer given by his existence against all of this unfairness.
As he was receiving its scope of information, he was realizing the immensity and ridiculousness of it.
At this moment, he allowed everything to be put together as his focus was placed onTHE Infiniverse.
The light of The Fallout that was backed by unknown Axioms of Observable Existence had proceeded to touch everything.
The curse ofTHE Existential Ceilingpermeated across every single lifeform in Observable Existence.
Well, apart from those sheltered in the safety and cozy allure ofTHE Loom.
That was the design and inherent nature ofTHE Fallout.

So at this moment, his expression was heavy as when he looked into THEInfiniverse, he saw the figure of his Mother with the marks of the cursed permeating on her body as she raised her hand and saw the faint cracks on them.
He looked at his people as he saw these faint cracks on their bodies, as if they were told from this point on, they would always be lesser.
Mutated.
That their path across Existence would forever have a ceiling as they could never cross a certain Depth.
Alongside this, some of those within his Civilization had their existence imperceptibly vibrating as they underwent different types of mutations.
The Fallout was far too pervasive as their Civilization answered to it and tried to adapt to it by undergoing glorious evolution.
They tried to be like him.
Whatever the resultant effects were going to be, it would be much less than what he achieved.
But it was still something.

Noah looked at the raging Fallout all around him and roared with immensity, his sound waves mixing with the continuously blooming mushroom clouds as if he was roaring out his defiance toward Existence and the very Fallout itself for what it imposed.
"OOOH!"
The roar carried the weight of a being who refused to accept limitation.
It carried the fury of someone watching his loved ones be branded with a curse they did not deserve.
It carried the defiance ofTHE Anomalywho would not bow to anyone’s design.
And as his own existence continued to change...
|The First Phase of THE Fallout is ending.|
|The Second Phase is beginning.|
Motherfucker, what?
|This information is being drawn by the emergence of your Core Phonemes of The First Tongue that are not accounted for by THE Fallout.|
|It is now known and understood thatTHE Falloutis irreversibly altering Existence, Paradox, Chaos, and The First Tongue in phases and sequences absolutely.|
|Your Core Phonemes, your additions to The First Tongue, will be the only things that remain unaffected.|
|The Second Phase of The Fallout involves:|
|- Endless expansion of all zones|
|- Corruption of fundamental existential relationships|
|- Displacement of Existence to forge the landscape of Existence after The Fallout|
|In that landscape:|
|- Distance is meaningless yet impassable|
|- Communication is impossible through any normal Weavings of Existence|
|- Sound is the only thing that can travel|
|- Mental connections will be severed|
|- Thoughts cannot be sent across distances|
|-Perception and awareness will be limited to a few miles even for THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities|
|All Weavings of Existence will be compressed to a singular existence.|
|Even clones of an entity will be returned to the main body.|
|EXCEPTION DETECTED:|
|The defiance of your existence and the unaltered Phonemes of your First Tongue bypass this limitation.|
|At most, you are capable of supporting the emergence and maintenance of two or three bodies.|
|WARNING:|
|If another body remains outside in the landscape of The Fallout as the Second Phase unfolds:|
|- All of your existence could be focused on it|
|- Your connection toTHE Infiniversecould be severed or masked|
|- You would not be able to find your way back to it|
|- Teleportation will not be possible|
|- Even quantum movement across distances will not be possible|
|It is advised to return to THE Infiniverse as the Second Phase of The Fallout unfolds and irreversibly changes all of Existence.|
The words were heavy.
Noah’s eyes burned with defiance as he felt like he had won and also lost.
He looked down across the ever-changing landscape ofTHE Falloutas he felt an imminent countdown that would stop absolutely everything.
And he disappeared.
He returned toTHE Infiniverse, into his Early Veiled Shore.
The vibrating and the shaking of Existence had stopped as if it was known that imminent destruction had now been weathered and survived.
He stepped on the golden sands and looked at his people whose existence seemed to be undergoing their own imperceptible changes.
And they looked back at him.
A king looked at his family.
An emperor looked at his people.
At this moment, Noah looked like something that had transcended humanity entirely.
His body radiated a terrifying, regal, and majestic allure of power.
He was adorned in that blue-gold robe shining with his Way and filled with Phonemes of The First Tongue, now adding an additional nine that pulsed with unprecedented authority.

The cracks of the curse spread across his skin like fractured porcelain, but colorless tendrils of Quintessence now flowed through them, weaving between the damage like threads of pure essence refusing to accept the brokenness.
And his eyes.
His eyes had changed most of all.
His pupils now held an image of an endlessly recursive infinite loop, spiraling inward and outward simultaneously.
It was hypnotic and terrifying, a visual representation of the mutation that now defined his existence.
Looking into those eyes was like staring into a type of Infinity itself.
He looked like a grand ancient primordial emperor instead of a human being.
When he looked at his people, thinking of how he may have failed them, thinking of how they now bore cracks that would never fully heal...
His mother appeared beside him with a smile.
The cracks over her skin were faint but there, glowing with that residual Fallout energy that marked all the cursed.
And yet she smiled as if none of it mattered.
"It seems like the hard part is over," Ameliasaid with serenity that only a mother could possess in such circumstances.
"Let us now be together as we watch the unfolding end of Existence, shall we?"
The words were serene as they implied success.
Noah’s existence burned as he looked at his Mother and his people.
The defiance in his eyes became even more pronounced as barring everything else, they had survived the First Phase of THE Fallout that was focused on lifeforms.
They could now wait to see just what immense and unfathomable Weavings of Existence unfold as the Second Phase ofTHE Fallouttargeted all of Existence itself.

He looked at his people, at Sigrid and Khor, at Riya and Adelaide, at his Mother and Henry, at Titano and The Emperor Penguin, at Hyperion and The Great Beyonder, at Moiraine and Barbatos, at all those who had placed their faith in him.
Even the cockroach Little Bobby stood in a corner with a cracked bald round head as he held his daughter close.
He looked at all of them as his voice echoed out.
"Whatever limitation The Fallout has imposed upon us will be but temporary," Noahdeclared with a voice that carried the weight of absolute conviction.
"Our Weavings of Existence will see glory.
They will see Absolute.
This I promise to myself, and to you."
HUUM!
He said such words to his people as Existence pulsed in turn.
The sands of the Early Veiled Shore vibrated as if in agreement, as if the very foundation of his Civilization acknowledged the promise being made.
And he said this without boasting.
Because the details of his emerging anomalous factor became abundantly clear in his mind.
|THE EXISTENTIAL PARADOX LOOP - FULL DOCUMENTATION|
|Classification: Singular Mutation|
|Only one instance can exist in Observable Existence.|
|Status: Emerging within your existence.|
|Designation: THE Absolute Mutant.|
|CORE FUNCTION:|
|You can reset your existence to any previously experienced moment while retaining all memories, knowledge, and cultivation progress from the "future" timeline.|
|THE Existential Paradox Loopoperates on principles that bend the very nature of causality.|

|- You can designate specific moments as "Anchor Points" in your existence|
|- These Anchors are moments of significance that your Infinite Mana and your Way infuse with permanence|
|- You can have 9 Anchors active simultaneously across your timeline|
|- Each Anchor requires the infusion of an infinity to establish and maintain|
|- Current Anchors: 0/9|

|-Upon sensing the potential collapse of your Way and Civilization, or upon voluntary activation, your existence resets to the most recent Anchor Point|

|- Knowledge of enemy capabilities, future events, and strategic information persists across resets|

|- Without sufficient infinities infused into the Loop, it fails entirely|

Ensures the mechanism never runs out of fuel as long as your Mana remains infinite.|

Ensures no external force can interfere with or prevent a reset once initiated.|
|- Phoneme of Fortune: Influences the outcome of resets toward beneficial results.
Increases the likelihood that knowledge gained will lead to favorable outcomes.|
|- Phoneme of Advantage: Identifies loopholes and exploitable patterns across timelines.
Allows you to recognize opportunities that others would miss.|
|- Phoneme of Narrative: Shapes the flow of events to favor the protagonist’s journey.
Ensures that resets follow a coherent story progression rather than chaotic randomness.|
|- Phoneme of Harvest: Gathers all benefits from erased timelines.
Ensures no cultivation progress, insight, or power gained is ever truly lost.|
|- Phoneme of Hunger: Devours the scattered remnants of erased timelines to somewhat fuel future resets.
Converts temporal waste into usable energy.|
|- Phoneme of Potential: Realizes possibilities that have not yet become.
Allows you to reach outcomes that would otherwise be impossible through normal progression.|
|Because these Phonemes did not exist when The Fallout was designed, the Loop itself is immune to THE Fallout’s interference.|
|LIMITATIONS AND COSTS:|
|MEMORY BURDEN:|
|-Each loop adds the weight of an entire timeline|
|- The weight of all the reversal across Observable Existence must be felt by you|
|- After enough loops, the strain becomes immense|
|- You must maintain your Clarity, Conviction, and Completeness to prevent mental degradation|
|- Failure to maintain Way profundity may result in identity fragmentation|
|CAUSALITY BACKLASH:|
|- Major changes to the timeline create "resistance" from Existence itself|
|- The more dramatically you alter events, the harder subsequent alterations become|
|- Some events may be "fixed points" that resist change regardless of loops|
|- Attempting to force change on fixed points may consume multiple infinities|
|ANCHOR DEGRADATION:|
|- Anchor Points slowly degrade over extended periods|
|- They must be periodically reinforced with fresh infinities|
|- Losing an Anchor Point means losing the ability to reset to that moment|
|- If all Anchors degrade, the Loop becomes temporarily unusable until new Anchors are established|
|THE PARADOX ACCUMULATION:|
|- Each loop creates subtle paradoxes in the fabric of Existence|

Death is reconnaissance.|

This was the best possible solution your Existence deemed viable based on what it sensed came with THE Fallout.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4686: The Cursed And The Blessed I
paragraphs: THE Existential Paradox Loop.
The sheer incredulity of this alone was unfathomable as Noah looked at it whileTHE Falloutcontinued to unfold in its second phase.
It was also a double-edged sword as it looked ridiculously overpowered at first glance. The capability of a do-over, basically. A reset if and when things went wrong.

But if it ever did come to it, while yes, he would keep all his memories of what happened and even retain his power, beings likeTHE Living Paradox, THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and especially THE Living Temporal would sense that a reversal had occurred. And they would retain a portion of their memories.

It was basically a boon exclusive for him where he gained tremendous benefits, but truly powerful beings would number one, know that someone was doing something so crazy, and they would also benefit by knowing fractions of events of the future.
Overpowered, yes, but with its own heavy costs and results.
Either way...
"It is a start."
He sighed as he motioned to his people. Among them, he smiled toward the Bard of Quintessence in his radiant simian visage filled with white-gold hair.
It was the end of the world. The end of Existence. With them surviving it and at the cost they paid for it...

"Let us have music and a feast to commemorate the survival of the end that hung like a blade for so long over us," Noahdeclared with a voice that carried across the golden sands. "Let us have a festival. THE Festival of... The End."
HUUM!
His words were ridiculous, but what were they to do? Sit around sulking and sad? He controlled his own Weavings as he would rather do something else entirely.
And so the Bard of Quintessence smiled and floated over.

The markers of the cursed were visible on his simian form, faint cracks glowing with residual Fallout energy that traced along his golden fur like rivers of ash. His luminescence had dimmed ever so slightly, and there was an almost imperceptible tremor in his existence when he moved. But his smile remained brilliant and defiant as an illusory gold guitar appeared in his hands, and a melody began to resound across the Early Veiled Shore.
Behind Noah, the massiveTHE Cooking Stanchion of Infinitymanifested in all its culinary glory, a pillar of gastronomic authority that pulsed with blue-gold light and the promise of impossible dishes.

He looked at it and said with determination, "Today, I shall cook the very residual authority of THE Fallout and Primus Mana into food for consumption. We shall not wallow, so let us enjoy. Give a middle finger to THE Living Paradox and his machinations."
OOOH!

His people roared out with fervor even amidst a rotating and ongoing apocalypse swirling outsideTHE Infiniverse. A moment later, the flipper of an Emperor Penguin that held markers of the curse raised up in earnest confusion as he called out, "But Master, I don’t have a middle finger to give!"
Noah turned toward The Emperor Penguin with a sharp gaze, and this penguin put its flipper down fearfully as the melody of the Bard of Quintessence began to permeate outward.

As it did, as THE Festival of The End was kicked off, a symphony bloomed from within Noah himself. His Stanchions of Infinity pulsed as another melody began to spread across THE Infiniverse, weaving together with the Bard’s guitar into something hauntingly beautiful.
A voice emerged, feminine and aching, carried by the Phonemes of Narrative and Quintessence:
"We built our homes on borrowed time,
And called the wreckage yours and mine.
The cracks are showing, can’t you see?
But broken’s where we’re meant to be.
Hold on, hold on, don’t let me go,
Through the fire and the afterglow.
We’re all just strangers passing through,
But strangers, darling, can be true.
The ending came, we watched it fall,
And found we’re standing after all.
So raise a glass to what we’ve lost,
We paid the price, we know the cost.
Hold on, hold on, the night is long,
But we’ll keep singing our broken song.
When morning comes, if morning comes,
We’ll still be here, we’ll still be one.
They said the world would burn away,
And here we are at break of day.
With scars that glow and hearts that ache,
But still alive, for our own sake.
So hold on, hold on, through the pain,
We’ll find our way back home again.
The end has come and the end has gone,
And somehow, somehow... we live on."

The symphony echoed across THE Infiniverse as the somber melody touched every soul within its bounds. Those with the markers of the cursed felt their cracks pulse gently with the music, not with pain but with acknowledgment. With belonging.

As the symphony and words echoed out, Noah began cooking Mana and the residual energy of THE Fallout into physical foods. The blue-gold flames of his culinary authority danced as he worked, transmuting apocalyptic devastation into sustenance that would nourish both body and soul.
While his hands moved with practiced efficiency, he said silently through his connection with Ruination, ’Set up the first Anchor Point.’

|I’ve already begun preparing it, Master. The fuel for the Anchor has to be Infinities woven with Logos and Philologies of your 9 new Core Phonemes to function. Without sufficient infinities infused into the Loop, it fails entirely. So we have to form brand new Logos and Philologies as it may take some time.|

Ruination said such words to him as he nodded before he replied, ’Integrate Quintessence or Infinity into currently existing Philologies we have. Undifferentiated Mana and Cheating Architect would be easy, and their capabilities would also be enhanced. This will be faster for us to get an Anchor Point set up as soon as possible.’
|Understood, Master.|
Ruination got started on a glorious process as while Noah oversaw the start of a feast, he kept his gaze on the unfolding second phase of THE Fallout as it was heavy.

Existence seemed like it was being ground down, spat up, and changed tremendously as the information he obtained through the establishment of the 9 new Core Phonemes of The First Tongue were beginning to unfold.
He couldn’t see past one mile outside THE Infiniverse.
And as the symphony and melody of his festival came out of THE Infiniverse and flowed outside toward the regions under the effects of THE Fallout...
BZZT!
His symphony and melody shockingly fizzled outside as if Existence told it, "Get that shit out of here!"
Communication would not be possible.
Mental connections would not be possible.
Teleportation would not be possible.

He had hoped that he would be able to reunite with Lumivara and Ul’Moreth and others after THE Fallout to truly reap the rewards, but he wouldn’t even be able to sense them or try to send a message to them through their entanglement.
Man, Riya had been right when she said Mana would be undergoing lots of adversity.
The aftermath of THE Fallout would not make things easy!
As he thought about all this, he wondered.
How were Eckert and Alexander faring? How were THE Creature and beings like THE Primordial Chaos faring at a time like this?
And the fuckers insideTHE Loom... what were they getting out of Existence being razed down?
