chapters.title: Chapter 4687: The Cursed And The Blessed II
paragraphs: Inside THE Loom.
While apocalyptic horrors raged outside...
Ambessa uncomfortably pulled on the collar of the obsidian-gold suit she was forced to wear by the forces ofTHE Living Elementalas she moved from one section ofTHE Loomto another.

Around her were a few Pre-THE and False THE entities who were surrounded with vibrant golden lights as shockingly, their Sovereignties were being elevated. They naturally and forcefully had their Depths taken toTHE Surface Depthin a process that should have taken eons but was being accomplished in mere moments.
It truly fucking paid to be inTHE Loomas while it razed down Existence, everything devoured was being swallowed up by it and distributed to a specific few.
But did they really need these ridiculous suits?

Ambessa would rather be wearing her bloomers and something free, not this full body coverage bullshit that constricted her movements and made her feel like a decorated puppet on display. The obsidian-gold fabric clung to every curve and left no room for comfort, designed more for presentation than practicality.
"Can you fucking relax? It is Liberation Day, and we have been chosen."
The words came sharp and cold from ahead of her.

"You’ll be standing in front of THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive soon as they prepare us for the emergence to the outside Existence once THE Fallout is done. We have been chosen. Show that fucking graciousness. You see that Depth of Paradox building inside you? That is eons of work erupting today, and it is not your own. Come on."

The words came from a golden-haired Early Creature burning with a light of Elemental who was looking at Ambessa with cold eyes. ATHE Surface Depth Elemental Early Creaturewho had already been given a high-sounding title that didn’t matter to shit to Ambessa what it was. Something like "Vanguard of the Elemental Emergence" or some equally pompous nonsense.
Ambessa glared back while following as she thought about how she had gotten here.
About how another one of her Avatars had been decimated while she had gone to seek the forces ofNoah Osmont.

And because of that name, because of Osmont, she was chosen among those to receive the bigger boons ofTHE Loom during THE Fallout.She was having her Depth built regardless of how tough it was to go from False THE to actual THE.
All because of the little connection she had with Osmont.

Frankly, couldn’t they leave him alone? He was probably dead fromTHE Falloutanyways. The flames that were consuming Existence outside were not something that could be easily survived, and from what she last saw as her Avatar fully perished, Osmont had been outside when it all began.
Why did THE Living Elemental have such a grudge against him to be forming a task force of THEs that would be looking for Osmont after THE Fallout?
It seemed excessive. It seemed obsessive. It seemed like a waste of resources that could be better spent elsewhere.
But no one asked for her opinion, and she was smart enough not to offer it.

Ahead of her, the chirpy Elemental Early Creature smiled as they entered a domain filled with rivers of fire and water mixing beautifully. The elements intertwined in impossible harmony, flames dancing with currents and steam rising in artistic spirals that painted the air with prismatic light.

"Soon, we will meet with THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive themselves," the golden-haired creature announced with barely contained excitement. "They will give us our directives for how to move outside THE Loom for the first time into an Existence with conditions that will not be habitable for most. We are the explorers of a changed Existence from this Shelter of THE Loom. We are the pioneers who will chart the new landscape while others cower and hide."
Her eyes blazed with fervor.

"The outside Existence has been fundamentally altered. Distance means nothing and everything simultaneously. Communication through normal means is impossible. Perception is limited even for those at THE Fundamental Depth. It is a hostile, broken landscape that will swallow the unprepared whole."
She turned to face the group with a smile that held both pride and anticipation.

"But we have been given the tools to survive it. We have been given the authority to thrive in it. We are uncursed. We bear no Existential Ceiling. While every other being in Observable Existence has been branded with limitation, we emerge from THE Loom as the elite. As the chosen. As the inheritors of whatever remains."
Her voice rose with passion.

"We will see glory! We will claim territories that others cannot even perceive! We will establish the dominion of THE Loom across the shattered remnants of Observable Existence! This is Liberation Day, and we are the liberated! Rejoice!"
Ambessa frowned at the words and sighed internally.
Right.

It was Liberation Day. THE Fallout. Those within THE Loom gained an interminable amount while the outside Existence burned.And THE Loom had already separated into multiple Shelters that would flow across Existence. When THE Fallout ended, they could observe and explore the changed inhabitable Existence while maintaining their rule from different bastions of protection.
Ambessa knew she was just a cog in the machine, and she was just fuckingtired.

She didn’t want to keep chasing after this Osmont as every time, she kept fucking dying. Why didn’t the rest of them get the hint? Every encounter with that man ended with her Avatars being obliterated, her plans being thwarted, and her existence being put through unnecessary trauma.
But the higher-ups seemed to think her repeated failures made her an expert on the subject. As if dying to someone multiple times qualified you to hunt them down successfully.
The logic escaped her entirely.
But...

Ambessa raised her head and looked up, seeing waves of auroras descending down from the crystalline ceiling of this domain. They wrapped around her and elevated her power with warmth that felt almost nurturing despite its artificial nature. Other waves spread to different parts of THE Loom, reaching chosen individuals across the vast structure.

She could feel her Depth solidifying, the False THE designation she had carried for so long finally giving way to genuine THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty. It was a gift that most beings would kill for, a boon that represented eons of cultivation being compressed into moments.
And yet, all she could think about was the price she would have to pay for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4688: The Cursed And The Blessed III
paragraphs: Moments later, Ambessa found they were arriving at their location as she sensed other entities entering a crystalline bejeweled crimson-blue domain filled with water and fire. The elements here were even more intense, more primal, as if approaching the source of all elemental authority.
Within it, the overpowering aura ofTHE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotivecould be felt pressing down on everyone present.

THE Living Elemental radiated waves of pure elemental might that made the fire and water bow in reverence. Their presence was a mountain made of storms, an ocean made of flames, an existence that had claimed dominion over the fundamental building blocks of reality itself.

AndTHE Living Emotive, that entity pulsed with emotions so vast and contradictory that merely being near them made Ambessa want to laugh and cry and scream all at once. Joy and sorrow, rage and peace, love and hatred, all swirling together in a maelstrom of feeling that threatened to overwhelm anyone without sufficient mental fortitude.
Ambessa sighed while going in as she wanted to get this shit over with.
THE Loomhad erupted as those within it benefitted, and when the dust settled, they would go out from different Shelters to reap the altered Existence.

She just really hoped she wouldn’t come across Osmont again, and even hoped she would stop being included in the hunting teams formed for him just because she was among the first to come in contact with him.
But deep down, she knew better.
Existence had a sick sense of humor.
And somehow, someway, she would probably end up dying to Noah Osmont again.
It was just her fucking luck.
In the depths of that domain where Ambessa and others were being drawn into.

The domain of water and fire stretched endlessly in all directions, a realm where the two opposing elements had been forced into coexistence by the sheer authority ofTHE Living Elemental. Rivers of molten flame cascaded upward while waterfalls of crystalline blue flowed sideways, each element weaving around the other in patterns that should have been impossible but existed nonetheless.

At the very heart of this domain, where the concentration of elemental authority reached its peak, a single massive elemental throne existed. It was forged from solidified fire and frozen water, crimson and azure intertwining in a seat of power that radiated waves of primal might. The throne pulsed with the heartbeat of elements themselves, each pulse sending ripples of fire and water across the surrounding space.

Currently, the languid figure ofTHE Living Emotivewas lying horizontally on this throne in a laid-back manner, her legs dangling over one armrest while her head rested on the other. She looked utterly at ease despite the apocalypse raging outsideTHE Loom, as if the destruction of Observable Existence was merely background noise to whatever tune played inside her mind.

In front of her, THE Living Elementalwas surrounded by blazing crimson flames that danced with fury and frustration. Eighteen Phonemes of The First Tongue surrounded him in a rotating formation, each one flickering with instability that had not been there beforeTHE Falloutbegan.
His gaze was fiery and troubled at this time as he spoke with barely contained agitation.

"Are you really so carefree?" he demanded. "The First Tongue no longer feels the same, and this is not a result of THE Fallout. Something has changed at its fundamental level. Something has been added that should not exist."
His words went to Emotive who seemed to barely be listening as she whistled and hummed to herself, her fingers tracing lazy patterns in the air.
"THE Loom has bloomed and existence will spin,
The fun begins where the chaos sets in,
Round and round the pieces will go,
Where they land, only Paradox knows..."
As she finished this little melody, Elemental looked at her with an almost angry gaze. Before he could say anything, she cut him off with a dismissive wave.

"Don’t fucking worry so much, big guy,"Emotive said with a yawn. "The fun is just now beginning. Paradox has so much work to do that he designed THE Loom into different components that would scatter across Existence. You and I are in one Shelter. Which, you should be fucking ecstatic about as you get to have my presence here. But as the dust settles, we can really get to have our fun. Because I know some things..."
Oh?
Elemental raised his brows as he focused on her, his flames calming slightly with curiosity.

Emotive smiled devilishly as she waved her hand and conjured an illusory image that materialized between them. It was the image ofNoah Osmont, rendered in perfect detail with his blue-gold authority radiating even through the illusion.
The image that Elemental flared up to immediately.
This was the one who had encroached upon his Civilization. This was the one who had humiliated him. This was the one who had taken what was his.

"This big guy here is apparently centermost for all you guys," Emotive said with manic delight, sitting up slightly to better observe Elemental’s reaction. "You want him, Paradox wants him, even THE Primordial Chaos talked about him. Apparently, he is the one to have laid a claim to The First Tongue. So it makes sense what he was able to do against you. But man, look at him."
She leaned forward, her eyes gleaming with something between fascination and hunger.
"He looks like he has that presence, doesn’t he? That je ne sais quoi. He almost reminds me of...THE Creature."
Her words were manic and taunting as she gazed toward the image of Noah in a fervent light. Elemental frowned heavily, his flames darkening with barely suppressed rage.

He looked over at Noah’s illusory figure silently, studying the entity who had become such a thorn in his existence. Meanwhile, Emotive twirled around the throne casually before she sighed with theatrical disappointment.

"Out of all those that have made the claim on The Oldest Paradox of Existence, he is the youngest,"she mused. "The most ripe. If I can get my hands on him and keep him away from Paradox and others, that would be ideal."
Elemental’s reply came cold and absolute.

"The only fate for him is collapse," he declared, his voice carrying the weight of elemental authority. "All the others will go for him, and after THE Fallout settles, I will also go for him. I do not underestimate any of those making a claim on The Oldest Paradox of Existence. If one has begun to encroach on my Civilization, even more so. He took from me. He will return what he took with interest, and then he will cease to exist."

chapters.title: Chapter 4689: The Cursed And The Blessed IV
paragraphs: Emotive laughed, the sound echoing across the domain like wind chimes made of broken glass.

"Good luck finding him in the Wastes of THE Fallout,"she said with genuine amusement."You and others really don’t know how it’s truly going to be out there. But no, you can do whatever you want, and I will do whatever I want."
She pointed at Noah’s illusory image with possessive intensity.

"For this guy, he laid the claim on The First Tongue, so I shall lay a claim on him. I’ve always wanted to raise a dog. THE Creature and others are too big as they would eat me up, but this Osmont..."
Her eyes widened with manic desire.
"Ahh, I want him. I want him!"
Her eyes radiated a manic light as she said this, and in the next moment, she waved her hand to pull out something that made the entire domain tremble!
A teardrop.

A single crystalline teardrop that emanated wild power so profound that even the elements themselves seemed to bow before it. The moment it appeared, Elemental showed a shocked expression as he pointed a finger at it.
"How did you get that?!"
His voice cracked with disbelief, his composure shattering for just an instant.
Emotive looked over calmly, rolling the teardrop between her fingers with casual indifference.

"Oh relax, it’s just a Fragment of an Axiom,"she said dismissively. "See, this is why you can’t be like THE Creature and Paradox, and even this Osmont. Where is your fucking composure? Your je ne sais quoi? You don’t make me feel a thing because of how you act, man. It’s abysmal."
She held up the Fragment, letting its light play across her features.

"But no, I told you I have a plan, and it involves this. Navigating the Wastelands, the Corrupted Existence after THE Fallout, will be impossible through normal means. But Axioms will make many things possible. This is something I can use to track what makes my heart flutter."
Her smile turned sharp.
"And I know it’s not fucking you, so at this time it will be Osmont. I do hope it doesn’t lead me to THE Creature as he will likely rip me apart right then and there... ah."
Her manic light became even grander as a darkened, cloudy expression settled on Elemental’s face after her words.

She seemed to be very set on playing with the emotions of others and making them feel lesser. It was her Way, after all.THE Living Emotiveexisted to evoke and manipulate feelings, and she wielded that power even against her supposed allies.
Elemental spoke with a voice that rumbled like tectonic plates grinding against each other.

"You can continue trying to crush my will by comparisons, but it is ultimately a waste of time," he declared with cold certainty. "My Way is firm. Games of manipulation will not work on me. I do not compare myself to THE Creature or any others as I have my own immensity. I am THE Living Elemental. I am the authority over Phonemes of Fire and Water and Earth and Air and everything in between. Your words are wind against my mountain."

Emotive rose up and actually sat properly on the elemental throne, crossing her legs as she twirled the Fragment of an Axiom in her hands. She looked over at Elemental with an expression that held pity and contempt in equal measure.
"You are one of the beings I least respect,"she said with brutal honesty. "You had so much potential, so many possibilities, and look at you. Stuck. Stagnant. Mediocre despite your Depth."
She leaned forward, her eyes boring into him.
"If you want to prove me wrong, I will actually bring you with me when I find Osmont. I will. And do you know what I think will happen?"
Her smile turned cruel.

"Somehow, he will be standing right there before you, and you still won’t be able to achieve what you want. You see, that is just how it is for some beings in Existence. They do everything, but never amount to much."
She sighed wistfully.

"THE Creature, oh, he amounts to much. I miss him even now. Paradox? He’s up there. This Osmont? He fucking laid a claim on The First Tongue that nobody has been able to do, so I’m sure he’s up there."
Her eyes met Elemental’s with piercing intensity.

"I will literally put him in front of you, and you likely still won’t get what you want. It’s like you’re so bad that Existence itself doesn’t want you winning. So after you fail, I will then make my move. How does that sound, big guy?"

Her words were truly poisonous and detestable to hear, but her eyes held a terrifying light that very few understood. She was not merely taunting him. She was speaking what she believed to be absolute truth. In her eyes, Elemental was simply not destined for greatness, and no amount of effort would change that fundamental reality.

Elemental looked at her coldly in an imposing demeanor, his flames condensing around him like armor made of pure destruction. The Phonemes of The First Tongue surrounding him blazed brighter as if responding to his fury.
Moments later, Emotive showed a bored expression as she lay back on the elemental throne, her body language dismissing everything he was projecting.

"Eeh, even your imposing glare doesn’t get me excited," she complained with theatrical disappointment. "Man, I can’t wait to track down Osmont. Maybe he will make me feel something, unlike being near a black hole of boring Weavings like you."
She closed her eyes, the Fragment of an Axiom still dancing between her fingers.
"Just wait for the second phase of THE Fallout to finish. Then the real fun begins. Then I get to see if this Osmont lives up to the hype. And you?"
She cracked one eye open to look at him.
"You get to watch and fail. As usual."
The domain of water and fire trembled with Elemental’s suppressed rage, but he said nothing more.
OutsideTHE Loom, THE Falloutcontinued its second phase, reshaping Observable Existence into something unrecognizable.
And inside, two ancient powers waited with very different anticipations.
One waited to destroy.
One waited to claim.
And somewhere out there, completely unaware of the attention being directed at him, Noah Osmontwas hosting a festival to celebrate surviving the end of Existence!

Moments later, Emotive showed a bored expression as she lay back on the elemental throne, her body language dismissing everything he was projecting.
"Eeh, even your imposing glare doesn’t get me excited," she complained with theatrical disappointment.
"Man, I can’t wait to track down Osmont.
Maybe he will make me feel something, unlike being near a black hole of boring Weavings like you."
She closed her eyes, the Fragment of an Axiom still dancing between her fingers.
"Just wait for the second phase of THE Fallout to finish.
Then the real fun begins.
Then I get to see if this Osmont lives up to the hype.
And you?"
She cracked one eye open to look at him.
"You get to watch and fail.
As usual."
The domain of water and fire trembled with Elemental’s suppressed rage, but he said nothing more.
OutsideTHE Loom, THE Falloutcontinued its second phase, reshaping Observable Existence into something unrecognizable.
And inside, two ancient powers waited with very different anticipations.
One waited to destroy.
One waited to claim.
And somewhere out there, completely unaware of the attention being directed at him, Noah Osmontwas hosting a festival to celebrate surviving the end of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4690: The Cursed And The Blessed V
paragraphs: In Existence, there would always be the rich and the poor, the sad and the happy, and the blessed and the cursed.
THE Fallout made very clear distinctions of which was which.
But as THE Fallout unfolded, there were some beings who had the power to choose for themselves whether they would be cursed or blessed.

In a far, indeterminate corner of Observable Existence burning and twisting under the light of THE Fallout, a humanoid entity floated grandly while waves of multicolored flames and ash passed through everything around him.

This entity was covered with undulating obsidian tendrils of chaos that writhed across his form like living shadows hungry for disorder. His sheer aura alone shockingly kept the flames of The Fallout at bay, creating an invisible field around his existence that the apocalyptic destruction could not penetrate without permission.
And he did grant permission routinely.

He would open up a singularity in the invisible field that he had around him, a small gap that allowed concentrated Weavings of The Fallout to flow through and permeate into his existence. Each time, the multicolored flames would rush in eagerly, only to be devoured by the obsidian tendrils and converted into something else entirely. He was not merely surviving The Fallout. He was consuming it. Digesting it. Making it part of his Chaos.

Around his existence, one could see an indeterminate amount of Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue floating in complex orbits. What looked to be more than eighteen Genesis Principles rotated around him like children listening to his beck and call, responding to his every whim with eager obedience.
But uniquely, there were even three types of authorities that even the Genesis Principles seemed to actively avoid.
Three points of power so profound, so ancient, so terrifying that even the fundamental truths of The First Tongue gave them wide berth.

Such a being was humming freely in the midst of The Fallout as he looked around with his gaze piercing many things, even though he realized it was gradually becoming limited by the changing Weavings of Existence.
At such a point, he opened his mouth as seas of Primordial Chaos spilled out naturally with his words.
"Eenie meenie miny moe, where exactly shall I go?"
As if he was looking for direction in the midst of universal devastation.
He sighed, the sound carrying the weight of eons of accumulated experience and the lightness of someone who found cosmic destruction mildly entertaining.

"Observable Existence had only been explored and mapped out by less than half of what it truly contains," he mused to himself, his voice resonating with the authority ofTHE Primordial Chaos. "All of us know that other Pockets of Existence like Ginnungagap exist but remain unable to be accessed through normal means. We know of regions that predate differentiation itself. We know of spaces between spaces where even I have not ventured."
His obsidian tendrils writhed with amusement.

"We know all of this, and yet you proceed to change all of Observable Existence while we still know there is much we don’t know? All those unknowns, all those unexplored territories, all those sleeping powers in hidden corners of reality, how will they be affected by your little tantrum, Paradox?"
He laughed, the sound causing nearby flames of The Fallout to scatter in confusion.

"What will arise from them? What ancient things will be awakened? What new horrors will be born from the collision of your Fallout and the unknown? Haha, so much Chaos to unfold. So much to witness! You may have designed this cataclysm, but you cannot possibly have accounted for everything. Nobody can account for everything. That is why Chaos always wins in the end."

At such a time, he laughed freely and looked around him as if he could see something that others could not. His gaze pierced through the layers of burning reality, through the Weavings of The Fallout, through the very fabric of Existence itself.
In the next moment, he spoke to the devastation around him.

"O Creature, you should be free enough right now to at least hear me and communicate before everything becomes much harder. The Fallout is targeting you, yes, but it is also weakening the chains that bind you. So tell me, old friend, old enemy, old enigma, how do you think all of this will end?"
He asked the burning Existence around him.
As if he expected an answer.
As if someone could hear him across the vastness of collapsing reality.
And shockingly, in the next moment, Existence trembled and buzzed fearfully as an extremely deep and imposing voice responded from everywhere and nowhere simultaneously.
"Badly."
HUUM!
Oh!
That voice!

It was filled with calmness so absolute that it made the chaos of The Fallout seem like a child’s tantrum. It carried an immensity that pressed down on reality itself, making evenTHE Primordial Chaosfeel the weight of something truly ancient. It was the voice of the being who had shaped Observable Existence, who had created the foundations upon which all civilizations were built, who had been imprisoned for eons but never truly defeated.
And as if it did not get its point across enough, it echoed out once more forTHE Primordial Chaosto hear.
"Very, very badly."
THE Primordial Chaoslaughed loudly at these words, the sound erupting from him like a symphony of disorder that made the surrounding Fallout flames dance in chaotic patterns.

His eyes opened wide, showing obsidian blackness all around. Within that darkness, infinite obsidian snakes constantly twisted and coiled, each one a fragment of primordial entropy given form. They burned with glory that predated the differentiation of Existence itself.

"You let Paradox reign on top for so long that many of us missed you," THE Primordial Chaossaid with genuine warmth beneath his chaotic exterior. "Your absence left a void that none of us could properly fill. But do tell, O Creature, have you grasped The Second Scale of Existence without telling the rest of us? Are you there yet?"
Was he there yet.
It was a terrifying question to ask.
The Second Scale of Existence.
Beyond THE Absolute Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
Beyond anything that currently existed in Observable Existence.
The level that THE Living Paradox sought to reach through The Fallout.
The level that would allow an entity to not justlegislatereality but to become indistinguishable from it.
The reply fromTHE Creaturecame with maddening ambiguity.
"Who knows... who knows..."
BOOM!

The words carried neither confirmation nor denial, only the weight of something that preferred to remain mysterious.THE Creaturehad always been an enigma, even to those who had existed alongside him since the earliest moments of Observable Existence.
THE Primordial Chaossmiled at the non-answer, his obsidian snakes hissing with appreciation for the chaos of uncertainty.

"Same as always," he muttered fondly. "Never giving a straight answer. Never letting anyone know exactly where you stand. I suppose that is how you survived this long, O Creature. By being unknowable even to those who thought they knew you."
The burning Existence around him offered no further response.
THE Creaturehad spoken his piece.
And now, THE Primordial Chaoswas left to navigate The Fallout alone, choosing his direction in a landscape that was rapidly becoming unrecognizable.
"Eenie meenie miny moe," he repeated with a grin."I suppose I’ll just follow the Chaos. It has never led me astray before."
He opened another singularity in his protective field, allowing more of The Fallout to rush in and be consumed by his endless hunger for disorder!

chapters.title: Chapter 4691: The Emerged I
paragraphs: Inside a Shelter of THE Loom.

A domain of cylindrical tall mountain-like pillars stretched endlessly in all directions, each one rising toward a ceiling that did not exist. Multicolored rivers of clouds flowed between these pillars like lazy serpents, carrying whispers of power that had been accumulated over eons of careful planning.

On one tall pillar, immense waves of authority were flowing into a single entity. His hair currently shone stellar gold with unfathomably radiant multicolored pupils that seemed to contain folds within their depths. His stature was that of a human, yet he felt like a giant whose presence alone could crush lesser beings into oblivion.
Near him were three shrouded female figures that were none other thanTHE Weavers.

Their faces could not be discernible as they looked like black holes that would devour everything, pulling in light and perception alike until nothing remained but the void of their presence. Their bodies seemed to be channeling a unique power throughTHE Loomand into the titan of a man before them.
He was none other thanGilgamesh.
A Leader among Leaders.
A glorious entity that had thrown his Curiosity all the way from the Earliest Folds to attack Noah in the current era. A being whose ambition stretched across time itself!

And at this moment, an air ofTHE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereigntysurged around him. His gaze was deep and filled with an unfathomable light that spoke of power recently gained and power yet to be fully understood. The authority flowing into him was settling into his existence like water finding its level, reshaping him from within.

"You hold the most potent Weavings of THE Creature as Paradox has raised you to THE Fundamental Depth," THE Weaversspoke in unison, their voices overlapping in a way that made it impossible to distinguish one from another. "How does it feel?"
Gilgamesh’s multicolored pupils flickered as he considered the question.
"It feels like I am being controlled," he replied with cold honesty. "And I don’t particularly like that."
THE Weaverslaughed, the sound ancient and knowing, as if they had heard such complaints countless times across the eons.

"Understandable," they said together. "But Existence is a game of give and take. We give you what you want, and you do something for us in turn. This arrangement has existed since before THE Loom was conceived. You are not the first to chafe at it, and you will not be the last."
Their shrouded forms shifted slightly, black hole faces turning toward him with what might have been amusement.
"This time around, the mission placed on you will be this man."

THE Weaverswaved their hands in unison, and an illusory image materialized between them. It wasNoah Osmont, rendered in perfect detail with his blue-gold authority radiating even through the projection.

Gilgamesh looked at the image calmly, his expression betraying nothing of his thoughts. He studied every detail with the patience of someone who had existed since the Earliest Folds, who had seen empires rise and fall, who knew that rushing to judgment was the mistake of the young.

"He will be hunted by weak things at THE Surface Depth, but THE Esteemed Paradox wanted someone decent to track him,"THE Weaverscontinued. "You and we have this task. The others are distractions, noise, insects buzzing around a flame. We are the true hunters. And you are the one meant to bring this hunt to its conclusion."

When they spoke, the voices ofTHE Weaverscame out simultaneously, three voices becoming one in a manner that was extremely eerie. It was as if they shared a single consciousness split across three bodies, or perhaps three consciousnesses merged into a single will.
And yet toward these words, Gilgamesh remained calm as he asked a simple question.
"Any preference on whether he needs to be brought in alive or collapsed?"
The question was heavy, carrying implications that stretched far beyond its simple phrasing. Bringing Noah in alive would mean one thing. Collapsing him would mean another entirely.
THE Weaverslaughed again, the sound carrying genuine amusement this time.
"If you can fully collapse him, it would mean you stand the chance to lay a claim on The First Tongue,"they said with voices dripping with temptation. "You can give it a go."
The eyes of Gilgamesh pulsed with a terrifying immensity at such words.
The First Tongue.
The language of Existence itself.
If he could collapse the one who had laid claim to it, if he could destroy Noah Osmont utterly and completely, there was a chance, however slim, that he could inherit that claim for himself.
It was a prize worth any risk.
But a moment later, he nodded with the composure of someone who planned thoroughly before acting.
"I will need my Legions of THE Early Creatures,"he stated. "Make sure to tell the big guy to send harvest their way to ensure their Depths are at least at Surface, maybe Intermediate."
Even more terrifying words were uttered.
Legions.

Not a handful of powerful entities. Not a small strike force. Legions of THE Early Creatures, beings from the Earliest Folds who had followed Gilgamesh across eons, all of them elevated to THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty at minimum.
It was an army meant to crush, not to hunt.
Toward this, THE Weaverssmiled behind their black hole faces.
"That much can be done," they affirmed. "THE Esteemed Paradox has resources to spare from THE Fallout’s harvest. Your Legions will be elevated. Your hunt will be properly supported."
Across Existence, many made their preparations asTHE Falloutwas underway.

An interminable light struck out againstTHE Belly of Existence, tearing through barriers that had stood since before recorded history. The attack was relentless, absolute, backed byAxioms of Observable Existencethat made resistance nearly futile.

THE Prison of THE Creaturewas torn open as the many entities within it that he had been siphoning from for eons flooded out into the burning landscape ofTHE Fallout.Ancient powers that had been captive for longer than most civilizations had existed now found themselves free but cursed, blessed with liberation but branded withTHE Existential Ceiling.

Ginnungagap became opened once more as for the first time in eons, Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms would appear in the changing Observable Existence. These twisted beings, born from the chaotic energies of that primordial realm, spilled into an Existence that had almost forgotten they existed.

What used to be the Infinite Unfurling was unlocked as all the Sovereignties within it flared out. Every single one was affected one way or another by the light of THE Fallout, some gaining mutations that would define their future, others simply bearing the curse that limited their advancement forever.
THE Living Paradox officially started his War with THE Creature, and it would not end in an instant.
It would be a long war as the victor was undecided.
Or maybe, the victor was already known, but Existence merely held its breath, waiting to see if fate would unfold as expected or if something unexpected would tip the scales.
As countless wonders unfolded, time passed.

The Second Phase of THE Fallout continued as THE Infiniverse stood strong against the apocalyptic devastation. Its barriers held firm, powered by Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue that were regenerated as fast as they were destroyed.
The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature was surrounded by a unique protective light as it stood strong, sheltering the countless lifeforms that Anaximander had drawn into its sanctuary.

And everything drew toward a conclusion as with the distortion of what THE Fallout was doing to Existence, some areas may have already experienced the passage of years while in others barely a second had passed. Time itself had become inconsistent, unreliable, subject to the whims of the catastrophe that was reshaping all of reality.
But the first shot had been taken.
A belly was spilled open.
A blade had been drawn.
And now, all that waited was to discover just how much blood had spilled, and how much more blood would spill before the dust finally settled!

chapters.title: Chapter 4692: The Emerged II
paragraphs: Others could fail. Others could have doubts. Others could be unsure.
Noah knew with utmost certainty that he was not one of them.

Even though he absolutely did not know how everything would unfold after THE Fallout, he had to approach it with the mindset that regardless of what happened, he would persevere through it and survive.
He truly did not have the choice because for him, failure was critical.
It was why right now, he had set up an Anchor Point.
He looked at the glowing words that detailed exactly how it looked like.
|ANCHOR POINT ESTABLISHED|
|Designation: Anchor Point One - THE Festival of The End|
|Location: Early Veiled Shore within THE Infiniverse|
|Timestamp: 1 hour, 17 minutes after First Phase of THE Fallout concluded|
|Status: Active and stable|
|Infinity Fuel: Fully infused with a few Logos and Philologies including some of the 9 Core Phonemes|
|Reset Capability: Upon sensing potential collapse of Way and Civilization, or upon voluntary activation, existence will reset to this moment|
|Retention: All memories, cultivation progress, and knowledge from erased timeline will be preserved|
|Remaining Anchor Slots: 8/9|
This Anchor Point acted like an assurance that he could go back to in the case that things went wrong.
And with how it emerged and what THE Fallout promised, it was very much foreshadowing that things would be going wrong. He was not looking forward to this.
But again, he could not hold any doubt as he had to always move with quintessential certainty.
And so at this moment, while THE Festival of The End continued all around him, Noah observed his surroundings with contemplative calm.

As he looked at his people whose skins were cracked with the marks of those cursed, destined to never even get nearTHE Absolute Depth, he remained calm. They were currently eating and drinking even while an apocalypse raged all around them.
It was a scene he would protect over and over again if he had to.

He wondered at this time if this Anchor Point that he had set, if he would actually be coming back here sometime in the future. If circumstances would force him to reset, to return to this moment and try again with the knowledge of what went wrong.
He shook his head at the thoughts as he got back to the current situation at hand.
One of the biggest things was his own existence, of course, and the changes that it had undergone in the last hour as THE Fallout raged.
And yes, it had been over an hour now as Existence continued to be altered and changed from the outside.
This single hour allowed him to familiarize himself with the newly forged Core Phonemes that only he owned and had access to.
Which in itself was a crazy reality to ascertain.

He, that weak Rank F Hunter from a blue planet, had nine exclusive Core Phonemes of the language of Existence. There had only been eighteen Core Phonemes initially since Observable Existence differentiated, and he had just added nine more that belonged solely to him.
He had truly come far since throwing fireballs in the back of a dilapidated apartment!

But when he closed his eyes and felt the Phonemes of The First Tongue, it felt like he was ever closer and integrated into The First Tongue itself. As if he held a secret that nobody else knew or had access to. As if he had become part of the very language that structured reality.

Insofar, he had begun with the Phoneme of Quintessence and Infinity to be infused into the Principles of Undifferentiated Mana, Cheating Architect, Perpetual Harvest, and the other Genesis Philologies.
What was unique was watching these Philologies be altered in real time.

After Quintessence and Infinity flowed into them, which only occurred after numerous trials and errors in Creative Mode, he watched as a radiant and different type of authority began to pulse and permeate in what he had known the Philologies to be.

Because simply, a Genesis Principle was something that was comprised of the Core Phonemes of The First Tongue, of which there were eighteen.So when someone else came and began altering by adding new Phonemes into these Philologies, they would not remain the same.
A Genesis Principle was a Genesis Principle.
But what Noah was doing right now was altering and elevating a Genesis Principle by adding brand new letters that had never existed before.

And as he began to run simulations with Ruination under Creative Mode on fusing the remaining Phonemes he just created into his Philologies, the immensity and weight that he was giving off only became more and more intense.

To the extent that the gains of utilizing the pressure and effort of withstanding THE Fallout turned into boundless harvest by the Philology of Perpetual Harvest. The advancements made by the prisoners in his Infinite Desmoterion contributed their share. The Infinite Potential he had continued to allow to flow into his Foundation and Civilization compounded everything further.
It allowed for a tremendous advancement within just the span of an hour.

|- Integrated into: Philology of Undifferentiated Mana (100%), Philology of Perpetual Harvest (100%)...|
|- Effect: All integrated Philologies now carry the essence of "purest truth" making them more resistant to external interference|

|- Effect: Integrated Philologies now possess boundless scaling potential with no theoretical upper limit|

But even this was just the start.
He knew he had to be grander than he was seconds ago, and he had to become stronger at a faster rate than ever before.
Because he could feel that Existence was about to fuck with him more than it ever had before.

The cracks on his skin pulsed with residual Fallout energy, a constant reminder of the curse that had been branded upon him. The colorless tendrils of Quintessence flowing through those cracks offered some comfort, but they did not erase the limitation thatTHE Existential Ceilingrepresented.
He could never reach THE Absolute Depth through normal means.
But who said anything about normal means?
He hadTHE Existential Paradox Loop. He had nine Core Phonemes that did not exist in THE Fallout’s parameters. He had Infinite Mana that rejected limitation by its very nature.
If Existence wanted to fuck with him, he would fuck with Existence right back!

chapters.title: Chapter 4693: The Emerged III
paragraphs: As everything proceeded forward like a churning train that had no stop, Noah continued to allow the help of Ruination in processing and keeping everything in order.
He had so many capabilities to keep track of that he now actually wanted to combine many things and keep a select few singular tracks that he followed.
Being a jack of all trades was nice, but he remembered countless abilities since his time as a hunter to now, and many of them had been forgotten or left behind along the way.

One of the more unique things that were memorable to him apart from the glorious fireballs was Sever. The capability to shoot tendrils of lightning or condensed lines of authority that linked from enemy to enemy and exploded them like popcorn. It had been devastating in its time, a technique that could clear battlefields in moments.
Playing with a swirling undead storm of bones and death, which he left behind to the Arch Lich, had also been something that defined an era of his growth.

The thought of the Lich reminded him as he looked over to Ra’Zan, and he saw this unique existence under him already flowing with multiple Phonemes of The First Tongue.THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywould be wrapping around him within the next few minutes, transforming the ancient undead into something that transcended his previous limitations.
But yes, he had many capabilities, and he even had 159 of THE Stanchions of Infinity. Yet he mainly utilized a select few that took center stage in his battles and cultivation.

He had the ideal and goal to streamline and combine many things into his emerging Foundation, into pillars that would actively be helping him survive the environment of THE Fallout. Into increasing his weight and immensity, and into elevating his Way. It was also why Mana Supremacy, Arcana Infinitum, and Primus Ascension were all currently being tested and fully integrated into the Philology of Undifferentiated Mana, which was being made even grander with the inclusion of the nine Core Phonemes that he just forged.
This path ahead was gradually becoming clear for his own power and Foundation.
The reduction of redundancies and the elevation of his Weavings of Existence at a rate that other entities would be maddened by!

"We all fall down... we all fall down..." he hummed to himself as in front of him was a radiant blue-gold grill that was the extension of the very concept of cooking elevated into a ridiculous stage. On the grill were a pair of T-bone steaks that were formed from pure concentrated THE Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger.
He cooked the very authority of his Civilization into forms of food and drinks as the next person in line caused him to frown.
The Emperor Penguin gave him an innocent look while holding on to an empty golden plate, his flippers clutching it with an eagerness that bordered on desperation.
Noah sighed as the steaks he was cooking floated from the grill and onto the plate of The Emperor Penguin, who smiled happily with pride.
There was a line of people behind him who were waiting for more food as the festival continued.

Even Little Bobby was there holding a plate with a dark gaze, his small form somehow radiating an intensity that belied his age. Behind him, Henry was laughing and talking with a shy Liora, whose cheeks flushed with warmth.

As Noah looked at the masses of entities all around him celebrating THE Festival of The End, even though their very Weavings of Existence now held signs of fracture that told them they would never exceed a certain Depth, he smiled.
This was his family that he was protecting.
And at this time...
"Oh?"
He raised his head as he felt a change. As he felt Existence settling outside.
|The complex changes of the Second Phase of THE Fallout have been measured to be rapidly reducing.|
|Observable Existence is returning to a new basal state. Obtaining as much information as possible from surrounding weavings of Existence. |
|Note: This information would have been impossible to extract through normal means.|
|The First Tongue itself faced a unique influence and change due to THE Fallout.|
|Standard methods of perception and communication remain non-functional.|
|However: The emergence of your 9 Core Phonemes, integrated into The First Tongue itself, still allows a form of information extraction across some of the rapidly changed Observable Existence.|
|Your additions to The First Tongue serve as unaffected conduits through the corrupted language of Existence.|
|Where others see only static and chaos, you perceive patterns and data.|
|Estimated time until Second Phase completion: 7 minutes|
|Estimated time until new basal state stabilization: 23 minutes|
THE Fallout was ending.
The prompts that flashed before Noah’s eyes also revealed something glorious.
Information extraction across some of the Observable Existence.

In a reality where, at this moment, communication was impossible. Teleportation was impossible among many other things. Very little would be known by the vastness of Observable Existence, as every entity was isolated in their own pocket of corrupted reality.
And yet, because of what he did by forging nine brand new letters of the language of Existence, Noah would still be able to get estimations of information from across Existence.

He knew that this was one of the stupendous capabilities that would bloom from his actions of forming new letters for The First Tongue. The other effects would still show up as time passed, revealing themselves in ways he could not yet predict.
But for now, it was time to go meet the changed Existence outside and see just what the actions ofTHE Living Paradoxhad done to Observable Existence.
He looked at the grill before him, then at the line of people still waiting for food.
"Ruination," he said silently.
|Yes, Master?|
"Take over the cooking."
|Understood. I will ensure THE Festival of The End continues in your absence.|

Noah stepped away from the grill as one of his bodies that Ruination could control seamlessly took his place, continuing to cook THE Civilizational Authority into delicious forms without missing a beat.
He walked through the festival, past his people who were laughing and eating and drinking in defiance of the apocalypse that had just reshaped all of reality.
He slowly made his way to the edge of THE Infiniverse, to where THE Infinite Loom and THE Faraday Cage had protected everything within from the worst of THE Fallout.
And he looked outward!
Toward the changed Existence that awaited.
Toward whatever horrors and wonders THE Living Paradox’s machinations had wrought!

chapters.title: Chapter 4694: The Emerged IV
paragraphs: THE Faraday Cage and THE Infinite Loom were designs of glorious innovation and wonder as they currently shone with a reinforced glow of power after weathering through THE Fallout itself.

Noah appeared directly before the vibrant blue-gold barriers ofTHE Infinite Loomas he looked outside to the changed Weavings of Existence, and they looked absolutely marvelous in the most terrifying way possible.

The immediate landscape outside ofTHE Infiniversewas filled by regions of space that shone with a stellar gray hue, expressing a form of destruction and brilliance at the same time. There seemed to be solid gray clouds pulsing with ash and flames, roiling like thunderheads made of concentrated devastation. If one looked up or down, or in any other direction really, they would notice a faint trace of what looked like ash raining in every direction.

When this ash touched onto surfaces, Existence in that area would sizzle slightly as smoke would bloom. It was as if the very atmosphere had become corrosive, hostile to anything that dared to exist within it.
And with his own eyes, Noah could only see barely more than a mile in every direction. Beyond that, the gray ash and clouds formed an impenetrable curtain that swallowed all perception.
And-
|KAAA!|

As he was thinking and observing all of this, out of absolutely nowhere, a massive form barreled out from the ash-filled Weavings of Existence outside. Since what he could observe was only a mile in every direction, with the gray ash and clouds seemingly covering everything after that, he only managed to see the creature when it was already upon him.
It came to smash onto the walls ofTHE Infinite Loom.
BOOM!
The barrier buzzed.
The impact was heavy as the entity that had done it actually held Depth.
Depth!
SCREE!
"What the fuck..."
He had not even gotten out yet.
He was just observing and waiting for the complete end ofTHE Fallout, and something was already being chucked toward his direction?

His gaze was stern as he observed the monstrous thing that had appeared outside of his home. The thing was currently banging its head onTHE Infinite Loom, and shockingly, even though it could not see him, its maddened eyes were locked onto him as if it came here specifically for him.
The creature was horrifying in a way that transcended normal terror.

Its general form resembled that of a Gulper Eel, with an impossibly large mouth that seemed to comprise most of its body. The jaw could unhinge to reveal rows upon rows of teeth that spiraled inward like a meat grinder made of bone. Its body was elongated and serpentine, covered in skin that looked like it had been turned inside out and then burned.

But what truly made it nightmarish were the markers of the cursed that spread across its flesh paired with all this. Faint cracks glowed with residual Fallout energy, covering every inch of its monstrous form. The cracks pulsed with a sickly gray-multicolored light, and from some of the larger fissures, wisps of primordial energy leaked out like steam from a broken pipe.
Its eyes were the worst. They held no sanity, no thought beyond desperate hunger. They were the eyes of something that had been broken byTHE Falloutand reformed into a creature of pure need.
As Noah observed it, The First Tongue buzzed as waves of information were extracted.
|CREATURE ANALYSIS|
|Designation: Emerged Devourer|
|Classification: The Awakened |
|Depth: THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Origin: Malformed Ginnu Lifeform from THE Belly of Existence|
|Status: Unable to resist the effects of THE Fallout. Underwent forced mutation.|
|Potential Group Ascertained: THE EMERGED|
|Origin: Entities from THE Belly of Existence who were affected by The Fallout when THE Living Paradox’s attack tore open THE Creature’s domain.|
|Mutation Type: Primordial Regression|

|The Emerged are entities who were exposed to The Fallout while simultaneously being bathed in the primordial energies of THE Belly of Existence. This dual exposure caused them to regress toward more fundamental, more ancient forms of existence.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Bodies shifting toward primordial, proto-existence states|
|- Can access abilities from the era before differentiation|
|- Perceive reality in ways that predate current Existence’s structure|
|- Struggle to communicate with post-differentiation entities|
|- Slowly losing connection to modern Existence’s rules|
|Hierarchy:|
|- The Awakened: Recently emerged, still adapting to their new nature (Current specimen)|
|Curse Variation:|

|The Emerged bear a modified version of THE Existential Ceiling. While they cannot reach Absolute Depth through normal means, their primordial regression grants them access to power structures that predate the Depth system entirely.|
|Unique Boon - Primordial Memory:|
|- Can access inherited memories from before differentiation|
|- Possess knowledge of Existence’s fundamental structure|
|- Can perceive the "cracks" in reality that The Fallout created|
|MUTATION DETAILS: PRIMORDIAL HUNGER|
|This specific specimen underwent a horrific mutation that amplified its base instincts to catastrophic levels.|
|Effect: The creature’s existence feels perpetually thirsty, craving rich Weavings of Existence to sustain itself.|
|Behavior: Any entity that comes within a few miles will be sensed if they possess rich Weavings of Existence. The creature will pursue them with undeniable, maddened need.|
|Note: THE Infiniverse and your personal Weavings register as extraordinarily rich sources. This creature likely sensed you from maximum perception range and immediately charged.|
|Warning: Where there is one Emerged, there are likely many more. THE Belly of Existence contained countless entities.|
Noah observed the details of this creature that roared toward him andTHE Infiniversewith a maddened glare.
He could not help but think ofLumivara, Ul’Moreth, and The Fisherman.
They had been in THE Belly of Existence when THE Fallout struck. They had been exposed to those same primordial energies while the attack tore through THE Creature’s domain.
Had they undergone similar mutations?
Or had they been strong enough, aware enough, to resist the regression and maintain their sanity?
He did not know.
And in this new Existence where communication was impossible and perception was limited to mere miles, he had no way of finding out.
BOOM!

THE Emerged Devourerslammed againstTHE Infinite Loomagain, its massive maw trying to bite through barriers that had withstood THE Fallout itself. Cracks of cursed energy flared across its body with each impact, and its screech of frustration echoed through the gray landscape.
Noah watched it with cold, calculating eyes.
This was his first glimpse of what awaited outside.
An Intermediate Depth creature, driven mad by hunger, attacking his home within minutes of THE Fallout’s conclusion.
And according to the information extracted, where there was one, there were likely many more.
THE Belly of Existence had contained many entities.
All of them now exposed to THE Fallout.
All of them potentially transformed into these Emerged.
All of them fucking hungry.

sentences.text: THE Faraday Cage and THE Infinite Loom were designs of glorious innovation and wonder as they currently shone with a reinforced glow of power after weathering through THE Fallout itself.

Noah appeared directly before the vibrant blue-gold barriers ofTHE Infinite Loomas he looked outside to the changed Weavings of Existence, and they looked absolutely marvelous in the most terrifying way possible.
The immediate landscape outside ofTHE Infiniversewas filled by regions of space that shone with a stellar gray hue, expressing a form of destruction and brilliance at the same time.
There seemed to be solid gray clouds pulsing with ash and flames, roiling like thunderheads made of concentrated devastation.
If one looked up or down, or in any other direction really, they would notice a faint trace of what looked like ash raining in every direction.
When this ash touched onto surfaces, Existence in that area would sizzle slightly as smoke would bloom.
It was as if the very atmosphere had become corrosive, hostile to anything that dared to exist within it.
And with his own eyes, Noah could only see barely more than a mile in every direction.
Beyond that, the gray ash and clouds formed an impenetrable curtain that swallowed all perception.
And-
|KAAA!|
As he was thinking and observing all of this, out of absolutely nowhere, a massive form barreled out from the ash-filled Weavings of Existence outside.

Since what he could observe was only a mile in every direction, with the gray ash and clouds seemingly covering everything after that, he only managed to see the creature when it was already upon him.
It came to smash onto the walls ofTHE Infinite Loom.
BOOM!
The barrier buzzed.
The impact was heavy as the entity that had done it actually held Depth.
Depth!
SCREE!
"What the fuck..."
He had not even gotten out yet.
He was just observing and waiting for the complete end ofTHE Fallout, and something was already being chucked toward his direction?
His gaze was stern as he observed the monstrous thing that had appeared outside of his home.
The thing was currently banging its head onTHE Infinite Loom, and shockingly, even though it could not see him, its maddened eyes were locked onto him as if it came here specifically for him.
The creature was horrifying in a way that transcended normal terror.
Its general form resembled that of a Gulper Eel, with an impossibly large mouth that seemed to comprise most of its body.
The jaw could unhinge to reveal rows upon rows of teeth that spiraled inward like a meat grinder made of bone.
Its body was elongated and serpentine, covered in skin that looked like it had been turned inside out and then burned.
But what truly made it nightmarish were the markers of the cursed that spread across its flesh paired with all this.
Faint cracks glowed with residual Fallout energy, covering every inch of its monstrous form.
The cracks pulsed with a sickly gray-multicolored light, and from some of the larger fissures, wisps of primordial energy leaked out like steam from a broken pipe.
Its eyes were the worst.
They held no sanity, no thought beyond desperate hunger.
They were the eyes of something that had been broken byTHE Falloutand reformed into a creature of pure need.
As Noah observed it, The First Tongue buzzed as waves of information were extracted.

|Designation: Emerged Devourer|
|Classification: The Awakened |
|Depth: THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Origin: Malformed Ginnu Lifeform from THE Belly of Existence|

Underwent forced mutation.|

|The Emerged are entities who were exposed to The Fallout while simultaneously being bathed in the primordial energies of THE Belly of Existence.
This dual exposure caused them to regress toward more fundamental, more ancient forms of existence.|

While they cannot reach Absolute Depth through normal means, their primordial regression grants them access to power structures that predate the Depth system entirely.|

|- Possess knowledge of Existence’s fundamental structure|
|- Can perceive the "cracks" in reality that The Fallout created|

|This specific specimen underwent a horrific mutation that amplified its base instincts to catastrophic levels.|
|Effect: The creature’s existence feels perpetually thirsty, craving rich Weavings of Existence to sustain itself.|
|Behavior: Any entity that comes within a few miles will be sensed if they possess rich Weavings of Existence.
The creature will pursue them with undeniable, maddened need.|
|Note: THE Infiniverse and your personal Weavings register as extraordinarily rich sources.
This creature likely sensed you from maximum perception range and immediately charged.|

THE Belly of Existence contained countless entities.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4695: Moirai I
paragraphs: Noah looked at THE Emerged Devourerwith a sense of pity.
A Malformed Ginnu Lifeform who was imprisoned this whole time, and at the time of freedom, they were too weak to fight against THE Fallout.
SCREE!

THE Emerged Devourer still continued to bash its entire body on the barrier, its Depth heavy and profound as it was rapidly eating away at the nearby Logos on THE Infinite Loom. Each impact sent ripples of destruction through the carefully constructed defenses, the creature’s maddened hunger dissolving the meanings that held the barrier together.
It was causing an unnecessary expenditure of his home as Noah began to float toward it.
Pity was pity, but he would not hold back.
He was on a path. He was streamlining his Way and abilities as at this moment, he wanted to feel his Depth freely.
Eighteenth of the Immensity of THE Creature at THE Intermediate Depth? Okay.

What did that translate to? His Way was at Surface Depth as it could Assert Mana or Hunger in unique ways, but if he held Intermediate Depth immensity, then hisAssertionswould automatically be elevated toImpositions.
He wanted to feel with his body closely as he expressed his immensity. How the Logos within him moved. How the Philologies flowed.

In Ginnungagap, he used The Goad and Logos of Imprisonment to gradually corner THE Surface Depth entities until they could no longer exert any power of their Depth, and while in such a state, he took them into his prison.

But this was when he had not even formed his Depth yet. He had the Depth at this moment, and even though he was at THE Surface Depth in his Way and Civilization, he wanted to see how he would measure up to this Intermediate Depth creature that was mutated from THE Fallout.
And so he took a step forward.

As he did so, his skin glinted with Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue. Every weight and immensity of his existence surrounded his entire body, held together tightly as blue-gold light permeated around him like a glow of brilliance. He looked like a humanoid entity that was set aflame with stellar blue-gold brilliance, each Phoneme burning across his form like stars embedded in flesh!

As if THE Emerged could sense a level of immensity from him, it actually backed away for him to come out of the barrier. Its gaze was that of fervor and mad excitement while looking at him, as if it were looking at achickenthat had come out to be cooked and eaten. Saliva that burned with primordial hunger dripped from its impossible maw.
The moment Noah left the confines of THE Infiniverse to appear in the landscape of THE Fallout...
HUUM!
His entire existence vibrated as he felt waves of resonance cascading all around.
|CRITICAL HARVEST DETECTION|

|For stepping out into the expansive, corrupted, and altered Weavings of Observable Existence, Perpetual Harvest has briefly sensed the boundless Infinite Potential that should have been waiting for you.|
|Sources detected:|
|- All the changes that The First Tongue underwent during THE Fallout|
|- All the advancements that those who followed your Way or backed you withinTHE Prison of THE Creatureunderwent|
|- The Shelters of THE Loom making themselves visible within Observable Existence, allowing their Weavings of Existence to run free|
|- All the usage of Mana and The First Tongue across the eons that was carried out to maintain THE Loom and by those within it|
|All of this boundless harvest is barely being sensed at this moment due to the altered Weavings of Observable Existence.|
|Note: If you did not have nine newly forged Phonemes reinforced in The First Tongue, this harvest would never have been collected.|
|The Philology of Perpetual Harvest, backed by your newly forged Phonemes of The First Tongue, promises you that it will ensure every scrap of harvest is accounted for and given to you.|
|Infinite Potential begins to be gathered, however slow and however rigorous, until every ounce that belongs to you is given.|
Noah sensed and heard these prompts as he felt invisible waves of brilliance like an endless sea begin to surge above him and trickle down into his Foundation and Civilization.
He accepted this calmly as he trusted in the Philologies that he was advancing at this moment, that every ounce of what was his would be given!
But he kept his gaze on the Gulper Eel.

At this moment, an ashen color of its Depth erupted around it like heavy strikes of lightning as it looked toward Noah with an immense sense of greed and want. It radiated the immensity of its Depth toward him as if to bring him to submission so he could seamlessly be enjoyed and eaten.
Its mental state and Way seemed entirely far too gone. It could not even be saved. Anything that made it a Malformed Ginnu Lifeform had truly already been stripped away.
What a pity.

The creature’s Way expressed itself asPrimordial Consumption, a regressed, bestial version of hunger that predated sophisticated concepts of devouring. It did not merely want to eat Noah. It wanted to unmake him, to return his complex existence to raw, undifferentiated sustenance.
As its weight and immensity surged toward Noah, he erupted with his own Way in response.

Blue-gold tendrils of lightning unfolded from his existence, crackling with the authority of Mana and Hunger intertwined. They clashed with the ashen bolts of the Gulper Eel’s Depth in the space between them.
HUUM!
The collision was cataclysmic.

Reality itself groaned as two immensities met in the corrupted air. The ashen clouds around them were blown back by the shockwave, revealing glimpses of the gray wasteland that stretched endlessly in all directions. Lightning of blue-gold and lightning of primordial ash intertwined and fought for dominance, each tendril seeking to overwhelm the other.
The ground beneath them cracked! The falling ash was vaporized in a sphere around their clash.The very Weavings of Existence trembled as two Depths contested for supremacy!
And shockingly, Noah’s Depth and the Depth of this creature were almost equal.
Both sides were dispersed.
Noah looked at such a scene and nodded.
At THE Surface Depth, he could disperse the Depth of an Intermediate Depth entity.

He looked at the Gulper Eel as it was not deterred. In fact, it looked at him with even more greed as at this moment, its Way began to twist. Noah sensed this creature was about to utilizeImpositionthat THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities had access to.

The Gulper Eel lit up with a sickly primordial glow as reality around it began to warp. Its maw opened impossibly wide as it sought to impose that the enemy in front of it was already cut up, already prepared, already ready for consumption.
Noah saw this and prepared to counter with his ownImpositionwhen he became astonished.
This was not an Imposition!

chapters.title: Chapter 4696: Moirai II
paragraphs: The Gulper Eel shockingly did not use an Imposition!
Noah’s eyes flickered as time slowed around him, The Phonemes of The First Tongue burning gloriously within his eyes as he demanded an answer.
|Analysis of enemy technique reveals anomalous expression of authority.|
|The Gulper Eel did not use Imposition.|
|It utilized a more ancient form of this capability that creatures in extremely early Observable Existence before differentiation utilized.|
|Classification: Dogma |
|Meaning: "That which seems good" or "Authoritative decree"|

|Dogma is the forceful establishment of a truth that did not previously exist. Dogma creates new truth through sheer authority. It is the precursor to Imposition but carries an additional weight of philosophical conviction.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Decrees that reshape local reality according to the speaker’s philosophical framework|
|- Requires not just power but ideological certainty|
|- Creates "zones of doctrine" where the Dogma’s truth is absolute law|
|- Can only be broken by a superior Dogma or by exposing logical contradictions within it|

|Philosophical Foundation: Dogma represents the power of conviction to shape reality. In the ancient understanding, a belief held with sufficient certainty and authority becomes indistinguishable from truth within its sphere of influence.|
|ENEMY DOGMA ANALYSIS:|
|Dogma of Inevitable Consumption:|
|"That which I perceive as prey has already been prepared for my consumption."|
|Effect: Reality within the Dogma’s zone will reshape the target’s existence to be in a state suitable for consumption, regardless of their actual condition.|
|Danger Level: Extreme. If this Dogma takes hold, your existence will be forcibly altered to match its decree.|
"Dogma..." Noah voiced out to himself as his expression became stern right after.
His heart was free.
And so, he would set this Malformed Ginnu Lifeform free.

Noah allowed the full immensity of his Depth to surge forth as he spoke hisImpositioninto existence. Every single Philology and Logos within him flowed into it, the blue-gold brilliance condensing into words that carried the weight of his entire Way.

"All things are Mana. All Mana is undifferentiated. That which is undifferentiated cannot be prepared or altered by external will, for it has no fixed state to alter. Your Dogma decrees that I am prepared, but I decree that preparation itself is meaningless against that which encompasses all states simultaneously."
BOOM!
TheImpositioncrashed against theDogmalike a tidal wave against a fortress.

The Gulper Eel’s zone of doctrine flickered as logical contradiction was exposed at its core. How could something be prepared for consumption when it existed in all states at once? How could a single decree encompass that which was, by its very nature, undifferentiated?
The Philology of Undifferentiated Mana burned with unprecedented brilliance as it demonstrated, in real-time, the logical impossibility of the Dogma’s premise.
And then the Dogma shattered!
Not merely dispersed, but reversed.

The decree that the prey was prepared for consumption turned back upon its speaker, and the Gulper Eel’s own existence began to warp. Its flesh started to segment. Its form began to separate into portions suitable for consumption, its own Dogma deeming itself to be prey!
SCREE!
The creature’s shriek was one of confusion and agony as its authority was turned against it.
|DOGMA OVERCOME|
|Analysis of victory conditions:|
|Factor One: Your Way of The First Tongue granted inherent resistance to ancient expressions of authority.|
|Factor Two: The Philology of Undifferentiated Mana provided the logical framework to expose the Dogma’s internal contradiction.|
|Factor Three: Your Way, though at Surface Depth, was sufficient to carry an Imposition of equivalent weight to an Intermediate Depth Dogma.|

|Conclusion: Dogma, though a grander form than Imposition, operates on philosophical conviction. When confronted with a truth that logically negates its premise, it cannot maintain coherence regardless of the power behind it.|
Noah saw the shocked expression of the Gulper Eel even as its eyes still carried a light of greed, and he shook his head with pity.
It was time to end this.
He raised his hand, and his voice carried the weight of finality.

"A clench of my fist becomes a severing light of Mana that chains across the existence of the enemy before me. It will not stop until Way and Cognizance are collapsed. What remains shall be the first offering of loot in this accursed landscape."
He clenched his fist.
BOOM!

A heavy blue-gold tendril of light erupted from his closed hand and lanced toward the already fragmenting Gulper Eel. It struck the creature and then chained through its existence, jumping from one portion of its being to another!
Each link of the chain severed something vital.
The first link severed its Way.
The second link severed its Cognizance.
The third link severed its Depth.
The fourth link severed its hold on existence itself.
The creature did not scream. It could not scream. There was nothing left to scream with!

The scene carried solemnity and a sense of sadness as Noah watched the Gulper Eel seperate into motes of primordial light. For the first entity to die in his hands in this new era, it was not any of those responsible for THE Fallout.
It was a Malformed Ginnu Lifeform.
A victim, not a perpetrator.
A being that had been imprisoned, freed, and then broken by forces beyond its control.
Noah looked at the glorious and terrifying scene of his power as at such a time, new prompts bloomed.
|LOOT GENERATION INITIATED|
|All the Weavings and Infinite Potential of THE Emerged Devourer, The Gulper Eel, are being burned by THE Loot Stanchion of Infinity.|
|The Phonemes of Harvest, Fortune, Advantage, and Infinity are being utilized to allow the emergence of something that would contribute to the continued safety of your Existence.|
|Loot generation in progress...|
A blinding light shone.

Massive Phonemes bloomed and compressed around what remained of the Gulper Eel. They spun and condensed, burning away impurities and extracting essence. The process was mesmerizing, watching raw existence be refined into something greater.
After some time, all that remained was a string of golden light and a singularity that shot towards Noah and sunk into his head, straight intoTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.
The string floated still.

A brilliant, glorious string of golden light that shockingly pushed away the ashen glow of the surrounding landscape. It hung in the air before Noah like a thread of pure destiny, pulsing with an authority that predated differentiation itself.
Noah calmly looked at it and beckoned as it flowed toward him.

The string felt warm against his existence, warm and infinitely complex. It carried the weight of possibilities, of paths taken and not taken, of futures that might be and futures that never would be. Holding it was like holding the concept of choice itself made tangible.
|Item: Fragment of THE Moirai Threads|
|Classification: Primordial Artifact (Pre-Differentiation)|
|Origin: Strands from before destiny differentiated. The Moirai Threads were the proto-concept of fate before it split into past, present, and future.|
|Properties:|
|- Can interact with temporal and causal phenomena|
|- Resonates with paradox-based abilities|
|- Contains inherited knowledge of destiny’s fundamental structure|
|SPECIAL COMPATIBILITY DETECTED|
|This Fragment can interact with and enhance THE Existential Paradox Loop.|
|Integration Effect: Partial Simulation of THE Existential Paradox Loop|
|Capability Granted: Without expending an Anchor Point reset, you can now obtain partial information regarding potential futures.|
|Limitation: Information is fragmentary and probabilistic, not absolute. Major events may be sensed, but main details will be obscured.|
A terrifying loot formed, all for the sake of ensuring his existence did not undergo collapse and hardship in these terrifying Weavings of Existence.
Noah looked at the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads as it wound itself around his wrist like a bracelet of pure golden light!
