|Factor Two: The Philology of Undifferentiated Mana provided the logical framework to expose the Dogma’s internal contradiction.|
|Factor Three: Your Way, though at Surface Depth, was sufficient to carry an Imposition of equivalent weight to an Intermediate Depth Dogma.|
|Conclusion: Dogma, though a grander form than Imposition, operates on philosophical conviction.
When confronted with a truth that logically negates its premise, it cannot maintain coherence regardless of the power behind it.|
Noah saw the shocked expression of the Gulper Eel even as its eyes still carried a light of greed, and he shook his head with pity.
It was time to end this.
He raised his hand, and his voice carried the weight of finality.
"A clench of my fist becomes a severing light of Mana that chains across the existence of the enemy before me.
It will not stop until Way and Cognizance are collapsed.
What remains shall be the first offering of loot in this accursed landscape."
He clenched his fist.
BOOM!
A heavy blue-gold tendril of light erupted from his closed hand and lanced toward the already fragmenting Gulper Eel.
It struck the creature and then chained through its existence, jumping from one portion of its being to another!
Each link of the chain severed something vital.
The first link severed its Way.
The second link severed its Cognizance.
The third link severed its Depth.
The fourth link severed its hold on existence itself.
The creature did not scream.
It could not scream.
There was nothing left to scream with!
The scene carried solemnity and a sense of sadness as Noah watched the Gulper Eel seperate into motes of primordial light.
For the first entity to die in his hands in this new era, it was not any of those responsible for THE Fallout.
It was a Malformed Ginnu Lifeform.
A victim, not a perpetrator.
A being that had been imprisoned, freed, and then broken by forces beyond its control.
Noah looked at the glorious and terrifying scene of his power as at such a time, new prompts bloomed.
|LOOT GENERATION INITIATED|
|All the Weavings and Infinite Potential of THE Emerged Devourer, The Gulper Eel, are being burned by THE Loot Stanchion of Infinity.|
|The Phonemes of Harvest, Fortune, Advantage, and Infinity are being utilized to allow the emergence of something that would contribute to the continued safety of your Existence.|
|Loot generation in progress...|
A blinding light shone.
Massive Phonemes bloomed and compressed around what remained of the Gulper Eel.
They spun and condensed, burning away impurities and extracting essence.
The process was mesmerizing, watching raw existence be refined into something greater.
After some time, all that remained was a string of golden light and a singularity that shot towards Noah and sunk into his head, straight intoTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.
The string floated still.
A brilliant, glorious string of golden light that shockingly pushed away the ashen glow of the surrounding landscape.
It hung in the air before Noah like a thread of pure destiny, pulsing with an authority that predated differentiation itself.
Noah calmly looked at it and beckoned as it flowed toward him.
The string felt warm against his existence, warm and infinitely complex.
It carried the weight of possibilities, of paths taken and not taken, of futures that might be and futures that never would be.
Holding it was like holding the concept of choice itself made tangible.
|Item: Fragment of THE Moirai Threads|
|Classification: Primordial Artifact (Pre-Differentiation)|
|Origin: Strands from before destiny differentiated.
The Moirai Threads were the proto-concept of fate before it split into past, present, and future.|
|Properties:|
|- Can interact with temporal and causal phenomena|
|- Resonates with paradox-based abilities|
|- Contains inherited knowledge of destiny’s fundamental structure|
|SPECIAL COMPATIBILITY DETECTED|
|This Fragment can interact with and enhance THE Existential Paradox Loop.|
|Integration Effect: Partial Simulation of THE Existential Paradox Loop|
|Capability Granted: Without expending an Anchor Point reset, you can now obtain partial information regarding potential futures.|
|Limitation: Information is fragmentary and probabilistic, not absolute.
Major events may be sensed, but main details will be obscured.|
A terrifying loot formed, all for the sake of ensuring his existence did not undergo collapse and hardship in these terrifying Weavings of Existence.
Noah looked at the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads as it wound itself around his wrist like a bracelet of pure golden light!

chapters.title: Chapter 4697: Moirai III
paragraphs: A Fragment of THE Moirai Threads.
A string so vibrant and powerful that he felt like it weighed an entire Depth of Absolute Sovereignty in his hand.
It represented many things as truth be told, even though he did not have any doubt, he was still unfathomably cautious of everything that was to come.
He had a sense of expectation and wonder for the mysteries out there, but he was not looking forward to the struggles and the hardship that he would have to go through to bypass them.
This object was an unfathomable saving grace as it was also born as a product of what his existence deemed would be the most ideal loot for him to have.
If it could truly react withTHE Existential Paradox Loop...
"Utilize the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads."
HUUM!
If he had the cheat to peer into the future, to see what would be happening, why not use it right away?

The moment that he uttered such words, the golden thread shot out from his hand and pierced into his chest like a sharp blade. His eyes frowned in pain as the golden thread proceeded to wrap around and constrict his heart with a grip that felt like destiny itself squeezing his existence.
It was not a pleasant feeling at all.
But moments later, a unique cloud of golden brilliance began to surround him, and his eyes became glazed gold as visions that had not yet come to pass began to crystallize before his perception.
|Usage of the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads initiated.|
|A Partial Simulation of THE Existential Paradox Loop is beginning.|
|Note: This is a Partial Simulation only.|
|Capability: Fragmentary glimpses of potential futures based on current trajectory.|
|Limitation: Information is probabilistic, not absolute. Details may be obscured or inaccurate.|
|Estimation: 9 Fragments may allow for a Full Simulation until potential collapse or death.|
|Current Fragments: 1/9|
|Warning: Viewing potential futures does not guarantee they will occur.|
|Simulation beginning...|

Noah viewed these prompts calmly as moments later, he began to feel waves of information flowing through him. His eyes flickered gold, and scenes of potential futures he had not yet come across began playing before him.
|Timeline Analysis Beginning...|
|Within minutes of the Second Phase of THE Fallout ending, you set off into the Wastes of THE Fallout after having laid to rest a Gulper Eel.|
|You break down its Weavings and memories as part of what it used to be and what it stood for are written in the pages of your Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.|
|The Phonemes of Advantage and Fortune naturally trigger and focus on retrieving certain memories that pulse with glory and benefit for you.|
|From its memories, you learn of a terrifying corrupted region this entity had run away from while THE Fallout was continuing.|
|A domain that had been locked in Ginnungagap, which was within THE Belly of Existence.|
|After THE Belly was torn open, this domain and many other wonders spilled out and proceeded to face corruption.|
|You grow very interested as the memories leave behind a name...|
|THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|You remember the words ofUl’MorethaboutTHE Vaults of Ginnungagapand the dangers and wonders they held.|
|After you weigh the risks, you try to backtrack the path of the Gulper Eel to find this corrupted domain.|
|You begin heading out deeper into the Wastes of THE Fallout cautiously, still feeling the faint connection to THE Infiniverse.|
|You affirm you can return to it if need be, the connection with The First Tongue allowing this to be a possibility, especially due to the 9 newly forged Core Phonemes.|
|You wonder if it would be possible to bypass the restrictions of the Wastes of THE Fallout to sense or reach out to Lumivara and Ul’Moreth.|
|As you move carefully through The Wastes while noting the specific path you take, you come across an abomination. Or really, the Abomination was drawn to your pure weavings of Existence.|
|A creature not originating from THE Belly of Existence or THE Loom.|
|Something from a domain existing between the gaps of Existence that was torn open due to THE Fallout.|
|You come across your first Scorched.|
|You draw upon The First Tongue to define and classify this entity:|
|THE SCORCHED|
|Origin: Entities who survived direct exposure to The Fallout’s flames without any protection.|
|Mutation: Existential Combustion|

|The Scorched are entities whose very existence has been permanently set ablaze by The Fallout. They burn continuously with the multicolored flames of existential annihilation, and rather than being consumed, they have learned to fuel themselves with the destruction.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Bodies wreathed in perpetual flames of The Fallout|
|- Can project and weaponize Fallout energy|
|- Immune to further Fallout damage|
|- Feed on destruction and decay|
|- Cannot heal naturally; must consume the existence of others to regenerate|
|- Gradually lose their original personality and memories|
|- Eventually become more flame than entity|
|Hierarchy(Currently encountered):|
|-Cinders: Newly Scorched, still fighting to maintain identity|
|Curse Variation:|

|The Scorched bear the full Existential Ceiling curse but have developed a workaround. By consuming the existence of others, they can temporarily boost their advancement rate. This makes them predatory but also prevents them from ever achieving stable, lasting power.|
The information Noah was reading in the form of prompts was grand, but the images he saw were even grander!
His eyes blazed gold as even though this was only a possibility, he saw it.
THE Scorched entity appeared in his mind’s eye with terrifying clarity.

It was a serpentine creature of impossible grace and horrifying beauty, its body long and sinuous like some ancient leviathan adapted for land. Fins that should have belonged to an aquatic being fanned out along its spine and tail, but instead of membrane and scale, they were composed entirely of crystallized Fallout flames that shifted through colors.

Its fur, or what might have once been fur, had become living fire that flowed across its form like water made of destruction. Multicolored flames of violet and crimson and gold and colors that had no name rippled across its serpentine body with each movement, leaving trails of scorched reality in its wake.

The creature’s face was elongated and almost regal, with eyes that burned like twin suns trapped in sockets of ash. Where its mouth opened, one could see that even its teeth were flames given solid form, each fang a concentrated point of existential annihilation.

Most disturbing were the cracks across its existence, the markers of the cursed that glowed not with the usual residual Fallout energy but with active, hungry fire. The cracks were not healing. They were spreading. And from each crack, more flames poured forth.

It moved with a dancer’s grace despite its size, each step leaving behind footprints of burning reality that took moments to repair themselves. Bubbles of superheated existence rose from its form like foam from turbulent waters, each one a tiny pocket of destruction waiting to pop!
Oh!
Even though he was only viewing scenes of it in his mind, Noah could see the ferocity of THE Scorched as its Depth burned with heavy Intermediate immensity.
This was not a creature that could be reasoned with.
This was not a creature that remembered what it once was!
This was flame given purpose, and that purpose was consumption!

The golden haze around Noah’s vision flickered as the Partial Simulation continued to feed him glimpses of what might come. He saw himself facing this creature in the gray Wastes, saw the clash of blue-gold authority against multicolored annihilation, saw the dance of death that would unfold between them.
And he saw that this was merely the first of many such encounters!

chapters.title: Chapter 4698: Moirai IV
paragraphs: As he viewed the scenes of THE Scorched in the glimmers of golden light of The Fragment of THE Moirai Threads, the Partial Simulation continued.
|Your battle against THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders was a glorious one.|
|This creature uniquely utilized Dogma and not Imposition, its ancient expressions of authority fueled by the very flames that consumed its existence.|
|Partial scenes of the battle have been observed:|
|The Scorched Leviathan declared a Dogma of Purifying Flame, seeking to establish that all things within its presence must burn and be cleansed of impurity.|
|You countered with the Philology of Undifferentiated Mana, arguing that Mana cannot be purified because it already exists in its most fundamental state.|
|The clash of Dogma against your philosophical framework created cascades of destruction across the Wastes.|
|Result: Victory.|
|Your Weavings and Phonemes move once more to form the best possible loot.|
|2 Fragments of THE Moirai Threads form from THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders.|
|Current Fragment Count: 2/9|
|You begin sifting through its memories.|
|Note: Only partial memories are available due to this Partial Simulation.|
|Discovery: The direction you are heading toward is actually one THE Scorched was veering away from.|
|The creature fled from something it deemed too dangerous even for its flame-wreathed existence.|
|You do not hesitate as you continue in the same direction, seeking the corrupted domain from the memories of the Gulper Eel.|
|You traverse regions where the ashen clouds condense into liquid devastation that rains upward from the ground.|
|Your Logos of Protection are tested repeatedly as you navigate zones where time inverts without warning.|
|You encounter pockets of frozen time where lesser False THE creatures are trapped mid-motion, their expressions forever locked in terror.|
|You bypass regions where sound becomes visible and silence becomes lethal, your Phonemes of The First Tongue guiding you through.|
|You discover areas where the very concept of distance has been corrupted, with single steps covering miles or miles covering inches unpredictably.|
|You note paths and landmarks, committing them to memory for your eventual passage.|
|Time passes. Struggles compound. Your existence is tested again and again.|
|But you persevere.|
|After some time and annoyances, you feel something immense far ahead.|
|You come across a massive crimson-gold cloudy barrier that extends for countless miles, shrouded by the ashen clouds and flames of THE Fallout.|
|Everything within your existence screams danger at observing this place.|
|Your instincts, honed through countless battles and near-death experiences, tell you to turn back.|
|But defiance is in your nature.|
|You take a step forward and go in.|
The golden light around Noah flickered gloriously as his eyes pulsed with a gold light while he saw the scenes of the domain he was entering clearly.
It felt grand and ancient.
|It was not hard to enter the domain at all.|
|Your existence was even uncontrollably pulled into it once you crossed the threshold.|
|As you passed through the crimson-gold barrier, your existence was pulled on all sides.|
|Its integrity was almost destroyed by forces that seemed to want to reshape you into something compatible with this ancient place.|
|But you persevered.|
|Your existence burned with glorious defiance.|
|You demanded information.|
|Your Phonemes expressed their power gloriously, the nine newly forged letters of The First Tongue reaching out to extract meaning from the incomprehensible.|
|Information begins to flow...|
|DOMAIN IDENTIFIED: THE CORRUPTED VAULT OF GINNUNGAGAP|
|This Vault predates The First Tongue’s differentiation.|
|It originates from an era when Existence was still learning to define itself.|
|It is a remnant of Ginnungagap that was torn open by THE Fallout and corrupted by the collision of primordial energies with the catastrophic changes to Observable Existence.|
|The Vault operates on principles that predate the modern Depth system.|
|Ancient expressions of authority hold sway here.|
|Current Location: The Second Circle|
|Designation: The Stoa of Dogmata|
|You are arriving in the Second Circle of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Warning: You have bypassed the First Circle entirely through unknown means.|
Noah’s eyes flickered as he saw a grand and unfathomable scene.
The Stoa of Dogmata stretched before him in impossible grandeur.

An endless colonnade of pillars rose toward a ceiling that did not exist, each one carved from crystallized authority that predated differentiation itself. The pillars were inscribed with Dogmata from the ancient era, each inscription glowing with the conviction of beings who had believed so absolutely in their truths that reality itself had bent to accommodate them.
Some pillars burned with cold fire. Others wept tears of solidified time. Still others hummed with frequencies that made his very existence vibrate in uncomfortable waves.

The space between pillars was filled with zones of doctrine, visible as faintly shimmering barriers that separated one philosophical framework from another. He could see where one zone ended and another began, the boundaries marked by subtle shifts in the color of light, the texture of space, the very feel of reality.
And he could only see the immediate mile or two around him.
Further in, multicolored clouds covered everything, obscuring the depths of the Stoa in mystery. He sensed immense dangers lurking within those clouds!
But he also sensed opportunities!
Treasures waiting to be claimed by those bold enough to navigate.
|As you gaze at this region of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap you arrived in, you do not realize that meters to your right was a humanoid figure of a woman watching you with an intrigued smile.|
|You happen to see her only when your gaze directly lands on her, your perception being unable to even perceive her through any other means.|
|She looks toward you for a few seconds longer before she seemingly loses interest and goes back to staring at the endless expanse ahead.|
|You feel absolutely nothing from this woman.|
|No Depth. No Way. No Weavings of Existence. Nothing.|
|As if she does not exist at all.|
|As if she is a hole in reality shaped like a person.|
|You are cautious, seeking answers through The First Tongue.|
|An imperceptible Weaving of power unfolds from you, reaching toward her to extract information.|
|The entity shockingly senses what you tried to do.|
|She is surprised.|
|Then she waves her hand.|
|A shocking force smacks into you and nearly crushes your existence entirely.|
|80% of your protective Logos and Philologies are decimated in an instant.|
|You are thrown backward, your existence screaming in agony as you struggle to maintain coherence.|
|The woman speaks for the first time in a warning.|
|Her voice is unfathomably grand and serene as she says in The First Tongue:|
||Do not do that again.||
|Barely grasping what remains of your existence, you see a prompt that tells you the only piece of information you managed to obtain from the entity.|
|A single distinction extracted at the cost of nearly everything:|
|Designation: Eon.|
BOOM!
|Fragment strain has exceeded sustainable parameters.|
|Information extraction has reached critical threshold.|
|The glimpses of potential future are fragmenting.|
|Partial Simulation ending.|
|Returning to present moment.|
The golden light around Noah shattered like glass as he was forcibly ejected from the vision.

He gasped, his existence trembling from the phantom pain of injuries he had not yet sustained. His heart pounded against the golden thread still wrapped around it, and for a moment, he could still feel the echo of that woman’s casual dismissal, the way she had destroyed 80% of his defenses with a wave of her hand!
Eon.
That single word burned in his mind with terrifying weight.
Noah stood in the gray Wastes outside THE Infiniverse, the golden thread around his heart slowly releasing its grip as the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads faded into dormancy!

|As you gaze at this region of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap you arrived in, you do not realize that meters to your right was a humanoid figure of a woman watching you with an intrigued smile.|
|You happen to see her only when your gaze directly lands on her, your perception being unable to even perceive her through any other means.|
|She looks toward you for a few seconds longer before she seemingly loses interest and goes back to staring at the endless expanse ahead.|
|You feel absolutely nothing from this woman.|
|No Depth.
No Way.
No Weavings of Existence.
Nothing.|
|As if she does not exist at all.|
|As if she is a hole in reality shaped like a person.|
|You are cautious, seeking answers through The First Tongue.|
|An imperceptible Weaving of power unfolds from you, reaching toward her to extract information.|
|The entity shockingly senses what you tried to do.|
|She is surprised.|
|Then she waves her hand.|
|A shocking force smacks into you and nearly crushes your existence entirely.|
|80% of your protective Logos and Philologies are decimated in an instant.|
|You are thrown backward, your existence screaming in agony as you struggle to maintain coherence.|
|The woman speaks for the first time in a warning.|
|Her voice is unfathomably grand and serene as she says in The First Tongue:|
||Do not do that again.||
|Barely grasping what remains of your existence, you see a prompt that tells you the only piece of information you managed to obtain from the entity.|
|A single distinction extracted at the cost of nearly everything:|
|Designation: Eon.|
BOOM!
|Fragment strain has exceeded sustainable parameters.|
|Information extraction has reached critical threshold.|
|The glimpses of potential future are fragmenting.|
|Partial Simulation ending.|
|Returning to present moment.|
The golden light around Noah shattered like glass as he was forcibly ejected from the vision.
He gasped, his existence trembling from the phantom pain of injuries he had not yet sustained.

His heart pounded against the golden thread still wrapped around it, and for a moment, he could still feel the echo of that woman’s casual dismissal, the way she had destroyed 80% of his defenses with a wave of her hand!
Eon.
That single word burned in his mind with terrifying weight.
Noah stood in the gray Wastes outside THE Infiniverse, the golden thread around his heart slowly releasing its grip as the Fragment of THE Moirai Threads faded into dormancy!

chapters.title: Chapter 4699: Eon! I
paragraphs: Eon.

This was the only distinction he got from a being who was powerful enough to actually sense when The First Tongue was being utilized and accessed by him to find out information. That level of power alone was ridiculous, and when paired with the name, even if Noah had a single working brain cell, he immediately and directly went to the distinction ofTHE Secretive Eon.
"Fucking hell..."
And he could not help but curse as he smiled. A Monstrous being right outside the gate!

If his thought process was right and the entity there was actually someone on the same caliber asTHE Living Paradox, or THE Creature, or THE Primordial Chaos, this would be the first entity of this stature that Noah had seen who had only gazed at him with slight interest before looking away as if he did not matter.
She only made an action when he made an action. She only responded.
And it made sense that a wave of the hand of such a being could decimate more than eighty percent of his protection and power.
But Noah now came to a crossroads where he had to ask himself what exactly he would do with the information that he had received from the Partial Simulation.

He knew that the information regarding THE Corrupted Vault was indispensable, with that domain itself being something extremely unique. His own Weavings of Advantage and Fortune were pointing to this place as something that could greatly elevate his power and immensity.
But it was a risk.
The action of meeting one of the terrifying entities in the same caliber asTHE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Paradoxwas also a tremendous risk.

And as he thought about this, he also thought about The Early Veiled Shore ofTHE Creaturewhere one of his bodies remained. He had cautiously been waiting within the Shore as he discussed things with Anaximander, THE First Hunger, and THE Living Origin, who were taking stock of all those within the Shore and how every single entity was affected by the curse of THE Existential Ceiling, and how things were affected overall.
This whole time, Noah had been waiting to see if the owner of that Shore would come back to his abode.
It would allow for many things to be illuminated and for many secrets to be revealed, but there was no sign ofTHE Creature.
Was he andTHE Living Paradoxout there right now in these boundless, expansive, changed Weavings of Observable Existence already fighting for supremacy?
There were too many unknowns, and at this moment when it came time for him to make a decision on exactly what he would be doing, the decision was actually already made to begin with.
The hardest and riskiest things almost always granted the most tremendous benefits.

In Existence, one did not get anywhere unless they struggled, unless they put in the hard work. He stretched his body and looked down to the expanse of THE Fallout as he was ready to put in some work.

He finished assessing the risks of still entering the Vault and potentially meeting the entity that was likelyTHE Secretive Eon. When he asked his intuition and even danced with the possibility with his newly forged Phonemes, apart from the sense of immense danger, he did not sense the allure of collapse from this particular event.
And hey, if anything did happen and his intuition was wrong, well, he had an Anchor Point for this.
The Wastes of THE Fallout were filled with unfathomable dangers, and he had all the tools to go through it. So...
"Let’s go. THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders is up first."
HUUM!
He felt his existence pulse with waves of immensity as he took a step and began delving into the Wastes as if he knew and understood exactly where he had to go.
And in a sense, he did.

So far he had come across two groups of beings in this landscape. The Emerged and The Scorched. They were dangerous, yes, but to him at this moment, they represented the source of the resource that was in the Fragments of THE Moirai Threads.
As he proceeded on in the future, he would have to see which ones would be fitting to enter his Infinite Desmoterion or be turned into loot.
With steady steps, he rapidly began to cross the dangerous regions of the Wastes that he knew from the memories of the Partial Simulation.

And even though he could do it extremely fast since he knew the rough location that THE Scorched would be at, he wanted the conditions to be extremely similar to how the Partial Simulation played out.
So he waded across the Wastes of THE Fallout.
Until eventually, he was actually the one to come across THE Scorched, even before it sensed and went toward him.

THE Scorched Leviathan of Cindersfloated in the ashen expanse like a serpentine titan of annihilation. Its elongated body rippled with living flames that shifted through impossible colors, fins of crystallized Fallout energy fanning out along its spine like the sails of a burning ship. Its regal face turned toward him with eyes like twin dying suns, and its Way emanated outward in waves of Purifying Consumption, a philosophy that demanded all things burn and be made clean through destruction.
It blinked at him in surprise before it sensed his immensity that caused it and The Emerged to go crazy with need.
But before this creature at THE Intermediate Depth made any moves, Noah was the one that made the first move as he continued to test the immensity and Depth of his power.

His entire body vibrated with all of its weight and immensity as he raised his leg. Every Logos, every Philology, every Phoneme within him condensed into this single action as he spoke his Imposition into existence.
"My foot is the sharpest blade in Existence. By the time it fully presses down, the enemy before me will have its existence entirely severed and collapsed."

chapters.title: Chapter 4700: Eon! II
paragraphs: His Imposition was a truly domineering one as the Phoneme of Tyranny appeared above him and spun with an incandescent purple glow. Everything seemed to slow down as his entire visage radiated splendor. His small figure immediately gave off an extremely imposing and terrifying air, and when his leg began to move down, THE Scorched was alarmed as it felt its existence seemingly about to be cut into countless pieces and collapsed.
THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders roared with a majestic voice that shook the Wastes, its Dogma erupting from the very core of its burning existence.
“My flames cannot be severed by anything in Existence! That which burns eternally knows no blade, no edge, no cutting force! I am fire unending, and fire cannot be divided!”
One sought to cut by placing their foot down, and one denied this as they said they could not be cut.
In the next moment, Noah’s brilliant figure forcefully brought down his foot in its entirety.
BOOM!
The collision of Imposition and Dogma lasted less than a heartbeat.

Blue-gold light erupted from Noah’s descending foot like an existential blade carving through reality itself. The Phoneme of Tyranny burned with such intensity that it overwrote the very concept of what could and could not be severed. His Imposition did not argue with the Dogma. It did not debate. It simply declared with such absolute authority that the Dogma’s philosophical framework crumbled before it could fully establish itself.

THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders’ eyes showed utter incredulity as the severing light passed through its existence. Its flames, which had burned since before THE Fallout, which had consumed multiple entities to fuel their eternal conflagration, were cut apart like paper before a blade that recognized no limitation.
It wanted to ask, “Bro, what the fuck was this? I didn’t even get to salivate or chase after you?!”
But its existence was already dimming into oblivion, its Way collapsing, its Cognizance fading, its very concept of self being severed into fragments that could no longer maintain coherence.
|Imposition victorious over Dogma.|
|Analysis: THE Scorched Leviathan’s Dogma operated on the conviction that its flames were eternal and indivisible.|
|However, your Imposition was backed by the full immensity of your Depth, the Phoneme of Tyranny, and the Philology of Undifferentiated Mana.|
|The Phoneme of Tyranny grants absolute authority to your declarations when sufficient immensity supports them.|
|Your Imposition did not attempt to argue that flames could be severed. It simply declared that your foot was the sharpest blade, making the question of what can or cannot be cut irrelevant.|
|Against a Dogma that relies on defining limitations, an Imposition that ignores limitations entirely will always prevail if backed by sufficient weight.|

As Noah looked at the collapse of yet another Civilization under his hands, his gaze was cold and imperious as he observed everything that represented the Way and existence of this creature begin to be bundled up into a brilliant song of golden light by his Phonemes.
Similar to THE Emerged, but because the Depth of THE Scorched was a bit greater, two golden strings formed from the remnants of the Civilization.
They began to flow toward him.
|Loot generated from THE Scorched Leviathan of Cinders.|
|2 Fragments of THE Moirai Threads obtained.|
|Current Fragment Count: 2/9|
|Note: Higher Depth entities yield greater Fragment quantities.|

Noah kept them inside of his existence calmly as he took another step and disappeared even further inward, prepared to smoothly bypass the regions that he had in his memory before he had an encounter with one of the more terrifying types of existences.
THE Secretive Eon!
Across The Wastes of THE Fallout.
The end of Existence came with a lot of things as different entities faced different challenges and entirely different results.
The veil between the Living and the Dead was completely torn as the lands of the Living and the Dead effectively did not exist anymore.
All that existed was the landscape after THE Fallout.
It was ashen domains of destruction and brilliance in equal measure, as it seemed like an apocalypse and also the emergence of something unfathomably new.
A few minutes after the Second Phase of THE Fallout had ended. In an unknown region of Observable Existence.
A consciousness woke up as if it had been in a long and endless slumber.
The consciousness was none other than the Great Usurper, Eckert!
But as he woke up at this time, he found himself confined in what felt like a relatively small space.
His Idle Existence had covered an extremely expansive region of the Lands of the Dead as he knew how it felt when he covered such an expansive space.
But at this moment, he felt contained.
What was...
|Emergency Consciousness Preservation Protocol - Complete.|
|The emergence of THE Fallout and its subsequent actions over Observable Existence distorted and expanded your existence in a grotesque fashion.|
|For the sake of survival of a cognizant consciousness, a risk was taken to utilize the force of THE Fallout to infuse your consciousness into the Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox.|
|The gamble was successful due to the chaotic Weavings of Existence.|
|Your consciousness was contained within the Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox, but the effects of THE Fallout were pervasive.|
|Your existence has been branded with the Curse of THE Existential Ceiling.|
|Your existence has been branded as a Scorched.|

|The Scorched are entities whose very existence has been permanently set ablaze by The Fallout. They burn continuously with the multicolored flames of existential annihilation, and rather than being consumed, they have learned to fuel themselves with the destruction.|
|Your consciousness is wreathed in perpetual flames of The Fallout.|
|You can project and weaponize Fallout energy.|
|You are immune to further Fallout damage.|
|You feed on destruction and decay.|
|You would have gradually lost your original personality and memories, but the Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox prevents this deterioration.|
|You are now a Cinder, a newly Scorched Lifeform.|
|Your consciousness is contained in the Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox and has integrated with it by 1% so far.|
|Idle Expansion with the emergence of Idle Loot of THE Fallout is now possible.|
|Proceed?|
Eckert’s consciousness shone brightly as he viewed all these prompts for another instant before he nodded with enthusiasm, his mind bright as he wondered...
Did Osmont come out the other side okay?
Because at this moment, it did not seem like he could reach him!
But he would go slowly and see just what had changed with him and with existence at large. And...where the hell were his Disciples of THE Creature?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4701: Eon! III
paragraphs: Others had easy lives. Others struggled.
But if ever you found yourself living an easy life, you should be worried. Deeply, profoundly worried. Because Existence was a sadistic teacher who believed in learning through suffering.

If the lessons stopped, it didn’t mean you had graduated. It meant the teacher was preparing something special. Something that would make all previous lessons look like warm-up exercises. Noah had learned this truth the hard way, which was, coincidentally, the only way Existence ever taught anything.
If the path before you was smooth and unobstructed, something was horrendously wrong. Either you were being fattened for slaughter, or you had already died and simply hadn’t noticed yet.
At this moment.

Noah had trekked through The Wastes as he followed the events of the Partial Simulation closely, and at this moment, he was staring at the grand and seemingly endless boundary of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.

His eyes radiated an imperious light of power and conviction, burning with the certainty of one who had weighed the risks and found them acceptable. His gaze was steady, his stance unwavering, and when he spoke, his voice carried the weight of absolute commitment.
“In for a penny, in for a pound.”
BOOM!
And right after, he entered a chaotic region of Existence that was trying to pull his Weavings in every single direction simultaneously.

But his body was already pulsing and radiating Phonemes of The First Tongue, his immensity causing him to look like an unstoppable force with an indomitable momentum as he remained steady throughout until he was deposited...
BOOM!
Into a glorious place.
His vision adjusted as he looked around to see The Stoa of Dogmata. Exactly as he saw in the Partial Simulation.

The endless colonnade of pillars stretched before him in impossible grandeur, each one carved from crystallized authority that predated differentiation itself. Inscriptions of ancient Dogmata glowed upon their surfaces, some burning with cold fire, others weeping tears of solidified time. The zones of doctrine shimmered between the pillars like veils separating different philosophical realities, and further in, multicolored clouds obscured the depths of this place in impenetrable mystery.
But what the Partial Simulation had not fully conveyed was the ground beneath his feet.

The earth he stood on was obsidian, black and gleaming like volcanic glass that had been polished by eons of existence. Obsidian tendrils of crackling light spread across its surface like veins of destabilizing power, pulsing with energies that would have torn apart a weak THE Surface Depth entity in moments.
|Welcome to the Second Circle of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Current Location: The Stoa of Dogmata.|
|Caution: The ground itself carries destabilizing energies.|
Noah sensed and observed all of this, but the vast entirety of his attention turned to his right at this moment.
There, just like in the Partial Simulation, was the image of a serene and glorious woman.
Eon!
THUMP!

Okay, so his heart beat a little faster. Not in a juvenile way and not because he was smitten, but in that anticipatory way when you met an extremely unpredictable variable that could collapse you at any moment.
And this entity had a light smile as she looked toward him with a light of intrigue.
This time around, he caught her gaze before she looked away in a bored fashion since he knew she would be here, and their gazes met.
She was small in stature, almost delicate in appearance, with features that held an ageless quality that made it impossible to determine if she was young or ancient beyond measure.

Her face was composed and regal, with high cheekbones and dark eyes that seemed to hold depths far greater than any physical form should contain. There was a stillness about her, a sense of absolute control and purpose that radiated from her very being!

Her hair was dark as the void between stars, but strands of gold flowed through it like rivers of light through an endless night, catching the ambient glow of the Stoa in ways that seemed almost deliberate. A white-blue robe covered her form, simple yet somehow more elegant than the most elaborate garments, as if the fabric itself knew it was privileged to drape across her shoulders.
And her eyes!
Oh!
Her pupils seemed to be the simplest and most common pupils, dark and unremarkable at first glance. And yet...
|Warning.|
|You have stared into eyes that may harm your existence if you gaze for too long.|
|Recommendation: Limit direct visual contact.|
Staring into her eyes alone for too long could harm him.
Noah’s gaze flashed with defiance at this as he blinked, and he cautiously floated toward this terrifying entity as he spoke out calmly.
“Hello. You are one of the few cognizant beings I have met since the end of THE Fallout. I am-”

As he was speaking, the terrifying entity seated ahead looked away into the depths of this domain. Her voice came measured and unhurried, each word placed with the precision of someone who had spent eternities choosing exactly what to say and when to say it.
“I know who you are, Scale Breaker. I watched you take your first stumbling steps in the Primordial Genesis Shore.”
BOOM!
Her gaze finally settled on him with the weight of ages.
“Whether you have grown bolder or merely more foolish since then, I have not yet decided.”
BOOM!
Her words were heavy as Noah instantly became stern.
She was there?
In Ginnungagap?!

He did not recall seeing anything about her or even closely resembling her in all the Ginnu Lifeforms there. She looked at his silence and surprise as she continued looking ahead calmly, her posture unchanged, her attention seemingly fixed on something in the distant depths that only she could perceive.

Noah’s reply came cautiously, his voice measured. “You were there when THE Primordial Chaos, THE Creature, and THE Living Temporal fought? And none of them sensed you either? You weren’t involved in that entire conflict?”
At such words, THE Secretive Eon’s expression remained unchanged. When she spoke, there was no defensiveness, no need to justify. Only quiet, glorious, interminable certainty.

“THE Creature knew I was there from the moment he arrived. The others...” A slight pause came that was almost dismissive. “They saw what they expected to see, which was nothing at all. But that is the way of things.”
Her head tilted, a fraction of movement that somehow conveyed vast consideration.
“You call what happened there a conflict. Perhaps it was, from where you stood. But it was not anything much.”
The faintest ghost of something unreadable crossed her features before vanishing.
“That you know who I am is unexpected. I will grant you that much. But it makes your presence here all the more puzzling.”
She turned to regard him fully, and her calm was more terrifying than any display of power could have been.
“Do you believe yourself grand now, Scale Breaker? Because you have laid claim to The First Tongue?”
The question hung in the air, requiring no answer.
“You know what I am. You know what entities such as myself do to ones such as yourself. And yet here you stand.”
Her dark eyes studied him with an attention that felt like being weighed on scales older than Existence itself.
“I find myself curious despite my better judgment. Why?”
Why.
The question was a simple one as Noah felt a sense of danger and stopped moving forward, looking at this terrifying being as he said...
“Just my intuition.”
BOOM!
Intuition.
The word left her lips like she was tasting something she had not encountered in a very long time.
“Intuition...”
Her eyes grew distant for a moment, seeing something far beyond the Stoa, far beyond this moment entirely.
Then she smiled.
“What a curious and ridiculous thing to say.”
Her gaze refocused on him with renewed interest!

sentences.text: Others had easy lives.
Others struggled.
But if ever you found yourself living an easy life, you should be worried.
Deeply, profoundly worried.
Because Existence was a sadistic teacher who believed in learning through suffering.
If the lessons stopped, it didn’t mean you had graduated.
It meant the teacher was preparing something special.
Something that would make all previous lessons look like warm-up exercises.
Noah had learned this truth the hard way, which was, coincidentally, the only way Existence ever taught anything.
If the path before you was smooth and unobstructed, something was horrendously wrong.
Either you were being fattened for slaughter, or you had already died and simply hadn’t noticed yet.
At this moment.

Noah had trekked through The Wastes as he followed the events of the Partial Simulation closely, and at this moment, he was staring at the grand and seemingly endless boundary of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.
His eyes radiated an imperious light of power and conviction, burning with the certainty of one who had weighed the risks and found them acceptable.
His gaze was steady, his stance unwavering, and when he spoke, his voice carried the weight of absolute commitment.
“In for a penny, in for a pound.”
BOOM!
And right after, he entered a chaotic region of Existence that was trying to pull his Weavings in every single direction simultaneously.

But his body was already pulsing and radiating Phonemes of The First Tongue, his immensity causing him to look like an unstoppable force with an indomitable momentum as he remained steady throughout until he was deposited...
BOOM!
Into a glorious place.
His vision adjusted as he looked around to see The Stoa of Dogmata.
Exactly as he saw in the Partial Simulation.
The endless colonnade of pillars stretched before him in impossible grandeur, each one carved from crystallized authority that predated differentiation itself.
Inscriptions of ancient Dogmata glowed upon their surfaces, some burning with cold fire, others weeping tears of solidified time.

The zones of doctrine shimmered between the pillars like veils separating different philosophical realities, and further in, multicolored clouds obscured the depths of this place in impenetrable mystery.
But what the Partial Simulation had not fully conveyed was the ground beneath his feet.
The earth he stood on was obsidian, black and gleaming like volcanic glass that had been polished by eons of existence.
Obsidian tendrils of crackling light spread across its surface like veins of destabilizing power, pulsing with energies that would have torn apart a weak THE Surface Depth entity in moments.
|Welcome to the Second Circle of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Current Location: The Stoa of Dogmata.|
|Caution: The ground itself carries destabilizing energies.|
Noah sensed and observed all of this, but the vast entirety of his attention turned to his right at this moment.
There, just like in the Partial Simulation, was the image of a serene and glorious woman.
Eon!
THUMP!
Okay, so his heart beat a little faster.
Not in a juvenile way and not because he was smitten, but in that anticipatory way when you met an extremely unpredictable variable that could collapse you at any moment.
And this entity had a light smile as she looked toward him with a light of intrigue.
This time around, he caught her gaze before she looked away in a bored fashion since he knew she would be here, and their gazes met.
She was small in stature, almost delicate in appearance, with features that held an ageless quality that made it impossible to determine if she was young or ancient beyond measure.
Her face was composed and regal, with high cheekbones and dark eyes that seemed to hold depths far greater than any physical form should contain.
There was a stillness about her, a sense of absolute control and purpose that radiated from her very being!

Her hair was dark as the void between stars, but strands of gold flowed through it like rivers of light through an endless night, catching the ambient glow of the Stoa in ways that seemed almost deliberate.
A white-blue robe covered her form, simple yet somehow more elegant than the most elaborate garments, as if the fabric itself knew it was privileged to drape across her shoulders.
And her eyes!
Oh!
Her pupils seemed to be the simplest and most common pupils, dark and unremarkable at first glance.
And yet...
|Warning.|
|You have stared into eyes that may harm your existence if you gaze for too long.|
|Recommendation: Limit direct visual contact.|
Staring into her eyes alone for too long could harm him.
Noah’s gaze flashed with defiance at this as he blinked, and he cautiously floated toward this terrifying entity as he spoke out calmly.
“Hello.
You are one of the few cognizant beings I have met since the end of THE Fallout.
I am-”
As he was speaking, the terrifying entity seated ahead looked away into the depths of this domain.
Her voice came measured and unhurried, each word placed with the precision of someone who had spent eternities choosing exactly what to say and when to say it.
“I know who you are, Scale Breaker.
I watched you take your first stumbling steps in the Primordial Genesis Shore.”
BOOM!
Her gaze finally settled on him with the weight of ages.
“Whether you have grown bolder or merely more foolish since then, I have not yet decided.”
BOOM!
Her words were heavy as Noah instantly became stern.
She was there?
In Ginnungagap?!
He did not recall seeing anything about her or even closely resembling her in all the Ginnu Lifeforms there.
She looked at his silence and surprise as she continued looking ahead calmly, her posture unchanged, her attention seemingly fixed on something in the distant depths that only she could perceive.
Noah’s reply came cautiously, his voice measured.
“You were there when THE Primordial Chaos, THE Creature, and THE Living Temporal fought?
And none of them sensed you either?
You weren’t involved in that entire conflict?”
At such words, THE Secretive Eon’s expression remained unchanged.
When she spoke, there was no defensiveness, no need to justify.
Only quiet, glorious, interminable certainty.
“THE Creature knew I was there from the moment he arrived.
The others...” A slight pause came that was almost dismissive.
“They saw what they expected to see, which was nothing at all.
But that is the way of things.”
Her head tilted, a fraction of movement that somehow conveyed vast consideration.
“You call what happened there a conflict.
Perhaps it was, from where you stood.
But it was not anything much.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4702: Eon! IV
paragraphs: Intuition.

Noah said these words because truly, his intuition was one of the few things he followed, paired by the fact that no matter how dangerous this could potentially be, he had an Anchor Point he could go back to.
And yet THE Secretive Eon reacted as if she had heard these exact words before.
Noah thought about things carefully before he kept his distance and proceeded to sit down just like her while staring out into the same direction she was staring out to.
He felt like he had to choose his next few words carefully as this entity was a bit unique, but there could be something to gain. When it came to entities like her, it was always information.
Much of Existence was filled with mysteries, but entities like her held vast knowledge already due to their power.
So he began simply after he gathered his thoughts.

“Before THE Fallout, I had a conversation with THE Living Paradox similar to this. Right before he initiated everything. Meeting someone else like him after THE Fallout felt unique, and thus my intuition brought me here.” He kept his gaze fixed on the distant expanse ahead. “When the other side is not trying to collapse me, I find the conversations can be revealing.”

His words were calm, and when THE Secretive Eon heard them, she scoffed quietly while keeping her gaze ahead. Her hair flickered with radiance, strands of gold catching light that seemed to come from nowhere.
“You would place me and THE Living Paradox on the same pedestal? I find myself wondering whether that speaks more to how highly you think of him or how highly you think of yourself.”
Something flickered in her dark eyes that might have been amusement.

“You are the weakest of those four, and yet you move as if you stand among equals, as if the gap between you and them is merely a matter of time rather than an insurmountable chasm. You have not met or known of others apart from them, but still you move the way you do, still you hold yourself as you hold yourself.”
Her head tilted slightly.

“I can see it in your eyes, Scale Breaker. That same look I have seen in others across the ages. That arrogance, that feeling of infinite self-worth, as if Existence itself is meant to be yours, as if you were destined for something grand and all of this is merely the prelude to your inevitable ascension.”
Her gaze remained fixed on the distant expanse, seeing something far beyond the Stoa.

“It is never so easy. A few laid claims before you and learned that truth in ways they did not survive. THE Primordial Paradox laid claim to Paradox itself and believed himself infallible, untouchable, beyond the reach of consequence. Where is he now? Eaten. Devoured. Not a shred of his Weavings remain, and he was a million times more powerful than you are at this moment.”
BOOM!
Shocking words came from her as Noah sternly kept his gaze straight, his mind buzzing.
“THE Primordial Paradox is collapsed? Then THE Living Paradox...”
THE Secretive Eon waved her hand with a small gesture of absolute finality.

“THE Living Paradox consumed THE Primordial Paradox and became him, a creature with no claim devouring one who held absolute claim, and in doing so expressing that ideology more purely than its original bearer ever did.” The faintest curve touched her lips. “Paradox, it seems, has a sense of irony.”
She fell silent for a long moment before speaking again.

“I waste my breath saying this, and I know that I do, for more often than not those like you listen to no one, but I will say it regardless because perhaps this time will be different, though I suspect it will not be.”
Her gaze remained fixed on the endless expanse ahead.

“Take a step back, Scale Breaker, and reevaluate yourself. Do not believe yourself something special. Do not think that you have measures or protections that others lacked, or convince yourself that it is somehow impossible for you to die because of who you are. THE Primordial Paradox had many plans and many contingencies, just as you do, and he was collapsed all the same. THE Creature had many plans and many contingencies, and yet here we are, speaking of what became of them rather than speaking with them.”
Her head turned slightly, just enough that he could see the edge of her composed features.
“Existence is grand and unfathomable. THE Creature is something. THE Living Paradox is trying to be something. Others are already something. You, as of this moment, are not anything.”
There was no malice in her voice, no contempt, only truth delivered with the patience of one who had seen this conversation play out countless times across countless ages!

“If I were to offer you counsel, and I am not certain you are capable of hearing it, I would tell you to unmake everything you are and become something small, a worm or a fly, something that moves through Existence without drawing its gaze. Grow in silence, gather strength in shadow, and only when you have reached THE Absolute Depth should you allow yourself to unfold into what you truly wish to be.”
Her dark eyes finally met his directly, and the weight of ages pressed against his existence.

“Otherwise, you are courting death with every step you take, every single step, and sooner or later death will answer your courtship.” Her lips curved into something that was almost sad. “It always does.”
THE Secretive Eon told him how he should live.
But Noah’s eyes burned with defiance.
Him? Crawl like a worm until he was powerful enough to stand?
What would his Tyranny say to such cowardice? Tyranny did not grovel. Tyranny did not hide. Tyranny stood in the open and dared Existence to challenge it.
What would his Quintessence stand for if he abandoned everything that made him who he was? The very core of his being rejected the notion of diminishing himself for the sake of survival.
How brilliant would his Mana shine if he smothered it beneath caution and fear? Mana was meant to blaze. It was meant to illuminate. It was not meant to be hidden away like something shameful.
No.
He sat there grandly without replying, but one could see the air of defiance around him that seemed to reject every single word of THE Secretive Eon.
He would not become a worm.
He would not become a fly.
He would remain exactly what he was, and he would grow stronger as exactly what he was, and if Existence sought to collapse him for it, then Existence would find that he did not collapse easily.
And THE Secretive Eon saw this without even turning her head.
She smiled with the expression of someone who had witnessed this same defiance countless times before and knew precisely how it ended.
Then she continued looking on ahead, saying nothing more.

chapters.title: Chapter 4703: I Am!
paragraphs: What does it mean to be oneself?

Many across the ages have grappled with this question, and none have arrived at an answer that satisfies all. Some say the self is merely the sum of one’s experiences, a collection of memories and traumas and joys that accumulate like sediment at the bottom of a river.
Others argue that the self is something innate, a core that exists before experience, before memory, before even the first breath of consciousness.

There are those who believe the self is an illusion, a story we tell ourselves to make sense of the chaos that surrounds us. And there are those who believe the self is the only thing that truly exists, with everything else being merely a reflection of our inner truth projected outward onto the canvas of reality.
But perhaps the most profound truth about the self is this: everyone will tell you who your self is, and who to be.

Parents will shape you in their image. Teachers will mold you according to their ideals. Friends will influence you with their expectations. Enemies will define you by opposition. Society will demand conformity.

Power will demand submission. And through it all, countless voices will whisper and shout and scream about who you should become, how you should act, what you should believe, and why you should change.
But in the end, one can only be themselves.

Because nobody knows how you can be your true self apart from you. No sage, no ancient entity watching from the shadows of existence can tell you who you are at your core. They can offer counsel. They can share wisdom. They can warn of dangers and promise rewards. But the fundamental question of selfhood can only be answered by the one asking it.

And sometimes, the answer comes not through contemplation, but through assertion, through defiant declaration. Not through becoming what others say you should be, but through embodying what you know yourself to already be.
Noah’s defiance was clear as at this time, he felt his Existence and Phonemes buzzing while he looked directly at the calm figure of THE Secretive Eon.

“I am realizing more and more that power comes in different forms.” His voice was steady, contemplative, yet underlaid with something that pulsed with growing conviction. “If I look at my power now, I could strictly designate myself as a THE Surface Depth or THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity, and that would be accurate. But it is also inaccurate, because I can do things no Intermediate Depth entity could do. I was able to go to the Earliest Folds. To the Infinite Unfurling. To Ginnungagap itself. I was able to evade the imprisonment in THE Belly of Existence and THE Loom when others could not. I was able to do things that no THE Intermediate entity could do, without ever stepping into THE...”
BOOM!

His eyes shone with an unfathomable light of immensity. A profound and unique air filled with ancientness and immensity began to radiate from him, and the very Stoa of Dogmata seemed to tremble in recognition of something taking shape.

“So when you say I am not at the level of THE Creature or you, perhaps in some aspects that is true. But there are things I can do that THE Creature cannot do. There are places I have been that THE Creature has not reached. I have done with The First Tongue what THE Creature never did. There are truths I have touched that THE Creature has not grasped.” His gaze burned brighter. “And if that is the case, then in those aspects, I am more powerful than THE Creature. In those aspects, I exceed him.”
BOOM!

Blue-gold light surged around him with profundity, his eyes shining like blazing suns as if he was extrapolating and expanding a glorious epiphany that had been building within him since the moment he first touched The First Tongue.

“You say I do not have any comparable power to them. That I am weaker than them. That I should hide until I am stronger, should crawl like a worm until I earn the right to stand.” His voice did not rise, did not fall, but each word landed with the weight of absolute conviction.

“And yet I believe I can move freely just like them. Because what Surface or Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity can sit here and talk to you without worry? THE Creature could talk to you as I am talking to you now. THE Living Paradox could do so. And now, I am doing so.”
He let that truth settle into the air between them.

“Because in some ways, my standing, my glory, my distinction, the very weight of my name, in some ways I am already like you and all others. That is my Way. That is my Immensity.” His eyes blazed with finality.
“I am not strong. I am not weak. I simply am.”
BOOM!
His blood buzzed. His Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons buzzed. His Organ of Civilization buzzed!

His mind buzzed as he felt like he had grasped and asserted an inner truth about himself that nobody could deny, a truth that Existence itself was forced to acknowledge, to the point that he embodied it!
|Your Way has been observed and asserted and embodied with unfathomable clarity.|
|You have done something only those exceeding THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty can do.|
|Background Information from The First Tongue: Way Expression at Fundamental Depth - Declaration|
|At THE Fundamental Depth, an entity’s Way can be expressed through Declaration, the act of speaking truth into Existence and having Existence reshape itself to accommodate that truth.|
|Existential Declaration:|
|- Statements made with full authority become temporarily true|
|- “There is no fire here” could temporarily negate all flame-based Principles in an area|
|- “My enemy cannot move” could generate a Principle of Binding that locks a target in place|
|- “I am invincible” could create temporary immunity to all forms of harm|
|- The more absolute the declaration, the greater the cost to maintain|
|Way Manifestation:|
|- The entity can manifest their Way as a tangible force in reality|
|- A Way of Judgment could manifest as scales that weigh the sins of all present|
|- A Way of Death could manifest as an aura that withers all it touches|
|- These manifestations are extensions of the entity’s very being|
|Background Information from The First Tongue: Way Expression at Absolute Depth - Embodiment|

|At THE Absolute Depth, an entity’s Way transcends expression and becomes Embodiment. The entity does not merely use their Way or declare their Way. They become their Way. Their existence and their truth become indistinguishable.|
|Conceptual Embodiment:|
|- The entity’s Way becomes so intertwined with Observable Existence that they essentially become a living law|
|- THE Living Paradox embodies contradiction itself|
|- THE Creature embodies the primordial nature of existence itself|
|- THE Primordial Chaos embodies entropy and disorder itself|
|- Attacking them means attacking the very concept they represent|
|Existential Veto:|
|- Can simply declare that something does not apply to them, permanently|
|- Unlike temporary immunity, this veto becomes a fact of their existence|
|- “Death does not touch me” could become a permanent truth rather than a maintained declaration|
|- This explains how beings like THE Living Paradox can embody contradictions that would destroy lesser entities|
|Way Legislation:|
|- The entity can legislate truths related to their Way into permanent existence|
|- THE Living Paradox could legislate “Contradictions can coexist” as a permanent law of reality|
|- THE Creature could legislate “All things that exist are my children” as an absolute truth|
|- These legislations reshape Observable Existence itself|
|Sovereign Absolutism:|
|- Within the scope of their Way, the entity’s authority is absolute|
|- No being of lesser Depth can contest their sovereignty within their domain of embodiment|
|- Only other Absolute Depth entities can challenge their legislations|
|Current Assessment:|
|What you have just done was a partial form of Embodiment only possible from THE Absolute Depth of Absolute Sovereignty stage.|
|You have embodied your Way spectacularly to declare that your power cannot be designated into any specific stage.|
|Your existence has deemed your Depth to be THE Formless Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|Your power and capabilities are too unique to fit into any demarcated Depth.|
|You are not Surface. You are not Intermediate. You are not Fundamental. You are not Absolute.|
|You are Formless.|
|You simply are.|
HUUM!
His existence buzzed with glory!
THE Formless Depth!
Oh!

A profound and unique air filled with ancientness and immensity began to radiate from him, and the very Stoa of Dogmata seemed to tremble in recognition of something taking shape.
“So when you say I am not at the level of THE Creature or you, perhaps in some aspects that is true.
But there are things I can do that THE Creature cannot do.
There are places I have been that THE Creature has not reached.
I have done with The First Tongue what THE Creature never did.
There are truths I have touched that THE Creature has not grasped.” His gaze burned brighter.
“And if that is the case, then in those aspects, I am more powerful than THE Creature.
In those aspects, I exceed him.”
BOOM!

Blue-gold light surged around him with profundity, his eyes shining like blazing suns as if he was extrapolating and expanding a glorious epiphany that had been building within him since the moment he first touched The First Tongue.
“You say I do not have any comparable power to them.
That I am weaker than them.
That I should hide until I am stronger, should crawl like a worm until I earn the right to stand.” His voice did not rise, did not fall, but each word landed with the weight of absolute conviction.
“And yet I believe I can move freely just like them.
Because what Surface or Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity can sit here and talk to you without worry?
THE Creature could talk to you as I am talking to you now.
THE Living Paradox could do so.
And now, I am doing so.”
He let that truth settle into the air between them.
“Because in some ways, my standing, my glory, my distinction, the very weight of my name, in some ways I am already like you and all others.
That is my Way.
That is my Immensity.” His eyes blazed with finality.
“I am not strong.
I am not weak.
I simply am.”
BOOM!
His blood buzzed.
His Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons buzzed.
His Organ of Civilization buzzed!

His mind buzzed as he felt like he had grasped and asserted an inner truth about himself that nobody could deny, a truth that Existence itself was forced to acknowledge, to the point that he embodied it!
|Your Way has been observed and asserted and embodied with unfathomable clarity.|
|You have done something only those exceeding THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty can do.|
|Background Information from The First Tongue: Way Expression at Fundamental Depth - Declaration|
|At THE Fundamental Depth, an entity’s Way can be expressed through Declaration, the act of speaking truth into Existence and having Existence reshape itself to accommodate that truth.|
|Existential Declaration:|
|- Statements made with full authority become temporarily true|
|- “There is no fire here” could temporarily negate all flame-based Principles in an area|
|- “My enemy cannot move” could generate a Principle of Binding that locks a target in place|
|- “I am invincible” could create temporary immunity to all forms of harm|
|- The more absolute the declaration, the greater the cost to maintain|
|Way Manifestation:|
|- The entity can manifest their Way as a tangible force in reality|
|- A Way of Judgment could manifest as scales that weigh the sins of all present|
|- A Way of Death could manifest as an aura that withers all it touches|
|- These manifestations are extensions of the entity’s very being|
|Background Information from The First Tongue: Way Expression at Absolute Depth - Embodiment|
|At THE Absolute Depth, an entity’s Way transcends expression and becomes Embodiment.
The entity does not merely use their Way or declare their Way.
They become their Way.
Their existence and their truth become indistinguishable.|
|Conceptual Embodiment:|
|- The entity’s Way becomes so intertwined with Observable Existence that they essentially become a living law|
|- THE Living Paradox embodies contradiction itself|
|- THE Creature embodies the primordial nature of existence itself|
|- THE Primordial Chaos embodies entropy and disorder itself|
|- Attacking them means attacking the very concept they represent|
|Existential Veto:|
|- Can simply declare that something does not apply to them, permanently|
|- Unlike temporary immunity, this veto becomes a fact of their existence|
|- “Death does not touch me” could become a permanent truth rather than a maintained declaration|
|- This explains how beings like THE Living Paradox can embody contradictions that would destroy lesser entities|
|Way Legislation:|
|- The entity can legislate truths related to their Way into permanent existence|
|- THE Living Paradox could legislate “Contradictions can coexist” as a permanent law of reality|
|- THE Creature could legislate “All things that exist are my children” as an absolute truth|
|- These legislations reshape Observable Existence itself|
|Sovereign Absolutism:|
|- Within the scope of their Way, the entity’s authority is absolute|
|- No being of lesser Depth can contest their sovereignty within their domain of embodiment|
|- Only other Absolute Depth entities can challenge their legislations|
|Current Assessment:|
|What you have just done was a partial form of Embodiment only possible from THE Absolute Depth of Absolute Sovereignty stage.|
|You have embodied your Way spectacularly to declare that your power cannot be designated into any specific stage.|
|Your existence has deemed your Depth to be THE Formless Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|Your power and capabilities are too unique to fit into any demarcated Depth.|
|You are not Surface.
You are not Intermediate.
You are not Fundamental.
You are not Absolute.|
|You are Formless.|
|You simply are.|
HUUM!
His existence buzzed with glory!
THE Formless Depth!

chapters.title: Chapter 4704: All Must Die I
paragraphs: Formless Depth.
Noah’s entire existence buzzed with unfathomable brightness as he felt his mind so clear.

What was this? His body felt freer, like a cool sensation was spreading across his existence as everything coursed with immensity and vibrancy. The very fabric of reality seemed sharper and more defined!
It even felt more colorful all around, enough to make one ask: was this why people took drugs? Because it felt fucking fantastic.
But his drug right now was an immense sense ofClarity and Conviction.

Because it was unfathomably clear to him who and what he was. He felt like he could breathe much easier after knowing and accepting his Existence. There was no more uncertainty, no more grasping at definitions that did not fit, no more trying to squeeze himself into categories that were never designed to contain something like him.
He was Formless.
He simply was.
And in this clarity, he learned many things.
First was just how ridiculous those who attainedTHE Absolute Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywere.
Embodimentwas the defining factor, the thing that separated the truly transcendent from everything else.

With Embodiment, one could never truly collapse entities likeTHE Living Paradox, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Creature. These beings had undergone a metamorphosis so complete that they no longer existed as separate things from the concepts they wielded. They had become those concepts. Their flesh was philosophy. Their blood was ideology.
Their very breath was the manifestation of truths so fundamental that Existence itself could not function without them.

THE Living Paradox embodied contradiction itself. Every impossibility, every logical inconsistency, every thing that should not be able to exist yet did, all of it flowed through him like rivers through a landscape. To collapse him would require the elimination of paradox from all of Existence, and paradox was woven into the very fabric of reality.
How could something exist and not exist simultaneously? It shouldn’t be possible, and yet it happened constantly. That impossibility wasTHE Living Paradox.

THE Creature embodied the primordial nature of existence itself. Supposedly, every entity that had ever existed, every Civilization that had ever risen and fallen, every thought that had ever been conceived, all of it traced its lineage back to him in some fashion.

THE Primordial Chaos embodied entropy and disorder itself. The gradual decay of all ordered things, the inevitable march toward dissolution, the fundamental truth that nothing could remain static forever, all of this was his domain.
And if you wanted to collapse them, to truly and permanently end their existence, it meant attacking the very concepts they represented.

If one wanted to collapse THE Creature, did that not mean they had to collapse Existence itself? How could you destroy the embodiment of existence without destroying existence in the process? It was a logical impossibility, a paradox in its own right.

As he thought of this, Noah’s mind buzzed as he released beams of blue-gold light from his eyes. The revelation was too grand to contain, too profound to keep within the boundaries of his physical form!

His expression was one of wonder. "Is this why THE Living Paradox attacked THE Creature with THE Fallout? It was an attack on Existence itself, altering Existence overall, which would in turn be an attack on THE Creature’s Absolute Embodiment?"

He felt like he was grasping at things he didn’t even know existed. The architecture of power at the highest levels was so far beyond what he had previously understood that it made his earlier conceptions seem childish in comparison.

THE Fallout wasn’t just destruction for destruction’s sake. It was a surgical strike against the very concept of Existence, designed to wound THE Creature in a way that conventional attacks never could.
Brilliant.
Terrifying, catastrophic, and utterly monstrous in its implications, but brilliant nonetheless!
At this time, in the middle of this grand epiphany as his existence continued to buzz and a transformation was underway, THE Secretive Eonspoke.
"I may have judged you too harshly."
There was no urgency in her tone and no surprise, only the calm acknowledgment of something she had observed.

"I dismissed you entirely when we first spoke, and I must say I was even disappointed. Another fledgling stumbling into waters far too deep, I thought. Another one who would drown before learning to swim."She paused, her dark eyes settling on him with renewed consideration. "But it appears you have potential."

"Potential. That is what The First Tongue stood for the most, in the end. The capacity to become something more than what you currently are. I considered you a fledgling before, one who did not understand the depths he was wading into. You should now be considered something slightly more. A blind man with a walking stick, perhaps. Still unable to see, but at least capable of feeling your way forward without stumbling into every obstacle."
Something flickered in her dark eyes.
"Your conviction was not shaken by my words. So you can be considered somewhat sufficient."
Her lips curved into something that was almost a smile.

"But understand this, Scale Breaker. If you claim yourself to be as profound and as powerful as THE Creature or THE Primordial Chaos, you are also opening yourself up to challenges just like them. You are declaring yourself a player in games that have consumed beings far greater than yourself. You are opening yourself up to a challenge from someone like me."
The almost-smile became something more dangerous.
"What if I wished to challenge you right now? Would your power be able to stop me?"
BOOM!
Her expression remained calm throughout, serene and composed even as that dangerous smile played at the corners of her lips.
In response to her words, Noah closed his eyes and actually took a deep breath, as if he was smelling Existence in a newfound manner for the first time!

The air tasted different now. Reality felt different against his senses. Everything was sharper, cleaner, more defined. He let that breath fill him completely, let the cool clarity of his new understanding spread through every fiber of his being.
And when his eyes opened, they held an imperious gaze that seemed to smile slightly while radiating an unbound sense of tyranny.

"If you challenge me right now, even if I lose, I would have already won." His voice was steady, calm, utterly without fear. "That I can definitively and gloriously say: even you, THE Secretive Eon, are not someone that I fear being collapsed by."
Oh.
Fuck, that felt good to say.
The words had come out naturally, without hesitation, without the careful calculation that would have accompanied them before his transformation. Because they were true!
He didn’t fear her. He didn’t fear collapse. He didn’t fear anything at this moment except perhaps the limitations of his own imagination in exploring what he had become.
There were so many things he currently wanted to do. So many things he wanted to try! THE Existential Ceiling? It could absolutely fuck itself right off.

As his existence adapted toTHE Formless Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, profound changes were spreading even toTHE Infiniverse and Ruination.His connected bodies were experiencing the ripples of his transformation, and there was so much to be done, so much to explore, so much to understand about what he had become.
But first, there was stillTHE Secretive Eon.

And from her, there may still be things to gain. This meeting was already fruitful beyond his initial expectations. He had come seeking information and had instead stumbled into a transformation that redefined his very existence. What else might he obtain if he continued this conversation?
So he looked at her with a calm gaze, and after his words, she rose up from her position.
Oh?
