chapters.title: Chapter 4713: Archai I
paragraphs: Imperialism.
It was a word that carried weight across every corner of Observable Existence, even if most entities never consciously recognized it for what it was.

At its core, imperialism was simple. It was the extension of power beyond one’s original boundaries. The reaching out of influence to encompass that which did not originally belong to you. The transformation of the foreign into the familiar, the independent into the dependent, the free into the claimed.

Many viewed imperialism through a narrow lens of morality, as if it were simply good or evil, justified or unjustified. But existence itself didn’t operate on such clean distinctions. The truth was far more uncomfortable.
Nearly every force of power utilized imperialism.
If you had power, you were a colonizer.

The first apocalypse Noah had gone through was due in some form to imperialism. The Beast World, or really, the Demon World had stretched out their hands to encompass a tiny blue planet that had never asked for their attention. They had looked upon this planet and seen something to be claimed, to be conquered, to be absorbed into their greater sphere of influence. The lives lost, the civilizations disrupted, the entire trajectory of humanity altered, all of it stemmed from that fundamental impulse to expand.
And it wasn’t unique to those particular invaders.

Every Civilization that had ever risen to prominence had done so through expansion. Every Way that had ever achieved THE classification had grown by encompassing more and more of reality within its framework. Every entity that had ever attained Absolute Depth had done so by making their truth so pervasive, so all-encompassing, that existence itself bent to accommodate them.
THE Creature embodied existence itself. Was that not the ultimate act of imperialism? To claim the very concept of being as your own domain?
THE Living Paradox had consumed THE Primordial Paradox. Was that not conquest at the most fundamental level?
THE Primordial Chaosspread entropy and disorder wherever he touched. Was that not the expansion of influence by another name?

Imperialism covered the vastness of existence like a blanket that most entities never noticed because they were already wrapped within it. If there was a Way to expand, if there was a method to grow one’s influence and claim more of reality as one’s own, then perhaps Imperialism itself would be the grandest Way of all.
Because in the end, existence rewarded those who reached.
And it consumed those who didn’t.
Across his existence, Noah could also be considered to have utilized imperialism over the last months and years.

He had conquered many lands and expanded his influence across existence. He had claimed territories, absorbed authorities, and extended the reach of his Civilization into domains that had never heard his name before. Each victory, each acquisition, each new connection forged was another thread in the grand expansion he was weaving.
And the latest act of imperialism was THE Infiniverse executing a partial Embodiment and beginning to claim Muspelheim.
Now, Noah had to go through with it.

He had to get things ready, because even though he had just obtained a Fragment of an Axiom and held THE Formless Depth, he couldn’t just rush in without a plan. The main question remained, and it was a heavy one.
How could he take care of Fundamental Depth entities and even half-a-step Absolute Depth entities?

He had his means, yes. The Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem could lower their Depth temporarily. His Formless Depth meant he existed outside conventional power comparisons. His mastery of The First Tongue gave him tools that most entities couldn’t even comprehend.
But their quantifiable immensity and weight was still greater than his.
The answer, of course, was in his Formless Depth.
"Are things ready?"
He asked Ruination lightly, and her reply came soon after.
|Integration Status - Final Phase|
|The 9 newly forged Phonemes are finishing their integration with core Philologies.|
|Perpetual Harvest: Integration at 97%. Philological structure adapting to incorporate new linguistic elements.|
|Undifferentiated Mana: Integration at 94%. Core framework being restructured at fundamental level.|
|Cheating Architect: Integration at 91%. Novel pathways forming between existing and new Phonemes.|
|Result: All integrated Principles are beginning to transform into something else.Classification pending.|
|First Tongue Proficiency Update|
|Continued advancement as a Perfect Speaker with newly forged Phonemes has unlocked additional capabilities.|
|New Capability: Information extraction from complex, corrupted, or ancient domains.|
|The First Tongue has been utilized to study the Stoa of Dogmata and THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Purpose: To uncover the Weavings of power used by entities in higher stages before differentiation.|
|Discovery: Ancient expressions of power predate modern methodology.|
|Ancient Expression Identified: Aletheia|
|Classification: THE Surface Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Assertion|
|Meaning: "Unconcealment" or "Truth revealed"|

|Core Principle: Aletheia is the act of revealing a truth that was always present but hidden from perception. Unlike modern Assertion which requests Existence’s acknowledgment, Aletheia operates on the understanding that truth is not created but uncovered.|
|Key Distinction: The speaker does not declare something to be true. They unveil what has always been true but was concealed.|
|Philosophical Foundation: Truth exists independently of observation. The skilled practitioner simply removes the veil that hides it from others.|
Noah’s eyes sharpened.
Right.

Most THE Entities at this time used Assertion, Imposition, Declaration, and Embodiment for THE Surface Depth, Intermediate, Fundamental, and Absolute respectively.These were the modern expressions of power, the methods that entities in the current era utilized to exert their authority over reality.
But the enemies he might face from times of or before differentiation were different.

They utilized Dogma, a more powerful form of Imposition that he had already encountered. And now, Ruination had uncovered the equivalent of what methods the truly powerful utilized for THE Fundamental and Absolute stages.
THE Surface Depth ancient expression was deemed to be Aletheia.
But the ancient expressions of power above Intermediate were something else entirely.
|Ancient Expression Identified: Thesis|
|Classification: THE Fundamental Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Declaration|
|Meaning: "A placing" or "A proposition set forth"|

|Core Principle: Thesis is the act of placing a new truth into Existence that did not exist before and having it function as if it always had. It operates through philosophical proposition rather than raw authority.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Createstemporarynew Principles by proposing them into existence.|
|- The proposition must be logically coherent within its own framework.|
|- Other entities can challenge a Thesis through dialectic debate.|
|- A successfully challenged Thesis collapses entirely.|
|- An unchallenged Thesis becomes increasingly real over time, eventually solidifying into permanent truth.|

|Philosophical Foundation: Thesis draws from the tradition of dialectic, where truth is arrived at through proposition and challenge. A Thesis is not a declaration of power but an invitation to debate. If the proposition survives scrutiny, it earns its place in reality.|

|Example Application: "I propose that within this space, strength is determined by wisdom" creates a temporary Principle where physical power scales with intellectual understanding. If no entity can successfully argue against this proposition, it solidifies into local truth.|
Oh!
|Ancient Expression Identified: Apophasis|
|Classification: THE Absolute Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Embodiment|
|Meaning: "Denial" or "Negative declaration"|

|Core Principle: Apophasis is the most profound and paradoxical of the ancient expressions. It operates through negation, defining what something is by declaring what it is not. At its highest level, an entity using Apophasis becomes so thoroughly defined by what they are not that they transcend normal limitation.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Operates through systematic negation rather than positive declaration.|
|- "I am not mortal" is stronger than "I am immortal" because it eliminates the concept rather than opposing it.|
|- At its peak, an entity can negate the very concepts that could harm them.|
|- Can only be countered by an Apophasis that negates the negation, creating paradox.|

|Philosophical Foundation: Apophasis comes from the tradition of negative theology, where many understood not by what it is but by what it is not. This approach recognizes that positive definitions always limit, while negation liberates. To say "I am strong" binds you to a concept of strength. To say "I am not weak" removes weakness without binding you to any particular definition of its opposite.|

|Example Application: "I am not bound by causality. I am not subject to time. I am not limited by space." Each negation removes a fundamental constraint until the entity exists outside normal parameters entirely. They have not declared themselves free; they have simply removed the chains.|

|Combat Application: Apophasis at its highest level is nearly unbeatable because there is nothing to attack. An entity who has negated enough of their definable qualities becomes something that cannot be targeted by conventional means. The only counter is to negate their negations, but this creates paradoxes that can destabilize local reality.|
Noah looked at the prompts with bright eyes.
They were....ridiculously heavy!

He had claimed territories, absorbed authorities, and extended the reach of his Civilization into domains that had never heard his name before.
Each victory, each acquisition, each new connection forged was another thread in the grand expansion he was weaving.
And the latest act of imperialism was THE Infiniverse executing a partial Embodiment and beginning to claim Muspelheim.
Now, Noah had to go through with it.
He had to get things ready, because even though he had just obtained a Fragment of an Axiom and held THE Formless Depth, he couldn’t just rush in without a plan.
The main question remained, and it was a heavy one.
How could he take care of Fundamental Depth entities and even half-a-step Absolute Depth entities?
He had his means, yes.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem could lower their Depth temporarily.
His Formless Depth meant he existed outside conventional power comparisons.
His mastery of The First Tongue gave him tools that most entities couldn’t even comprehend.
But their quantifiable immensity and weight was still greater than his.
The answer, of course, was in his Formless Depth.
"Are things ready?"
He asked Ruination lightly, and her reply came soon after.
|Integration Status - Final Phase|
|The 9 newly forged Phonemes are finishing their integration with core Philologies.|
|Perpetual Harvest: Integration at 97%.
Philological structure adapting to incorporate new linguistic elements.|
|Undifferentiated Mana: Integration at 94%.
Core framework being restructured at fundamental level.|
|Cheating Architect: Integration at 91%.
Novel pathways forming between existing and new Phonemes.|
|Result: All integrated Principles are beginning to transform into something else.Classification pending.|
|First Tongue Proficiency Update|
|Continued advancement as a Perfect Speaker with newly forged Phonemes has unlocked additional capabilities.|
|New Capability: Information extraction from complex, corrupted, or ancient domains.|
|The First Tongue has been utilized to study the Stoa of Dogmata and THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Purpose: To uncover the Weavings of power used by entities in higher stages before differentiation.|
|Discovery: Ancient expressions of power predate modern methodology.|
|Ancient Expression Identified: Aletheia|
|Classification: THE Surface Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Assertion|
|Meaning: "Unconcealment" or "Truth revealed"|
|Core Principle: Aletheia is the act of revealing a truth that was always present but hidden from perception.
Unlike modern Assertion which requests Existence’s acknowledgment, Aletheia operates on the understanding that truth is not created but uncovered.|
|Key Distinction: The speaker does not declare something to be true.
They unveil what has always been true but was concealed.|
|Philosophical Foundation: Truth exists independently of observation.
The skilled practitioner simply removes the veil that hides it from others.|
Noah’s eyes sharpened.
Right.

Most THE Entities at this time used Assertion, Imposition, Declaration, and Embodiment for THE Surface Depth, Intermediate, Fundamental, and Absolute respectively.These were the modern expressions of power, the methods that entities in the current era utilized to exert their authority over reality.
But the enemies he might face from times of or before differentiation were different.
They utilized Dogma, a more powerful form of Imposition that he had already encountered.
And now, Ruination had uncovered the equivalent of what methods the truly powerful utilized for THE Fundamental and Absolute stages.
THE Surface Depth ancient expression was deemed to be Aletheia.
But the ancient expressions of power above Intermediate were something else entirely.
|Ancient Expression Identified: Thesis|
|Classification: THE Fundamental Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Declaration|
|Meaning: "A placing" or "A proposition set forth"|
|Core Principle: Thesis is the act of placing a new truth into Existence that did not exist before and having it function as if it always had.
It operates through philosophical proposition rather than raw authority.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Createstemporarynew Principles by proposing them into existence.|
|- The proposition must be logically coherent within its own framework.|
|- Other entities can challenge a Thesis through dialectic debate.|
|- A successfully challenged Thesis collapses entirely.|
|- An unchallenged Thesis becomes increasingly real over time, eventually solidifying into permanent truth.|
|Philosophical Foundation: Thesis draws from the tradition of dialectic, where truth is arrived at through proposition and challenge.
A Thesis is not a declaration of power but an invitation to debate.
If the proposition survives scrutiny, it earns its place in reality.|
|Example Application: "I propose that within this space, strength is determined by wisdom" creates a temporary Principle where physical power scales with intellectual understanding.
If no entity can successfully argue against this proposition, it solidifies into local truth.|
Oh!
|Ancient Expression Identified: Apophasis|
|Classification: THE Absolute Depth equivalent (Pre-Differentiation Era)|
|Modern Equivalent: Embodiment|
|Meaning: "Denial" or "Negative declaration"|
|Core Principle: Apophasis is the most profound and paradoxical of the ancient expressions.
It operates through negation, defining what something is by declaring what it is not.
At its highest level, an entity using Apophasis becomes so thoroughly defined by what they are not that they transcend normal limitation.|
|Characteristics:|
|- Operates through systematic negation rather than positive declaration.|
|- "I am not mortal" is stronger than "I am immortal" because it eliminates the concept rather than opposing it.|
|- At its peak, an entity can negate the very concepts that could harm them.|
|- Can only be countered by an Apophasis that negates the negation, creating paradox.|
|Philosophical Foundation: Apophasis comes from the tradition of negative theology, where many understood not by what it is but by what it is not.
This approach recognizes that positive definitions always limit, while negation liberates.
To say "I am strong" binds you to a concept of strength.
To say "I am not weak" removes weakness without binding you to any particular definition of its opposite.|
|Example Application: "I am not bound by causality.
I am not subject to time.
I am not limited by space." Each negation removes a fundamental constraint until the entity exists outside normal parameters entirely.
They have not declared themselves free; they have simply removed the chains.|
|Combat Application: Apophasis at its highest level is nearly unbeatable because there is nothing to attack.
An entity who has negated enough of their definable qualities becomes something that cannot be targeted by conventional means.
The only counter is to negate their negations, but this creates paradoxes that can destabilize local reality.|
Noah looked at the prompts with bright eyes.
They were....ridiculously heavy!

chapters.title: Chapter 4714: Archai II
paragraphs: The implications alone made his mind race with possibilities.Thesismeant that Fundamental Depth entities from before differentiation didn’t simply declare their truth into existence through overwhelming authority. They proposed it. They invited challenge. And if their logic held, if their framework was coherent, their truth became more real than anything a modern Declaration could achieve.
Because it had been tested. Because it had survived scrutiny.Because existence itself had examined it and found no flaw.
And Apophasis was even more terrifying.

Modern Embodiment meant becoming what you were, fully and completely merging with the concept you represented. But Apophasis was the opposite approach achieving the same result through a different path. It meant unbecoming what you were not. Systematically removing every limitation, every constraint, every definition that could be used against you until you existed outside the boundaries that trapped other entities.
An entity using Apophasis didn’t need to be stronger than their opponent.
They simply needed to not be something their opponent could affect.
|Current Capability Assessment|
|Based on your Formless Depth and current integration status:|

|Thesis: Potentially possible with great exertion of your Way and the elevation of your Principles. Success rate variable based on the coherence of your propositions and the philosophical framework of your opponents.|
|Partial Embodiment/Partial Apophasis: Currently impossible under normal circumstances unless your weight and immensity experiences significant increase.|
|Exception: Rare moments of existential epiphany or unique environmental factors may allow successful execution of Partial Embodiment or Partial Apophasis.|

|Note: Even this limited capability is a terrifying achievement brought to fruition solely by the nature of your Formless Depth. No other entity at your current stage could even approach these ancient expressions.|
Noah twirled the Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem as he read these prompts, feeling the pulsing power within his existence as he envisioned all the possibilities before him.
The main differences were becoming clear to him now.

Declaration versus Thesis. Both created truth, but through fundamentally different mechanisms. Declaration created through authority, through the raw weight of one’s Civilization imposing its reality upon existence. Thesis created through proposition, through logical coherence and philosophical framework.Declaration was harder to challenge directly but easier to overpower if you simply had more authority. Thesis was vulnerable to logical attack but became incredibly stable if left unchallenged.
An entity from Ginnungagap or Muspelheim using Thesis could potentially be defeated throughdebaterather than combat.
But an entity using Thesis that went unchallenged would have truth more solid than anything a modern Declarer could achieve.
And Embodiment versus Apophasis represented the same dichotomy at the highest level.
A clash between them would create fundamental paradoxes.
One entity saying "I am this" while another said "I am not that" in direct opposition could reshape local reality entirely.
At such a time, beside Noah in the sea of blue-gold Mana, the figure of the holographic Ruination appeared with an excited expression on her features.
|Master, I’ve managed to break down what your Principles could be distinguished as. I finished integrating the last few Phonemes into them.|
Her face was brilliant and filled with enthusiasm as she spoke, and illusory diagrams began to form around her as she explained.

|Your action of altering them and adding Phonemes into them elevated them to an ancient form of Principles that even Ginnu Lifeforms or Muspeli Lifeforms won’t necessarily have access to. So much has changed since before differentiation. The knowledge was lost. The methodology was forgotten. But from pushing The First Tongue to permeate freely in the Corrupted Vault, more of this information has been obtained.|
The diagrams shifted and reformed, displaying complex linguistic structures that pulsed with power.
|The designation given is: The Undifferentiated Principles. Archai.|
|Archai Classification - Overview|

|Before Principles became the stable truths that govern modern Observable Existence, they existed in a fluid, undifferentiated state called Archai (singular: Arche). These are the raw building blocks of reality, Principles that have not yet decided what they are.|
|Core Characteristics of Archai:|
|- Exist in superposition, capable of becoming any related Principle until observed or claimed.|
|- Respond to the philosophical framework of whoever interacts with them.|
|- Can be "convinced" to differentiate into specific Principles through argumentation and demonstration.|
|- Extremely dangerous because their undefined nature means they could become anything, including something lethal.|
|- Highly valuable because claiming an Arche allows one to shape what Principle it becomes.|
|Types of Archai Discovered:|

|Arche of Becoming: Undifferentiated principle of change, transformation, and potential. Could become Principles of Growth, Decay, Evolution, or Destruction. Responds to philosophical arguments about the nature of change.|
|Arche of Logos: Undifferentiated principle of reason, word, and order. Could become Principles of Truth, Language, Logic, or Structure. Responds to demonstrations of rational coherence.|
|Arche of Nous: Undifferentiated principle of mind, consciousness, and perception. Could become Principles of Thought, Awareness, Will, or Memory. Responds to displays of mental clarity and purpose.|
|Arche of Physis: Undifferentiated principle of nature and inherent quality. Could become Principles of Element, Essence, Character, or Being. Responds to authentic expression of one’s true nature.|
|Arche of Telos: Undifferentiated principle of purpose, and completion. Could become Principles of Apocalypse, Destiny, Goal, Death, or Fulfillment. Responds to clarity of purpose and direction.|
The waves of information were glorious ones, and Ruination ended the presentation with even grander revelations.
|Principle Evolution Status|
|Your own Principles are elevating to become Undifferentiated Principles.|
|This transformation befits your Undifferentiated self.|
|This transformation befits the quality of your Mana and your Way.|
|Your Principles are becoming Archai.|
|Confirmed Transformations In Progress:|
|- The Archai of Undifferentiated Mana|
|- The Archai of Perpetual Harvest|
|- The Archai of Cheating Architect|
|Additional Archai will bloom as integration continues.|
|Practical Application: These Archai can be examined for effectiveness alongside the ancient expressions of Dogma or Thesis in the Stoa of Dogmata and Muspelheim.|

|Note: You will be among the few entities since before differentiation to wield Principles in their Undifferentiated state. Even most Ginnu Lifeforms and Muspeli Lifeform and othet types of Lifeforms belonging to Primordial Realms may have lost access to them.|
Noah looked at all of these prompts with eyes that burned with blue-gold light.
Archai.
Undifferentiated Principles that had not yet decided what they were.

His Perpetual Harvest was becoming something that could be Growth or Decay or Evolution or Destruction depending on how he chose to express it. His Cheating Architect was becoming something that could bend rules in ways that hadn’t been defined yet. His Undifferentiated Mana was becoming the Arche of Mana itself, the raw building block from which all Mana-based Principles could potentially emerge.

Against modern opponents who used rigid, differentiated Principles, he would be able to shift and adapt in ways they couldn’t anticipate. Against ancient opponents who might recognize what Archai were, he would be speaking a language they understood but hadn’t heard in eons.
Either way, he had advantages that no one else, or very few, currently possessed!

chapters.title: Chapter 4715: Archai III
paragraphs: Archai!

For Noah, who had been looking to streamline his power so that he didn’t have so many different aspects of things that he didn’t utilize, the Archai were actually a profound and unique solution. Undifferentiated Principles that could become anything their grander concept represented.
This might even be a way to think about how he could bring down his 159 THE Stanchions of Infinity.
What use was such a high number when he only continued to utilize fully a select few of them?

The Stanchions were powerful, yes. Each one represented a facet of his authority, a pillar supporting the vast structure of his Civilization. But having 159 pillars meant that most of them stood unused, gathering metaphysicaldustwhile only a handful bore the actual weight of his advancement. It was inefficient. It was cluttered. And in a realm where clarity of purpose strengthened one’s Way, clutter was a liability.

If he could condense multiple Stanchions into single Archai that encompassed all their related concepts, he would lose nothing while gaining coherence. A single Arche of Apocalypse could replace a dozen Stanchions related to damage, annihilation, entropy, and collapse. A single Arche of Genesis could replace another dozen related to beginning, formation, growth, and manifestation.
Fewer pillars. Greater stability. More profound expression!
Well, it was something to consider for later.
As he thought about all of this, he focused on the main matter at hand which, at the end of the day, remained his immensity and weight paired up with knowledge of himself and his Formless Depth.
And the two directions now were Muspelheim and THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.
He was already in the Vault, so he simply had to make his entrance into Muspelheim.
"Is transfer to Muspelheim already possible?"
|Yes, Master.|
Ruination’s response came with accompanying diagrams that illustrated the pathway she had prepared.

|Muspelheim itself is similar to the early Veiled Shore of THE Creature or THE Infiniverse in that the corrupting effects of THE Fallout did not manage to permeate throughout fully. The primordial flames that define that realm acted as a natural barrier against the entropic decay that consumed so much else. That is how I was able to begin spreading the influence of our First Tongue for a few gigaparsecs already to begin gathering information in Muspelheim.|
The diagrams shifted, showing a crystalline structure forming in the space between realms.
|The entry into that primordial realm uniquely is going to be through a pathway that forms into a blue-gold Monolith. A...Dungeonthat you and your forces can use to enter as a doorway.|
Noah shook his head at this as he smiled.
A Dungeon.
He remembered how in the blue planet, countless Monoliths had appeared as Dungeons to facilitate gateways for the invasion of the forces of the Demons and Beasts.

Those towering structures had torn through the fabric of the Blue Planet’s reality, allowing armies to pour through from other realms when Dungeon Breaks occured. They had been instruments of conquest, tools ofimperialismwielded by forces that viewed humanity as nothing more than resources to be harvested.
And now, here they were.
He was the one creating the Monolith. He was the one opening the gateway. He was the one preparing to send forces through to claim territory that didn’t belong to him.
Existence turned, and those who had once been conquered became conquerors in their own right.

He breathed out at this moment as he raised his hand and felt the waves of blue-gold brilliance cascading through them. The Primus Mana responded to his will, swirling around his fingers like loyal servants eager to fulfill any command.
But eagerness wasn’t enough.

He needed more immensity and weight of his existence so that he could continue to support his Formless Depth to be capable of doing the things that others could not even imagine. He needed more Fragments of the Moirai Threads to get to nine so that he could have a full simulation until potential death. He needed to do many things.
And he knew he wasn’t the only one moving rapidly across existence at this moment.
THE Creature was not sitting still.
Nor was THE Living Paradox.
Nor was THE Primordial Chaos.

He was not the only one that could get stronger. All the others had been preparing for eons for this eruption of power. They had laid foundations while he was still learning what Mana even was. They had built Civilizations long befode he was struggling to survive his first apocalypse. They had accumulated weight and immensity across timescales that made his entire existence look like a single breath in an eternal conversation.
Who knew whether THE Creature or THE Living Paradox were already close to attaining the Second Scale of Existence?
There was no sitting still in such a terrifying environment.

Also, at this moment, even though it was hard, he would send another body to roam the Wastes of THE Fallout for the sole purpose of mapping and seeing if he could more easily locate Lumivara, Ul’moreth, The Fisherman, and others who had backed his Way.
They had likely been scattered when the chaos erupted. Finding them again was crucial, not just for the power they represented but because they had trusted him.
And he didn’t abandon those who trusted him.
Alongside that...
"Let’s go. To Muspelheim."
His voice carried the weight of decision, the finality of a course chosen and committed to.

"THE Living Spirit will be good practice for THE Living Elemental and the future Absolutes, and whether they can be toppled. Get Protos, Khor, Sigrid, Ra’Zan, and all the others who have attained THE to also join me soon. Their Depths will need to be forged in hardship and blood."
He paused, another thought crystallizing.
"Oh, and proceed to set another anchor point here."
|Understood.|

He gave the order as his body began to be wrapped in a brilliant blue-gold light. His eyes remained brilliant and piercing as he thought of countless possibilities, of battles to come and enemies to face and truths to uncover. The light wrapped around him and solidified into a radiant crystalline Monolith structure, a gateway of his own making that would serve as the doorway to conquest.
And his entire figure disappeared!

And his entire figure disappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 4716: Where Is He?
paragraphs: Capítulo 4716: Where Is He?
Across the Wastes of THE Fallout.
In a region filled with ash and flames and chaos, a graceful figure moved through the devastation with purpose that refused to waver.
Lumivara.

Her radiant humanoid form blazed against the surrounding darkness, an ethereal tail of pure light trailing behind her like banners of defiance. Fox-like features adorned a face of terrible beauty, with eyes that burned with golden blue luminescence and ears that swept back through hair that seemed woven from captured starlight.
Her brilliance illuminated the surrounding ash, pushing back the oppressive gloom that pervaded this cursed region.
Distinct signatures of Mana permeated across her Way of Light.

That blue-gold thread woven into her essence, the gift her Master had bestowed upon her, pulsed with steady rhythm as she used it to guide her search. It was a beacon and a compass both, connecting her to something greater than herself even in this realm of isolation.

At this moment, she had a stern gaze as she moved across the Wastes while trying to follow signatures of Mana. Trying to locate her Master in a region that did not allow for communication or teleportation.
The Wastes scrambled everything. They twisted space and severed connections. They made the simple act of finding someone into an ordeal that could take years or decades or longer.
But she was determined.
And she knew the others that she had recruited in THE Belly of Existence would be trying to do the same.
All the entities she had touched with the gift of Mana, all those who had sworn themselves to her Master’s Way.
They were out there. Searching. Refusing to give up.
And so, she continued on.
A few minutes later, as she crossed a region of volcanic flames where the very ground bled fire and the air itself seemed to burn, her expression shifted.
It became serious.

Her golden blue eyes narrowed as she looked behind her, her tail spreading wide in instinctive readiness. She sensed it before she saw it. The vibrant aura of multiple entities appearing, each of them carrying different depths of power that pressed against her senses like physical weight.
And then she saw them.
The figure that emerged first from the flames was magnificent in a way that demanded acknowledgment. She did not know him but...
This was...Gilgamesh!

He strode through the volcanic chaos as if it were a pleasant garden, his form radiating authority that predated civilizations. His features were carved from something older than mere flesh, a face of terrible beauty shining with glory!
Golden hair swept back from a brow that had worn crowns when crowns still meant something. His eyes blazed with the light of Genesis Principles.

He wore armor that seemed grown rather than forged, plates of paradoxical gold and obsidian that shifted between states of being as if unable to decide what they truly were. And in his bearing, in every step he took, there was the unmistakable weight of Fundamental Depth.
A Leader among Leaders!
Behind him, eighteen Early Creatures lined up like majestic titans.

They burned with THE Surface and Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, their forms massive and terrible in their grandeur. Paradoxical obsidian-gold armor adorned their bodies, matching their leader’s aesthetic in a display of unified purpose.
But that wasn’t what made Lumivara’s blood run cold.
Two of these Intermediate Depth Early Creatures held obsidian spears.
And mounted on those spears were severed heads.
The heads of collapsed entities.
Entities that seemed to be pulsing still with residual waves of their Way, Ways that had glimmers of... Mana.
That blue-gold thread. That gift. That connection to her Master.

And the figure of Gilgamesh himself was grasping in his hand a chain that bundled a man whose Way burned with Light and Mana. The chained entity’s body was on the edge of collapse, his form flickering between states of existence as if it couldn’t decide whether it was still alive or already dead. His eyes, when they met Lumivara’s, held nothing but apology.
She recognized him.
She recognized them all.
The heads on the spears. The chained being. All her followers that she had exposed to Mana in THE Belly of Existence. All those she had told to find the Master should they get separated.
Her responsibility.
Her failure.
“OOOH!”

Lumivara roared out with fury that made the volcanic flames recoil. Light exploded from her form, now nine tails blazing with radiance that turned the surrounding ash to glass. The signature of Mana within her burned brighter than it ever had, responding to her rage with equal intensity.
Gilgamesh looked at her calmly.
His expression didn’t change. His posture didn’t shift. He regarded her outburst the way one might regard a particularly loud insect, with mild interest and no concern whatsoever.
“We have been searching for the signatures of Mana and coming across lesser things constantly.”
His voice was deep and resonant, carrying the weight of ages in every syllable. It was the voice of a king who had ruled when kingship was absolute, when his word was law and his judgment was final.
“You seem a bit stronger than the rest. You must be his stronger follower.”
He tilted his head slightly, studying her with eyes that had witnessed the birth of many things.
“Do you know the whereabouts of your Master? Do you know where this man is?”
An illusory image appeared between them.
The Scale Breaker!
The blue-gold brilliance that surrounded him. The eyes that held depths that even Gilgamesh couldn’t fully fathom.
The First Leader looked at the image, then at the chained Intermediate Depth entity, then at the collapsed heads on spears held by his subordinates.
“The others kept their mouths sealed tightly.”
There was no satisfaction in his voice. No cruelty. Just statement of fact.
“I hope you won’t be the same. I take no pleasure in cruelty or torture, but Osmont must be found.”
He stepped forward, and the volcanic flames parted around him like servants clearing a path for royalty.
“So, little fox. The one whose signature you currently carry, that glimmer of blue in your Way, do you know where he is? Can you sense him?”
HUUUUUM!

As he spoke, multiple Genesis Principles seethed around his body, manifesting as countless weapons that materialized from nothing. Swords and spears and axes and halberds, each one a Phantasm that had shaped history, each one capable of annihilating lesser entities through concept alone.

His Fundamental Depth Weight crashed out like a billowing sea, pressing down upon the region with authority that demanded submission. The volcanic flames bent toward him as if in worship. The ash swirled in patterns that echoed ancient script!
Oh!
Oh!
Gilgamesh! Gilgamesh! Gilgamesh!
And Lumivara roared out in defiance.

Light and Mana erupted from her in a glorious pillar of brilliance that shot toward the burning sky. Her nine tails spread wide, each one becoming a blade of pure radiance. Her Way expanded outward, pushing back against his Weight with everything she had.
She would not kneel, and she would not speak.
And if she died here, she would die without betraying the one who had given her purpose!
Her eyes flickered with defiance as truly, she had hoped to at least see him again after all these eons. To relieve how he protected her in The Infinite Unfurling.
Oh.

chapters.title: Chapter 4717: Depth! I
paragraphs: Capítulo 4717: Depth! I
Wu Wei.
The concept had existed long before cultivators gave it a name, long before philosophers debated its meaning in quiet gardens and mountain temples.
It was woven into the very fabric of existence itself, a truth so fundamental that most entities never recognized it even as they lived within its embrace.
Effortless action.
Consider water.

It does not struggle against the rock in its path. It does not rage and scream and demand that the obstacle remove itself. It simply flows around, finding the path of least resistance while never abandoning its destination. Given enough time, that gentle pressure carves canyons. Given enough persistence, that soft yielding reshapes mountains.

Wu Wei was the understanding that true effectiveness came not from forcing outcomes but from responding spontaneously and appropriately to situations as they arose. It was the recognition that Existence had its own momentum, its own currents and flows, and that fighting against those currents exhausted one’s strength while achieving nothing.
But moving with them, adding one’s own intention to the existing flow, that was how empires were built and destinies were shaped.
This did not mean complete passivity or resignation.

The water still moved. The water still sought the sea. The water still carried within it the power to erode stone and flood valleys and reshape the very face of the world. Wu Wei was not about doing nothing. It was about doing the right thing at the right time in the right way, without wasted effort, without unnecessary struggle, without the friction that came from opposing the natural order.
It was responsive, non-coercive action.
A persistent, gentle pressure that never relented but never forced.

Across Observable Existence, those entities that had achieved the greatest heights understood this truth even if they called it by different names. They did not fight against the currents of fate. They read those currents, understood them, and then positioned themselves to be carried where they wished to go. They made themselves into vessels that the flow of existence itself wanted to fill.

The struggles that consumed lesser entities, the raging against circumstances, the desperate grasping for control, these were the hallmarks of those who had not yet learned. They exhausted themselves pushing against doors that opened inward. They broke themselves against walls that had doorways just to the side.
But those who understood Wu Wei?
They arrived at their destinations fresh and ready, having spent no more energy than the journey required.

Existence did not reward force. It rewarded alignment. It rewarded those who understood that the greatest power was not the power to impose one’s will upon reality, but the power to recognize which way reality was already flowing and to add one’s weight to that flow.
Now, Noah always went with the flow.
Whatever happened, he reacted and moved accordingly.
There were Primordial Realms connected to the Oldest Paradox of Existence?
Okay.
THE Infiniverse had made a Partial Embodiment and connected herself to Muspelheim as she now actively devoured it, and it needed to be conquered to make this process even faster?
Okay.

He didn’t rage against circumstances. He didn’t demand that reality reshape itself to match his expectations. He simply observed what was, understood its currents and flows, and then positioned himself to move with maximum effectiveness.
He flowed like water.
Like a gentle, pounding pressure that would always find a way.
And so...
HUUUUM!
He materialized outside of a massively rising blue-gold Monolith within Muspelheim.

His form coalesced from streams of azure and golden light, the signature of his Undifferentiated Mana painting itself across the primordial skies like a declaration written in fire. He wore robes that seemed woven from crystallized starlight, fabric that shifted between states of matter as if unable to decide what it truly was.

His features were sharp and angular, holding a type of beauty that was more conceptual than physical, the face of someone who had transcended the need for conventional appearance but chose to maintain one anyway.
His eyes burned with blue-gold brilliance, depths within them that seemed to contain entire folds.
And around him, Muspelheim spread in all its ancient glory.

The landscape was Mana and Flames given form and purpose. Obsidian plains stretched toward horizons that blazed with eternal flames, their surfaces reflecting light that had burned since before differentiation.

Mountains of crystallized magma rose like monuments to forgotten titans, their peaks wreathed in smoke that carried whispers of The First Tongue. Rivers of molten gold carved channels through the darkness.
The sky above was not a sky at all but an endless ocean, currents of seafire dancing in choreography that had been perfected over eons.
And Noah could see gigaparsecs away.

The auras of many powerful entities across the Depths of Absolute Sovereignty blazed like signal fires in the distance. Muspeli Lifeforms moved. And opposing them, different but equally powerful, the forces of THE Living Spirit marshaled!
As Noah looked at all of them, prompts bloomed before him.
|Welcome to Muspelheim|
|Primordial Realm of The First Spark |
|Status: Pre-Differentiation Domain, partially corrupted by THE Fallout at peripheral regions|
|Indigenous Population: Muspeli Lifeforms, native speakers of The First Tongue|
|Detected Entities within Sensory Range:|
|- THE Surface Depth signatures: 166|
|- THE Intermediate Depth signatures: 34|
|- THE Fundamental Depth signatures: 5|
|- Half-Step Absolute Depth signatures: 1 (THE Living Spirit)|
|First Tongue Saturation: 94.7% (Highest recorded outside of Ginnungagap)|
|Warning: Indigenous population possesses inherent sensitivity to First Tongue authority hierarchies.|
From her position among the obsidian spires, Surtra watched the newcomer’s entrance with eyes that had witnessed the birth of many things.
She did not know who he was.
His Depth was unreadable, masked behind something that her senses couldn’t penetrate.
But then her existence began to buzz.

The makeup of her Phonemes, those fundamental building blocks of The First Tongue that were woven into every Muspeli Lifeform, began to pulse. They vibrated at frequencies she had never felt before, resonating with something in that distant figure’s presence like tuning forks responding to a perfect pitch.
And she understood.

This was a quality unique to Muspeli Lifeforms, this sensitivity to The First Tongue’s hierarchy. It showed who among them held the most authority with the primordial language, who had mastered more Phonemes, who had gone deeper into the linguistic foundations of reality itself. When a greater speaker appeared, the lesser speakers felt it in their very being.
At this moment, Surtra could feel that the grand entity who had just appeared held the highest authority over The First Tongue.
Not just high.
The highest.

Higher than any Muspeli Lifeform she had ever encountered. Higher than the ancient masters she knew of in other locations in Muspelheim who had preserved The First Tongue through eons of isolation. Higher than anyone had any right to be.
He...should be the glorious entity that laid THE Claim.

She couldn’t be entirely sure because she could not sense his Depth. But The First Tongue never lied. The resonance in her Phonemes could not be faked or manufactured. Either this entity held supreme authority over their sacred language, or reality itself had begun to deceive them.
And reality did not deceive Muspeli Lifeforms about The First Tongue.
So at this moment...
Surtra raised her arms toward the burning sky, her form blazing with obsidian flames that had been kindled before differentiation separated the realms.
“Let the Bells of Muspelheim ring loudly!”
Her voice carried in The First Tongue, each Phoneme resonating through the primordial realm like bells struck by the hand of destiny.
“Signal to all the others that The One Who Laid The Claim that no others have been able to do has appeared! After eons of waiting, the one we were promised has come!”
BOOOOM!
The moment her words ended, the other Muspeli Lifeforms reacted.

Brilliant obsidian flames shot above from positions scattered across gigaparsecs of primordial landscape. Each flame was a voice, a confirmation, a recognition of what Surtra had proclaimed. They rose from the obsidian plains and the crystallized mountains and the banks of molten rivers, each one carrying the signature of a Muspeli Lifeform who had felt the same resonance in their Phonemes.
And then the epic scene truly unfolded.
Obsidian flames began to dance in the endless skies of Muspelheim.

They wove patterns that spelled out words in The First Tongue, proclamations visible across the entire realm. They rang with frequencies that were not quite sound and not quite light but something more fundamental than either.
As if they catalyzed a reaction, even more flames manifested.

The sky itself seemed to catch fire in a new way, the eternal burning intensifying into something that was less combustion and more celebration. The flames danced and rang in a unique symphony that began to spread out across Muspelheim, each new voice joining the chorus until the entire primordial realm vibrated with the message.
The One Who Laid The Claim had appeared.
After eons of waiting, he had come.

As the sound and flames reached past the Monolith Noah had just appeared in, his eyes shone with recognition. Prompts appeared in front of him, translating what he was witnessing into terms he could fully comprehend.
|Cultural Context: The Bells of Muspelheim|

|Throughout the history of Muspeli Lifeforms, every fundamental aspect of existence has been claimed by one entity or another. Existence claimed. Paradox claimed. Chaos claimed. Sovereignty claimed. Every great truth, every foundational concept, every pillar upon which Observable Existence rests has been laid claim to by some THE Entity.|
|But The First Tongue has never been claimed.|

|The language that predates all languages. The Phonemes from which all expression ultimately derives. The foundation of communication itself. No entity had ever possessed the authority to lay claim to it because no entity has ever mastered it fully enough to do so.|

|The Muspeli Lifeforms, as native speakers of The First Tongue, have waited for this moment since their Cognizance. They believed that one day, an entity would arise who could lay the claim that none others could make.|
|Your Way is THE Way of The First Tongue.|
|Current Status: The Bells of Muspelheim are ringing. The Flames of Muspelheim are dancing as they believe THE One Who Laid The Claim has been proclaimed.|
|Note: This title carries immense weight among Muspeli Lifeforms. They may view you as a prophesied figure rather than merely a powerful invader about to consume Muspelheim.|
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he looked at these prompts.
Possibilities flashed in his mind.
Existence flowed.
The gentle pressure of water against stone, given enough time, accomplished what brute force never could.
And Noah smiled as he began to descend toward the obsidian plains where the Muspeli Lifeforms waited with flames of welcome rather than flames of war.
THE Living Spirit gazed towards him with a calm gaze as things were likely about to get very chaotic!
But he wanted to see. There was so many things he wanted to try out as he wanted to see!
6/6 Keep the Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

“Signal to all the others that The One Who Laid The Claim that no others have been able to do has appeared!
After eons of waiting, the one we were promised has come!”
BOOOOM!
The moment her words ended, the other Muspeli Lifeforms reacted.
Brilliant obsidian flames shot above from positions scattered across gigaparsecs of primordial landscape.
Each flame was a voice, a confirmation, a recognition of what Surtra had proclaimed.

They rose from the obsidian plains and the crystallized mountains and the banks of molten rivers, each one carrying the signature of a Muspeli Lifeform who had felt the same resonance in their Phonemes.
And then the epic scene truly unfolded.
Obsidian flames began to dance in the endless skies of Muspelheim.
They wove patterns that spelled out words in The First Tongue, proclamations visible across the entire realm.
They rang with frequencies that were not quite sound and not quite light but something more fundamental than either.
As if they catalyzed a reaction, even more flames manifested.
The sky itself seemed to catch fire in a new way, the eternal burning intensifying into something that was less combustion and more celebration.
The flames danced and rang in a unique symphony that began to spread out across Muspelheim, each new voice joining the chorus until the entire primordial realm vibrated with the message.
The One Who Laid The Claim had appeared.
After eons of waiting, he had come.
As the sound and flames reached past the Monolith Noah had just appeared in, his eyes shone with recognition.
Prompts appeared in front of him, translating what he was witnessing into terms he could fully comprehend.
|Cultural Context: The Bells of Muspelheim|
|Throughout the history of Muspeli Lifeforms, every fundamental aspect of existence has been claimed by one entity or another.
Existence claimed.
Paradox claimed.
Chaos claimed.
Sovereignty claimed.
Every great truth, every foundational concept, every pillar upon which Observable Existence rests has been laid claim to by some THE Entity.|
|But The First Tongue has never been claimed.|
|The language that predates all languages.
The Phonemes from which all expression ultimately derives.
The foundation of communication itself.
No entity had ever possessed the authority to lay claim to it because no entity has ever mastered it fully enough to do so.|
|The Muspeli Lifeforms, as native speakers of The First Tongue, have waited for this moment since their Cognizance.
They believed that one day, an entity would arise who could lay the claim that none others could make.|
|Your Way is THE Way of The First Tongue.|
|Current Status: The Bells of Muspelheim are ringing.
The Flames of Muspelheim are dancing as they believe THE One Who Laid The Claim has been proclaimed.|
|Note: This title carries immense weight among Muspeli Lifeforms.
They may view you as a prophesied figure rather than merely a powerful invader about to consume Muspelheim.|
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he looked at these prompts.
Possibilities flashed in his mind.
Existence flowed.
The gentle pressure of water against stone, given enough time, accomplished what brute force never could.
And Noah smiled as he began to descend toward the obsidian plains where the Muspeli Lifeforms waited with flames of welcome rather than flames of war.
THE Living Spirit gazed towards him with a calm gaze as things were likely about to get very chaotic!
But he wanted to see.
There was so many things he wanted to try out as he wanted to see!
6/6 Keep the Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

chapters.title: Chapter 4718: Depth! II
paragraphs: The unique sensation ofTHE Formless Depthacross his body continued to be an extremely odd one as Noah descended alone toward the citadel of vibrant pillars surrounded by the forces of THE Living Spirit.

The best way he could explainTHE Formless Depthwas an extremely cooling vibrant sensation of power. It flowed through him like liquid starlight, touching every aspect of his existence with its impossible quality. The Phonemes of The First Tongue and Logos and Philologies inside of him reinforced his foundation even faster than before, each one humming with increased efficiency as ifTHE Formless Depthgave them permission to operate beyond their normal limits. His Organ of Civilization and Heart pumped even denser and grander, the blue-gold Mana coursing through channels that seemed to widen and deepen with every passing moment.
And his mental state...
THE Formless Depthseemed to amplify a sense of calmness and arrogance that seemed unmatched.

It wasn’t the arrogance of delusion or the calmness of ignorance. It was something deeper, something that emerged from the fundamental truth of what he had become. As if his Depth was telling his existence that regardless of what would be thrown at him in the future, he had to domineeringly and calmly get through it.
After all, he hadTHE Formless Depth!

It was why he freely floated ahead at this moment even though aHalf-Step Absolute Depth THE Living Spiritwas looking at him from the citadel below. Multiple Fundamental Depth entities surrounded that being like generals attending their emperor. Tens of Intermediate Depth spirits formed ranks behind them, their combined weight enough to crush lesser civilizations into dust.
And his Weight and immensity, in their eyes, may only be categorized as Intermediate, if they could feel it at all.
Yet he still felt calmness and freedom from worry in all this.

THE Formless Depthwas ecstatic and dangerous, and he had to be careful with it. Likely, even if he came acrossTHE Creatureright now, he felt like he would only gaze upon him calmly and even think he could take him on.
Eventually, yes.
But right now, the results would truly be very different.

THE Creaturehad accumulated weight and immensity across timescales that made Noah’s existence look like a candle flame compared to a star. THE Living Paradox had consumed THE Primordial Paradox and claimed authority over the concept of contradiction itself. THE Primordial Chaos had been spreading entropy since before differentiation separated the realms.
Noah was powerful, but he wasn’t delusional.
Not yet, anyway.
But this was the potential his Depth held! The grandness and immensity to even look upon THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Paradox and say... so what?!
That potential would be realized in time.
For now, he had lesser enemies to educate.

As he approached the citadel, he felt one of THE Fundamental Depth spirits near THE Living Spirit speak a few words to their leader. The massive presence that was THE Living Spirit seemed to consider for a moment, then nodded with glacial deliberation. And this terrifying thing, this Fundamental Depth entity, began to float up toward him.
The spirit that rose to meet Noah was a nightmare given form and purpose.

Its body was a twisted amalgamation of concepts that should never have been combined. The core of its being resembled anUdugdemon of ancient terror, a massive humanoid form that stood three times Noah’s height with skin that seemed carved from solidified shadows. Its face was a mask of cruel angles and sharp ridges, with seven eyes arranged in a pattern that suggested malevolent intelligence and twelve horns that curved backward from its skull like a crown of darkness.
But this was no mere demon.
This was a spirit that had achieved THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.

Its form flickered between states of being, solid one moment and ethereal the next, as if it couldn’t decide whether it wanted to be matter or energy or something else entirely. Chains of gray light wrapped around its arms and torso, not as restraints but as weapons, each link containing the compressed essence of subjugated Ways. Its hands ended in claws that seemed to cut through space itself, leaving trails of darkness in their wake.
And the weight that radiated from it...
That weight pressed down upon Noah like the judgment of ancient fiends!
The spirit stopped a hundred meters from him, its seven eyes all focusing on his form with expressions that ranged from contempt to curiosity to hunger.
"Are you supposed to be the reinforcement of these flaming giants?"
Its voice was like grinding stone mixed with screaming wind, carrying waves that made the air itself recoil.
"Do you even know who you stand against? If you did, you would at least not hide your Depth."
The spirit tilted its head, those seven eyes narrowing.
"You aren’t cowering and shitting yourself before my weight, so you should be Fundamental? Let me show you the difference in our Depths so that an ant like you knows just who you face."

At such words, waves of obsidian gray light buzzed from the spirit’s form as its Way bombarded Noah with crushing authority. The weight of THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty descended upon him like a mountain range collapsing, like the pressure at the bottom of an infinite ocean, like the grinding of tectonic plates that cared nothing for what was caught between them!
But Noah remained floating.

Even as such a terrifying weight descended on him, his position didn’t waver. His expression didn’t change. His eyes continued to regard the spirit with that calm, almost lazy attention that seemed entirely inappropriate for someone facing a Fundamental Depth entity.
|Arche of Perpetual Harvest - Active Response|
|The budding Arche of Perpetual Harvest is exerting tremendous effort to process incoming authority.|
|Current Function: Oppressive force redirection and conversion.|
|Result: Only 10% of pressure directed against you is actually received.The remaining 90% is being converted into harvestable essence and fed back into your reserves.|
|The spirit seems very committed to feeding you. I’m not sure he understands what’s happening, but his dedication to making you stronger is almost touching.|
|Sustainability: Current harvest rate exceeds drain rate. You are technically profiting from this assault.|
Noah blinked as he looked at the prompts.
Was Ruination also becoming influenced by the arrogance and calmness of his Formless Depth? Her prompts seemed a bit freer!
His eyes shone brightly as he looked at THE Fundamental Depth entity before him even more closely.
Lens of Civilization activated, and information crystallized before him.
|Entity Analysis: Gal’Thûrak the Subjugator|
|Classification: Udug Spirit Variant (Elder Form)|
|Depth: THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Distinction: THE Terror of Chains|
|Way: The Way of Subjugation|
|Principles:|
|- Principle of Binding |
|- Principle of Domination |
|- Principle of Fear Manifestation|
|- Principle of Authority Theft|
|Civilization: The Chained Collective (14,847 subjugated entities)|

|Notable Capabilities: Can temporarily steal aspects of defeated opponents’ Ways. Chain constructs possess semi-autonomous hunting behavior. Fear aura intensifies against those who recognize his reputation.|
|Weakness Assessment: Heavily reliant on psychological warfare. Actual combat capability, while formidable, does not match the terror his reputation suggests.|

After he looked at this, Noah still felt his body buzzing somewhat. THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty was still not a walk in the park for him at this moment, regardless of how much the Arche of Perpetual Harvest mitigated. The pressure that did get through was still immense, still taxing, still demanding!
He stayed freely in the skies right now, but the moment this entity made a true Declaration, they might be able to knock him down or he would be forced to useThe Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem.
But he truly wanted to test the limits of his own power and budding Archai!

chapters.title: Chapter 4719: Depth! III
paragraphs: At this moment, his mind buzzed with glory as he cycled everything he had to utter out something that only Fundamental Depth entities could produce.
He formed a Thesis in his mind.
The process was heavy.
It demanded everything he had and more.

His Philologies began to restructure themselves, arranging into patterns that he had only just learned existed. The Phonemes of The First Tongue vibrated at frequencies that pushed against the boundaries of what his current immensity could support. His Logos blazed with blue-gold fire as they prepared to serve as the framework for something that should have been beyond his reach.
The drain on his reserves was immediate and staggering.
But THE Formless Depth held firm.

It told him that this was possible. That the normal rules didn’t apply to him. That if he wanted to speak with the voice of Fundamental Depth, then he would speak with the voice of Fundamental Depth and reality could adjust its expectations accordingly.
He opened his eyes.

Above his head, THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons manifested and opened its pages, each one blazing with Phonemes that had never been observed before. The book rotated slowly, its presence announcing that what came next was not mere words but linguistic law being written into existence.
He would write his Thesis in his book!
And Noah spoke.
"I propose that within Muspelheim, only those to whom I grant permission may draw power from The First Tongue."
HUUM!
The words emerged not as sound but as truth seeking validation.
"All others who attempt to access its authority shall find their connection severed, their Phonemes silenced, their foundations denied. This is my Thesis. Let reality examine it and find no flaw."
It was a terrifying Thesis.
And the moment he uttered it, the response was immediate.

Around Noah, lines of Logos and Philologies vibrated with frequencies that made space itself hum in sympathy. From him, a blast of blue-gold light erupted and cascaded across Muspelheim, spreading outward at speeds that defied conventional measurement. The light touched everything, Muspeli Lifeforms and Spirit armies alike, testing and categorizing and implementing.
The demon spirit Gal’Thûrak watched this display with an expression that shifted rapidly.
"Who do you think you are to declare such a thing?!"
His voice thundered with outrage, his chains rattling as they prepared to strike.
And yet before he fully finished his words, he felt a change.
His expression became astonished.
Then shocked.
Then somber.
Then incredulous as he looked toward Noah.
Something fundamental had shifted in his connection to power. Something that had always been there, so constant that he had never noticed it, was suddenly different. Diminished. Restricted.
At the same time, prompts bloomed before Noah with comprehensive detail.
|Thesis Actualization Report|
|Thesis: "Within Muspelheim, only those to whom I grant permission may draw power from The First Tongue."|
|Status: Partially Applied|
|Coverage: Current region of Muspelheim (approximately 0.3% of total realm)|
|Resource Expenditure: Approximately 67% of available immensity was utilized in initial actualization.|

|Achievement: You have taken a true step toward utilizing the power of someone who has laid a claim on an aspect of the Oldest Paradox of Existence. The First Tongue recognizes your authority to regulate its access within your sphere of influence. Congratulations on telling reality that you get to decide who speaks its oldest language.|
|Thesis Effects on Non-Permitted Targets|

|Core Principle: Mana is the authority behind everything. All Principles are composed of Phonemes of The First Tongue. All Ways and Civilizations, regardless of their specialized forms, ultimately draw their power from this primordial source.|
|By severing access to The First Tongue, you have cut non-permitted entities off from the foundation upon which all their power rests.|
|Specific Effects:|
|Mana Flow: Reduced by 100% within coverage area. Non-permitted entities cannot draw upon ambient Mana or channel it through their systems. Their reserves drain without replenishment.|

|Principle Function: All Principles rely on Phonemes for their operation. Without access to The First Tongue, Principles operate at approximately 45% efficiency as they struggle to function on stored reserves alone.|
|Way Expression: Ways are specialized forms of The First Tongue. Non-permitted entities find their Way partially muted, operating at roughly 50% of normal output.|
|Authority Regeneration: Without access to The First Tongue’s ambient power, authority regeneration drops by approximately 65%. Non-permitted entities are burning fuel they cannot replace.|
|Civilization Functions: Civilizations draw power from Mana to fuel their operations. Any Civilization features within coverage area cease drawing new power and begin depleting reserves.|
|Cumulative Effect: Non-permitted entities operating at approximately 45-55% of their normal capability, with this percentage decreasing over time as reserves drain without replenishment.|
|Note: Gal’Thûrak appears to have just realized his chains no longer rattle with the same enthusiasm.|
|Thesis Challenge Window|
|As per the ancient expression of Thesis, other entities may challenge this proposition through dialectic debate. If successfully challenged, the Thesis collapses entirely.|
|Current Challenge Status: No challenges registered. The spirit seems too busy being shocked to form a coherent philosophical argument.|

|If Thesis Remains Unchallenged: Gradual solidification into local truth. After sufficient time without successful challenge, the Thesis will become permanent law within its coverage area, no longer requiring your immensity to maintain.|
|Strategic Assessment|
|The Spirit before you has just lost roughly half his effective power and is slowly losing more.|
|He knows it.|
|He knows you did it.|
|He does not know how, whether you can do it again, or how long it will last.|
As Noah read the prompts explaining his Thesis, he felt the drain on his immensity. It was substantial, yes. The cost of proposing such an audacious truth into existence was not small.
But he also felt that drain rapidly being refilled.

The Arche of Perpetual Harvest continued its work, converting the ambient First Tongue energy in the region into harvestable essence. The very language he had just claimed authority over was now feeding his recovery. The more his enemies relied on The First Tongue, the more they powered his restoration.
He looked toward THE Fundamental Depth Spirit before him.

Gal’Thûrak’s seven eyes were wide with an emotion that looked remarkably like fear. His chains hung limply at his sides, no longer rattling with eager violence. The weight that had pressed down upon Noah moments ago had diminished to something almost ignorable.
Noah smiled calmly.
"You asked who I am?"

His voice carried across the burning skies of Muspelheim, reaching not just Gal’Thûrak but THE Living Spirit far behind and his armies and the giants of the Muspeli Lifeforms who watched from their positions.
"Allow me to introduce myself."
He floated forward slightly, his robes of crystallized starlight shifting around him like the mantle of a king.
"I am someone who can question whether your existence should even be before me."
The words were casual. Almost lazy. As if he were discussing the weather rather than the fundamental nature of reality.
"Now, since you have brought yourself to me, I will leave your existence intact if you present your Civilization to me and kneel in apology."
He paused, letting the offer hang in the air.
"Otherwise..."
His eyes met Gal’Thûrak’s seven with perfect calm.
"Your Depth, regardless of where it is at, will face collapse today."

He said these words calmly and casually, as if making such a threat to a Fundamental Depth entity was the most natural thing in existence. As if he did this every day. As if the being before him was not THE Terror of Chains but merely an inconvenience that had placed itself in his path!
Gal’Thûrak stared at him in astonishment.
THE Living Spirit, far behind in the citadel, shifted its massive presence in a way that suggested sudden and intense interest, and then a frown as the effect of the Thesis exerted itself here!
The One Who Laid The Claim had not merely arrived.
He had announced his authority in a way that none of them could deny!

The very language he had just claimed authority over was now feeding his recovery.
The more his enemies relied on The First Tongue, the more they powered his restoration.
He looked toward THE Fundamental Depth Spirit before him.
Gal’Thûrak’s seven eyes were wide with an emotion that looked remarkably like fear.
His chains hung limply at his sides, no longer rattling with eager violence.
The weight that had pressed down upon Noah moments ago had diminished to something almost ignorable.
Noah smiled calmly.
"You asked who I am?"

His voice carried across the burning skies of Muspelheim, reaching not just Gal’Thûrak but THE Living Spirit far behind and his armies and the giants of the Muspeli Lifeforms who watched from their positions.
"Allow me to introduce myself."
He floated forward slightly, his robes of crystallized starlight shifting around him like the mantle of a king.
"I am someone who can question whether your existence should even be before me."
The words were casual.
Almost lazy.
As if he were discussing the weather rather than the fundamental nature of reality.
"Now, since you have brought yourself to me, I will leave your existence intact if you present your Civilization to me and kneel in apology."
He paused, letting the offer hang in the air.
"Otherwise..."
His eyes met Gal’Thûrak’s seven with perfect calm.
"Your Depth, regardless of where it is at, will face collapse today."
He said these words calmly and casually, as if making such a threat to a Fundamental Depth entity was the most natural thing in existence.
As if he did this every day.
As if the being before him was not THE Terror of Chains but merely an inconvenience that had placed itself in his path!
Gal’Thûrak stared at him in astonishment.
THE Living Spirit, far behind in the citadel, shifted its massive presence in a way that suggested sudden and intense interest, and then a frown as the effect of the Thesis exerted itself here!
The One Who Laid The Claim had not merely arrived.
He had announced his authority in a way that none of them could deny!

chapters.title: Chapter 4720: Depth! IV
paragraphs: THE Terror of Chains, Gal’Thûrak.
His gaze was heavy as he stared at the entity who had shockingly uttered out what looked to be a Declaration, but seemed to be so much more.
More than that, they proclaimed not giving permission to others utilizing The First Tongue.
For the declaration to actually stay, for it to take hold and begin affecting reality itself, what did that mean regarding this being whose Depth could not be discerned?
He couldn’t be Half-Step Absolute Depth or Absolute, right?

Such beings were rare beyond measure. THE Living Spirit was Half-Step Absolute, and his presence alone had been enough to subjugate the Muspeli Lifeforms here and claim dominion over vast swathes of this primordial territory. If another being of similar caliber had arrived, Gal’Thûrak would have sensed it. The weight of such existence couldn’t be hidden.
And yet...
This entity’s Depth was unreadable. His power was masked behind something that Gal’Thûrak’s senses couldn’t penetrate. And the declaration he had just made was functioning, actually functioning!
Even if he was Fundamental, how was his declaration affecting Gal’Thûrak so severely? How could he command The First Tongue like so?! He didn’t even seem like a Muspeli Lifeform!

Gal’Thûrak’s seven eyes flickered toward THE Living Spirit, who remained floating near the citadel far below. At the same time, he sent a private message through channels that only those bound to THE Living Spirit’s Civilization could access.
"Sir, what shall I do here? My Way seems to be in peril as we cannot properly gauge this being. Could he be at your level?"

The message carried his genuine concern, his confusion, his request for guidance. He had served THE Living Spirit faithfully for eons. He had subjugated countless entities in his master’s name. He had earned the right to ask for counsel in moments of uncertainty.
But THE Living Spirit did not reply.
The silence stretched for one heartbeat. Two. Three.
Gal’Thûrak’s expression became even heavier as understanding dawned.

The Sir wanted to use him to test things out. THE Living Spirit was observing, waiting, allowing his subordinate to probe the enemy’s capabilities so that he could gauge the threat without exposing himself to unknown danger. It was a logical strategy. It was a cold strategy. It was exactly what Gal’Thûrak himself would have done in his master’s position.
But that didn’t make it any less bitter to be the one used as the probe.
Still, Gal’Thûrak had lived for long!

Eons upon eons of existence had taught him many things. Pride was useful when it served survival. Pride was a liability when it didn’t. Lesser beings, those young fools who had accumulated power without wisdom, would bellow out in rage at an enemy who had somehow made a declaration that caused them tolose access to The First Tongue.They would attack blindly, seeking to prove their superiority through force.
And they would die.
Gal’Thûrak had not survived this long by being a fool.
His chains fell silent at his sides. His seven eyes closed, one by one, until only the central eye remained open. And then, in a movement that seemed to defy everything his title represented...
"It seems I have, in haste, stood against someone I did not understand."
His voice emerged calm and measured, carrying none of the earlier contempt.
"For this transgression, I shall kneel in apology."

And then THE Terror of Chains, THE Fundamental Depth entity whose very name had made civilizations tremble, whose chains had bound countless Ways and dragged them into servitude, whose existence had been synonymous with conquest and domination for longer than most entities had existed...
Knelt.

His massive form descended from its hovering position, obsidian-gray limbs folding beneath him as he lowered himself before Noah. His twelve horns, which had always pointed proudly toward the heavens, now angled toward the burning earth of Muspelheim. His chains pooled around him like the shed skin of a serpent, no longer weapons but mere accessories.

"However," Gal’Thûrak continued, his voice still measured, "presenting my Way is a bit harder. It is intertwined with my Civilization and with those I have bound over the eons. To present it would be to unravel everything I have built. I hope this apology will suffice for the moment while we discuss terms."
Silence descended upon this region of Muspelheim.
The Muspeli Lifeforms stared in disbelief, their obsidian flames flickering with confusion.

The armies of THE Living Spirit wavered in their formations. Intermediate Depth entities exchanged uncertain glances. The other Fundamental Depth spirits near the citadel shifted uncomfortably, their certainties shaken by the sight of one of their own abandoning pride so completely.
And THE Living Spirit himself...
His expression showed coldness and a trace of anger.

The massive presence that dominated this region of Muspelheim rippled with displeasure that made the air itself grow heavy. He had wanted Gal’Thûrak to engage, to probe, to reveal the stranger’s capabilities through combat. Instead, his subordinate had surrendered without a single exchange of power.
He had learned nothing new.
Noah looked at this powerful demon before him as he wholly did not expect this.

Where was the pride and arrogance that he had always come to know? Every enemy he had faced, from the lowest Beast World invader to the mightiest THE Entities, had met him with certainty in their own superiority. They had attacked first and questioned never. They had died with confusion in their eyes, never understanding how someone of lesser apparent power had overcome them!
But this one...
This one had actually thought.
This one had assessed the situation, recognized the danger, and chosen survival over pride!
Were those of higher Depth so perceptive and so protective of their Ways that they actually moved with logic?
It was almost disappointing.
Almost.

|Through the brilliance of your Way and actions, you have caused a Fundamental Depth entity to kneel before your grandeur.|
|Entity Affected: Gal’Thûrak the Subjugator|

This is a limitation he imposed upon himself by choosing to kneel. His own existence now recognizes you as superior, and that recognition cannot be undone through force alone, regardless of Depth.|
|Combined Effect Assessment:|
|Previous Limitation: Your Thesis restricts his access to The First Tongue, reducing his capability to approximately 50%.|
|New Limitation: His voluntary submission reduces his capability to stand against you specifically by an additional factor.|
|Result: Gal’Thûrak can only express approximately 10% of his Depth and immensity against you.|
|THE Terror of Chains has successfully terrorized himself into impotence against you.|
